paper.title: Latent On-Policy Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Enabling agents to learn from experience and internalize it into their policy has become a central problem in self-evolving AI. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers an effective pathway by using a privileged self-teacher to provide dense supervision on the student's own trajectories; however, existing methods still rely heavily on designer-specified privileged artifacts (e.g., answers, feedback, skills, or trajectories), limiting the end-to-end learnability and scalability required for cont

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 on-policy self-distillation 中 privileged context 依赖人工设计的问题。已有 OPSD 通常把答案、反馈、成功轨迹、反思文本或技能标签作为 teacher 的额外上下文，但这些格式预先规定了 teacher 能看到什么。LOPD 的目标是让 privileged context 变成可学习的连续 latent tokens，由经验数据端到端生成，并通过 teacher 的 token-level 分布监督 student。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发在于：它把经验学习中的“监督信号形式”从人工文本模板转成可优化的 latent substrate。虽然论文场景是 agent 和 on-policy distillation，但核心问题接近 RL/SFT 数据如何转化为密集训练信号。相比 RLVR 只用稀疏可验证奖励，LOPD 试图把历史经验压缩成 teacher 可用的连续条件，使 student 在自己实际访问的状态上获得更细粒度的分布监督。这个方向对 continual self-improvement、训练信号压缩、latent memory-conditioned teacher 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 流程保留标准 OPSD 的结构。student 根据任务和交互历史采样自己的 trajectory；teacher 访问同一批 visited prefixes，并输出 token-level distribution；student 用 reverse-KL 向 teacher 蒸馏。关键变化是 teacher 的 privileged context 不再来自手写规则，而是由 composer 从检索到的 past experiences 中生成一组连续 latent context tokens。composer 和 student 通过同一训练目标联合优化，因此 latent context 学习保留哪些经验信息能让 teacher 给出更有用的监督。为避免 teacher 退化成容易被 student 匹配但没有额外信息的分布，作者加入 privileged-margin constraint，要求 teacher 相对 student 保持可验证的 log-probability advantage。训练结束后只保留 student，推理时不需要经验库、检索器、composer 或 latent context。
summary.experiments: 论文报告在 3 个模型 backbone 和 7 个 benchmark 上验证 LOPD。结果显示 LOPD 优于 RLVR 和代表性 OPSD 方法；相较 GRPO 和 Skill-SD，使用不到 30% 的 rollout budget 取得更好的结果。消融实验重点验证两个设计：第一，latent privileged context 需要联合学习，固定或手工设计的 context 效果较弱；第二，privileged-margin constraint 有助于保持 teacher 的信息优势，减少 teacher-student 分布塌缩。由于给出的全文片段未包含完整表格，具体 benchmark 名称和每项绝对分数无法确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 introduction 中对 OPSD、RLVR、privileged context 的问题定义，再看 method 中 latent composer、reverse-KL distillation 和 privileged-margin constraint 的公式。实验部分优先看三类对比：与 RLVR 的样本效率差异，与其他 OPSD 变体的对比，以及 composer / margin 的消融。预计阅读 30 分钟。如果关注 RL pretrain 或持续学习，值得重点看 latent context 是否真的学到可迁移的经验压缩，而不是只在固定 benchmark 上提供额外条件信息。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a limitation of on-policy self-distillation: the privileged context given to the self-teacher is usually hand-designed. Prior OPSD methods condition the teacher on answers, feedback, successful trajectories, textual reflections, or skill annotations. LOPD instead makes the privileged context a learnable continuous latent substrate generated from past experience.
summary_en.importance: The idea is relevant to the interface between reinforcement learning, distillation, and continual improvement. Rather than treating experience as sparse rewards or manually formatted textual artifacts, LOPD learns a compact conditioning signal that helps a self-teacher produce dense token-level supervision on the student’s own trajectories. This is a useful lens for thinking about how post-training signals can be compressed, reused, and internalized by the policy without requiring extra context at inference time.
summary_en.technical_approach: LOPD keeps the standard OPSD loop. The student samples on-policy trajectories from the task and interaction history. The teacher then reevaluates the same visited prefixes and provides token-level distributions. The student is trained with reverse-KL distillation toward the teacher. The main change is how the teacher receives privileged information: a composer retrieves prior experiences and maps them into continuous latent context tokens. The composer is optimized jointly with the distillation objective, so it learns which parts of experience are useful for teacher supervision. A privileged-margin constraint requires the teacher to maintain a verifiable log-probability advantage over the student, preventing the learned context from collapsing into an uninformative condition. At inference, only the student is kept; no retrieval module, composer, database, or latent context is needed.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments over three model backbones and seven benchmarks. LOPD outperforms RLVR and representative OPSD baselines, and achieves better results than GRPO and Skill-SD with less than 30% of their rollout budget. Ablations focus on the need to learn the privileged context jointly and the role of the privileged-margin constraint. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so benchmark names and exact per-task scores cannot be verified here.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the distinction between RLVR, OPD, and OPSD, then read the method sections covering the latent composer, reverse-KL distillation, and the privileged-margin constraint. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against RLVR, other OPSD variants, and the ablations on composer learning and margin constraints. Expected reading time is about 30 minutes. For researchers working on RL pretraining or continual learning, the key question is whether the latent context learns a reusable compression of experience, or mainly acts as an additional benchmark-specific conditioning channel.

recommendation.zh: 把自蒸馏的特权信号从人工设计改成可学习潜在token，思路对RL-pretrain与自我进化训练有启发，重点看§3潜在token构造与训练目标设计。
recommendation.en: Replacing hand-crafted privileged signals in self-distillation with learnable latent tokens is insightful for RL-pretrain and self-evolution training; focus on §3 for latent token construction and training objectives.

institutions: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

paper.title: Drift and Dependence: Layer-wise Information-Theoretic Bounds for Replay-Based Continual Learning
paper.abstract: Continual learning must absorb new tasks without erasing old ones, and replay---mixing a small buffer of past examples into current training---is among the most effective remedies for catastrophic forgetting. Yet its generalization behavior is shaped by two coupled effects that existing analyses fold into a single hypothesis-level quantity: finite memory replaces each past distribution with an empirical proxy, and repeated reuse couples the buffer, the current data, and the final hypothesis thro

summary.core_problem: 分析 replay-based continual learning 的泛化误差，区分有限 memory 带来的表示漂移和重复 replay 带来的优化依赖。
summary.importance: 贡献是理论分析。它对 continual pretraining 有间接参考：在有限 replay buffer 与持续训练共存时，遗忘和泛化不能只看最终 hypothesis，而要看层级表示漂移与优化轨迹耦合。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 layer-wise information-theoretic framework，将 expected generalization gap 分解为 replay-induced representation drift 和 optimization-dependence term。后者进一步拆成 stability、plasticity、interaction 与 residual-coupling。还引入 Wasserstein relaxation 处理 support mismatch 下的 drift，并给出更可操作的 bound 形式。
summary.experiments: 摘要以理论结果为主，未给出具体模型、数据集、训练规模或实证提升。主要成果是分解式泛化界和可操作化的松弛项。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper analyzes the generalization gap of replay-based continual learning by separating finite-memory representation drift from optimization dependence induced by repeated replay.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is theoretical. It is indirectly relevant to continual pretraining: when finite replay buffers and ongoing optimization interact, forgetting and generalization cannot be understood only through the final hypothesis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper develops a layer-wise information-theoretic framework that decomposes the expected generalization gap into replay-induced representation drift and an optimization-dependence term. The dependence term is further resolved into stability, plasticity, interaction, and residual-coupling components. A Wasserstein relaxation makes the drift term usable under support mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract is primarily theoretical and does not report concrete model scales, datasets, training runs, or empirical gains. The main outputs are decomposition bounds and operational relaxations.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 theorem setup；对 continual pretrain 的价值是拆分漂移和优化耦合，不是直接给 recipe。
recommendation.en: Skim the theorem setup; its value for continual pretraining is the drift/dependence decomposition, not an actionable recipe.

paper.title: Macaron-V1: Towards Open Continual Learning with Self-Improvement and Mixture-of-LoRA
paper.abstract: Macaron-V1 is an open agent-model family for experiential intelligence: learning from experience in real environments and continuing to learn after deployment. It is organized around two system goals. Adaptation is pursued through recursive improvement of versioned model-harness pairs, where experience from one configuration is evaluated under an external contract and used to construct its successor. Collaboration is pursued via the Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) architecture that freezes a base model, c

summary.core_problem: 当前大模型后训练普遍采用集中式、静态的流程，模型发布后缺乏将真实部署环境中的交互经验转化为持续能力提升的闭环；同时多任务联合后训练在共享参数上容易产生跨任务干扰，难以兼顾聊天、Agent、代码、GenUI等异构能力。
summary.importance: 提出了一套面向部署后持续学习的Agent模型系统设计范式，将harness（运行时配置/工具/上下文）迭代与参数化的模块化适配结合，对持续预训练/后训练的闭环构建、以及大模型发布后的能力演进路径有工程参考价值；Mixture-of-LoRA的设计也为多任务后训练中避免参数干扰提供了可落地的折中方案。
summary.technical_approach: Macaron-V1围绕两个系统目标构建：1）适配（Adaptation）：采用显式版本化的model-harness对进行递归迭代，每个版本包含固定模型快照与运行时配置；在生产harness中审计执行轨迹、搜索最优上下文配置、筛选高质量轨迹，用于后续专家LoRA的更新，从而将部署经验转化为下一版本的能力提升，过程中保留可审计性与外部契约约束。2）协作（Collaboration）：采用Mixture-of-LoRA（MoL）架构，冻结大参数量基座模型，叠加多个独立的专家LoRA（聊天/Agent/代码/GenUI等），每轮用户对话由共享运行时选择单个LoRA生效，在不修改基座的前提下实现异构能力的模块化组合，避免跨任务参数干扰。旗舰版本Macaron-V1-Venti基于744B GLM-5.2基座搭配4个LoRA，面向本地部署的Macaron-V1-Tall基于50B Qwen3.6采用相同设计。
summary.experiments: 全文以系统报告形式呈现，侧重架构与迭代流程设计，未给出具体基准上的量化对比数字；核心产出是完整的持续学习系统框架、版本化迭代流程与MoL的工程实现方案，以及两个不同参数量级的实例化模型家族。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计15-25分钟。重点看第1节对“经验智能（experiential intelligence）”的定义与现有集中式后训练局限的分析，以及适配/协作两个维度的设计取舍；关注MoL与其他专家组合方式（token级adapter混合、多实例路由）的定位差异。若关注工程落地，可重点看版本化model-harness对的递归迭代流程与审计机制。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM post-training mostly relies on centralized, static pipelines. After release, there is no closed loop to convert interaction experience collected in real deployment environments into continuous capability improvement. Meanwhile, joint post-training over heterogeneous tasks tends to cause cross-task interference through shared parameters, making it difficult to balance diverse capabilities such as chat, agent tool use, coding, and GenUI.
summary_en.importance: The work proposes a practical system design paradigm for agent models targeting post-deployment continual learning, which couples harness (runtime configuration / tools / context) iteration with modular parametric adaptation. It offers engineering insights for building closed-loop continual pretraining / post-training pipelines and for capability evolution after model release. The Mixture-of-LoRA design also provides a deployable compromise to avoid parameter interference in multi-task post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Macaron-V1 is organized around two system goals. 1) Adaptation: recursive improvement over explicitly versioned model–harness pairs, where each version bundles a fixed model snapshot and a runtime configuration. Execution trajectories are audited in the production harness, context configurations that shape behavior are searched, and high-quality trajectories are selected to update specialist LoRA adapters for the next revision. Deployment experience is thus converted into capability gains across successive revisions, with auditability and external contract constraints preserved. 2) Collaboration: a Mixture-of-LoRA (MoL) architecture that freezes the large base model and layers independent specialist LoRAs (for chat, agent, coding, GenUI, etc.) on top. A shared runtime selects exactly one LoRA per user turn, enabling modular composition of heterogeneous capabilities without modifying the base model and avoiding cross-task parameter interference. The flagship Macaron-V1-Venti uses a 744B GLM-5.2 base with four LoRAs; the locally deployable Macaron-V1-Tall follows the same design on a 50B Qwen3.6 base.
summary_en.experiments: Presented as a system report, the paper focuses on architecture and iteration pipeline design and does not include detailed quantitative benchmark comparisons. The core deliverables are a complete continual learning system framework, the versioned iteration workflow, the engineering implementation of MoL, and two instantiated model families at different parameter scales.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, ~15–25 minutes. Focus on Section 1's definition of experiential intelligence and its analysis of limitations in centralized post-training, as well as the design trade-offs between the Adaptation and Collaboration dimensions. Pay attention to how MoL is positioned differently from other specialist composition methods such as token-level adapter mixing or multi-instance routing. For engineering-oriented readers, the recursive iteration loop and audit mechanism for versioned model–harness pairs are the most relevant parts.

recommendation.zh: 读系统图和 continual learning 评估即可；MoL 是务实工程，是否真能抗遗忘要看长期曲线。
recommendation.en: Read the system design and continual-learning eval only; MoL is pragmatic, but forgetting claims need longitudinal curves.

paper.title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents
paper.abstract: Continual self-evolution requires LLM agents to transform environmental interactions into reliable and reusable experience. Existing methods typically refine individual trajectories or abstract shared knowledge from related trajectories, but their experience representations are often disconnected from the underlying reasoning process. This limits feedback attribution, cross-task transfer, and update and retrieval efficiency, particularly in complex reasoning tasks with outcome-level feedback. To

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 如何把环境交互轨迹沉淀成可复用、可归因、可迁移的“经验”，并支持持续自我进化。
summary.importance: 属于通用Agent的记忆/经验管理范式探索；对“如何组织可学习的交互数据、如何把结果反馈对齐到推理结构”有启发，但与基座预训练本身距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Tree-of-Experience（ToE）：用与层级推理过程对齐的树结构组织经验（分析视角/推理路径），并用环境结果对节点可靠性做校准，以支持更新、迁移与高效检索。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务集、模型、对比方法与量化增益；从描述看主要对比“逐轨迹精炼”或“跨轨迹抽象”的经验表示方法，关注复杂推理与结果级反馈场景。

summary_en.core_problem: How can an LLM agent convert environment interactions into reusable, attributable, transferable experience for continual self-evolution?
summary_en.importance: A general agent memory/experience-management idea; potentially useful for organizing learnable interaction data and aligning outcome feedback with reasoning structure, but not directly about foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tree-of-Experience (ToE): store experience in a shared tree aligned with hierarchical reasoning (perspectives and reasoning paths), calibrate node reliability using environment outcomes, enabling systematic updates, transfer, and efficient retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks concrete tasks, model details, baselines, and effect sizes; appears to compare against trajectory-level refinement and cross-trajectory abstraction methods under outcome-only feedback.

recommendation.zh: 把“经验”显式对齐到层级推理树是个干净的记忆组织想法，但摘要看不到强实证；只需扫方法定义与检索/更新规则，别指望直接迁移到pretrain。
recommendation.en: Aligning experience with a hierarchical reasoning tree is a clean memory-structuring idea, but evidence seems thin from the abstract; skim the representation/update/retrieval rules, don’t expect direct pretraining takeaways.

paper.title: Continual Learning in Transition
paper.abstract: Classical continual learning (CL) has primarily focused on enabling models to update and retain knowledge through parameter-centric mechanisms, e.g., training strategies, architectural designs, and weight adaptation. However, emerging paradigms are reshaping the scope of CL beyond this traditional model adaptation view. For instance, on-policy learning broadens the space of update mechanisms; test-time training extends CL from the training phase to inference; and external harness components such

summary.core_problem: 重新界定 continual learning：学习不再只发生在参数更新中，也可能发生在 on-policy 交互、test-time training、外部记忆、技能库和协议层。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是概念框架和综述。它对 continual pretrain、agent memory、技能库、在线学习之间的边界有整理作用，但摘要看不出新的实验结论或可操作 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 用 When、How、Where 三个维度描述 continual learning 的转向。How 包含 off-policy、on-policy 和 beyond-gradient optimization；Where 从模型参数扩展到外部 harness 组件，如 memory、skill libraries 和 interaction protocols。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示这是综述或立场型工作，未报告模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或定量实验结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes continual learning as a broader adaptation problem where learning may happen through on-policy updates, test-time training, memory, skill libraries, and interaction protocols, not only through parameter updates.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a conceptual framework and survey. It is useful for organizing continual pretraining, agent memory, and online adaptation, but the abstract does not indicate new experiments or a concrete training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors characterize the transition with three axes: When, How, and Where learning occurs. The How axis covers off-policy, on-policy, and beyond-gradient optimization; the Where axis expands adaptation from weights to harness components such as memory, skill libraries, and interaction protocols.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract presents the work as a survey or position paper and does not report model sizes, training data, baselines, or quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 概念框架可作术语索引，不必细读；若做 continual pretrain，只看 When/How/Where 分类即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a terminology map, not a deep read; for continual pretraining, the When/How/Where taxonomy is the part to keep.

paper.title: Optimal Training-Time Scaling in Gradual Adaptation
paper.abstract: In gradual adaptation, how should the training time on each task change as the number of intermediate tasks increases? We study this question for overparameterized linear regression tasks that change smoothly and share a zero-loss solution. With $N$ tasks and training time $s_N$ on each, the final learning progress converges to a continuum curve when $Ns_N\toτ$. The limiting progress is $Θ(τ)$ for small $τ$ and $Θ(τ^{-1})$ for large $τ$, so both very short and very long training produce little p

summary.core_problem: 研究渐进式适应中，当中间任务数量增加时，每个任务应该训练多久，才能让最终任务上的学习进展最大。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个训练时间分配的 scaling 结论，虽然建立在过参数线性回归和小规模视觉/时间漂移实验上，但问题与 continual pretraining、课程学习和领域平滑迁移有概念接口。
summary.technical_approach: 论文考虑一系列平滑变化、共享零损失解的过参数线性回归任务。设中间任务数为 N、每个任务训练时间为 s_N，证明当 N s_N 收敛到 τ 时，最终学习进展收敛到连续曲线；该曲线在小 τ 下为 Θ(τ)，大 τ 下为 Θ(τ^{-1})，由此推出最优 per-task 时间 s_N* = Θ(N^{-1})。
summary.experiments: 理论结论用逐渐旋转的 MNIST 和自然 Yearbook 时间漂移任务做一致性验证。实验表明，当路径被切得更细时，每个中间任务应减少训练时间。没有 LLM 规模实验，也没有预训练损失或 downstream LM 指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how much training time should be spent on each task in gradual adaptation as the number of intermediate tasks increases.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a scaling result for training-time allocation. Although derived for overparameterized linear regression and checked on small visual/time-shift tasks, the question is conceptually relevant to continual pretraining, curricula, and smooth domain transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis studies smoothly changing overparameterized linear regression tasks that share a zero-loss solution. With N tasks and per-task training time s_N, the final learning progress converges to a continuum curve when N s_N approaches τ. The limiting progress scales as Θ(τ) for small τ and Θ(τ^{-1}) for large τ, implying an optimal per-task schedule s_N* = Θ(N^{-1}).
summary_en.experiments: The empirical checks use gradually rotated MNIST and a natural Yearbook time-shift setting. The results are consistent with spending less training time per intermediate task as the adaptation path is divided more finely. There are no LLM-scale experiments or language-model pretraining metrics.

recommendation.zh: 可作 continual pretrain 日程的弱理论先验；只看定理主线和 MNIST/Yearbook 是否支持 Θ(1/N)。
recommendation.en: A weak theoretical prior for continual-pretraining schedules; read only the theorem path and whether MNIST/Yearbook really support the Θ(1/N) rule.

paper.title: ContinualSkillBench: Can LLM Agents Truly Evolve Their Capabilities?
paper.abstract: Modern agent frameworks equip large language models with external skill libraries to solve complex tasks. However, it remains unclear whether these systems can effectively evolve their skills and whether the resulting skills improve task-solving capabilities. To bridge this gap, we introduce ContinualSkillBench, a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers five representative domains, each containing 100 interconnected subtasks ordered by increasing difficult

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM agent多依赖外部技能库提升任务表现，但缺乏系统的评测框架来验证agent能否在连续任务交互中自主合成、演化可复用技能，也无法确认演化出的技能是否真正带来能力提升。现有agent评测多基于孤立任务和固定技能文档，无法捕捉持续技能学习的动态过程。
summary.importance: ContinualSkillBench明确了当前agent将交互经验沉淀为可迁移技能的能力边界，为面向agent的预训练、持续预训练研究中，评估模型的上下文内技能抽象与复用能力提供了标准化参照。
summary.technical_approach: ContinualSkillBench是面向上下文内持续技能学习的动态评测框架，覆盖医疗、法律、数学、金融、办公5个代表性领域，每个领域包含100个存在依赖关系的子任务，锚定3个核心技能，按难度递增和技能复用机会递增的顺序排列。评测对比三类agent设置：顺序执行模式（每完成一个子任务就用反馈更新技能库，后续任务可调用更新后的技能）、独立基线模式（每个任务从零开始执行）、上下文学习模式（不显式维护技能库，仅依赖之前的交互上下文）。评测指标包括归一化奖励，以及技能数量、复用率、质量等维度。
summary.experiments: 在15组模型-领域组合中，顺序执行模式有14组优于独立基线，整体相对提升16.9%，但提升幅度在不同模型和领域间差异较大。在3个领域的消融实验中，上下文学习的平均归一化奖励为0.605，显式技能维护为0.602，两者表现相当，说明大部分性能提升来自对先前上下文和反馈的适应，而非可复用的技能抽象；显式技能仅在需要可复用流程或精确输出的任务上有选择性优势。不同模型的技能库行为差异显著：GPT-4o在5个领域共积累384个技能，GPT-5.3-Codex为205个，但GPT-4o的技能复用率更低、质量得分更差。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读可重点看第2节的benchmark设计逻辑，包括任务分层、排序规则；以及第4节的核心实验结果，尤其是显式技能维护与上下文学习的对比消融。各领域的具体任务细节可跳过。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern LLM agents rely on external skill libraries to boost task performance, but there is no systematic evaluation framework to verify whether agents can autonomously synthesize and evolve reusable skills during sequential task interactions, nor whether evolved skills lead to genuine capability improvements. Existing agent evaluations are mostly built on isolated tasks and fixed skill documents, which cannot capture the dynamics of continual skill learning.
summary_en.importance: ContinualSkillBench clarifies the capability limits of current agents at consolidating interaction experience into transferable skills. It provides a standardized reference for evaluating in-context skill abstraction and reuse in research on agent-oriented pretraining and continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ContinualSkillBench is a dynamic evaluation framework for in-context continual skill learning. It covers 5 representative domains: healthcare, law, mathematics, finance, and office. Each domain contains 100 interdependent subtasks anchored to 3 core skills, ordered by increasing difficulty and increasing opportunities for skill reuse. The framework compares three agent setups: sequential execution (updating a skill repository with feedback after each subtask, with subsequent tasks accessing the updated repository), independent baseline (solving each task from scratch), and in-context learning (no explicit skill repository, only prior interaction context as reference). Evaluation metrics include normalized reward, plus skill count, reuse rate, and quality.
summary_en.experiments: Sequential execution outperforms the independent baseline in 14 of 15 model-domain pairs, with an aggregate relative gain of 16.9%, though the magnitude of gains varies widely across models and domains. Ablation across 3 domains shows in-context learning achieves an average normalized reward of 0.605, compared to 0.602 for explicit skill maintenance — the two are comparable on average, indicating most performance gains come from adaptation to prior context and feedback rather than reusable skill abstraction. Explicit skills only deliver selective advantages on tasks requiring reusable procedures or precise outputs. Skill repository behavior differs substantially across models: GPT-4o accumulates 384 skills across 5 domains, versus 205 for GPT-5.3-Codex, but GPT-4o's skills have lower reuse rates and worse quality scores.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on Section 2 for the benchmark design logic, including task tiering and ordering criteria, and Section 4 for core experimental results, especially the ablation comparing explicit skill maintenance and in-context learning. Detailed task specifications per domain can be skipped. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 看实验分解，尤其 ICL≈skill maintenance；这会校正对 agent 技能库“持续学习”的过强假设。
recommendation.en: Read the ablations, especially ICL ≈ skill maintenance; it usefully tempers claims about agent skill-library learning.

institutions: Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Peking University
Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence

paper.title: Taming the Implicit: Dual-Channel Risk-Aware Reinforcement Fine-Tuning for Continual Multimodal Post-Training
paper.abstract: Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is widely believed to inherently resist catastrophic forgetting in continual post-training of multimodal large language models. Under pronounced task distributional shifts, however, forgetting across representative RFT algorithms escalates sharply. This stems from the implicit reward-variance regularization inherent to RFT, which proves incapable of suppressing uncontrolled optimization risk. We propose Risk-Aware Policy Optimization (RAPO), the first dual-channel

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是多模态大模型在连续 RFT 后训练中仍会遗忘的问题，尤其是在任务分布变化很大时，标准 RFT 的隐式正则不足以稳定保留旧能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型预训练本身，而在 pretrain 与 posttrain 的接口。论文给出一个有用信号：RFT 并不天然解决持续学习中的能力保持问题，奖励驱动的更新也会在分布漂移下产生不可控的样本级优化风险。这个结论对 continual pretrain、mid-train、RL 后训练回流预训练 recipe 都有参考意义。贡献量级属于方法型增量，但问题设定和诊断比较清楚。
summary.technical_approach: 方法 RAPO 把连续 RFT 拆成两个风险控制通道。第一是 policy channel，即 Risk-Aware Policy Scaling。它为每个样本估计优化风险，再把风险转成 policy loss 的缩放系数，避免高风险样本对参数更新产生过大的影响。风险由两个量刻画：rollout reliability 衡量同一输入下多次 rollout 的优化信号是否一致；Fisher-inspired local predictive sensitivity 衡量当前策略输出分布对该信号的局部敏感性。第二是 data channel，即 Risk-Aware Dynamic Bucket Sampling。它根据样本风险动态调整 bucket 分配和 batch 组成，让训练分布随风险变化而变化。与常见持续学习方法不同，RAPO 不保存旧阶段样本，也不依赖旧任务统计量；它只用当前阶段数据估计风险并调节更新。
summary.experiments: 实验在 MLLM-CL benchmark 上进行，重点比较连续多模态后训练中的新任务获取和旧能力保持。论文报告 RAPO 相比 RLOO backbone 将 final forgetting 幅度降低 79.8%，同时在所比较的 RFT 方法中取得最高的 final retained performance，并保持较有竞争力的新任务学习能力。分析部分从两个角度解释遗忘：数据角度上，极端任务表征差异会暴露更脆弱的历史能力；优化角度上，不同训练阶段会明显重组 layer-wise gradient structure。消融显示 R-Scale 和 R-Sample 都有贡献，risk dynamics 分析说明 RAPO 会随训练阶段自适应调整 loss scaling 和 batch composition。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，确认作者如何证明 RFT 在强分布漂移下仍会遗忘。再看 Methodology 和 Figure 2，重点理解 rollout reliability、Fisher-inspired sensitivity、R-Scale、R-Sample 的定义和连接方式。实验部分重点看 final forgetting、final retained performance、R-Scale/R-Sample 消融，以及 task discrepancy 与 layer-wise gradient 的分析。若关心持续预训练，可以重点借鉴它的样本级风险度量，而不是直接复用完整算法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies catastrophic forgetting in continual reinforcement fine-tuning of multimodal LLMs, showing that standard RFT does not reliably preserve earlier capabilities under large task distribution shifts.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretraining research is the pretrain–posttrain interface. The paper makes a useful point: reward-based fine-tuning has some implicit retention effect, but this effect is not enough when the task stream changes sharply. Sample-level optimization risk still needs explicit control. This matters for continual pretraining, mid-training, and RL-heavy post-training pipelines where new capabilities are added without full retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: RAPO introduces two risk-control channels for continual RFT. The policy channel, Risk-Aware Policy Scaling, estimates a per-sample risk and converts it into a coefficient that scales the policy loss. The risk estimate combines rollout reliability, which measures whether multiple rollouts for the same input provide consistent optimization signals, and a Fisher-inspired local predictive sensitivity, which measures how sensitive the policy distribution is to that signal. The data channel, Risk-Aware Dynamic Bucket Sampling, uses the same risk estimate to reorganize training batches through dynamic bucket assignment. Unlike replay-based continual learning methods, RAPO does not store previous-stage samples or task-specific statistics; all control signals are computed from the current-stage data.
summary_en.experiments: On the MLLM-CL benchmark, RAPO reduces final forgetting by 79.8% relative to its RLOO backbone. It also achieves the strongest final retained performance among the compared RFT methods while keeping competitive acquisition of newly introduced tasks. The analysis links forgetting to two factors: large task representation discrepancies that make some old capabilities especially fragile, and substantial reorganization of layer-wise gradient structure across training stages. Ablations show that both R-Scale and R-Sample contribute, and the risk-dynamics plots indicate that RAPO changes both loss scaling and batch composition during training.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim read of 20–30 minutes is enough. Start with the Introduction and Figure 1 to understand why standard RFT fails under strong distribution shift. Then read the Methodology and Figure 2 for the definitions of rollout reliability, Fisher-inspired sensitivity, R-Scale, and R-Sample. In the experiments, focus on final forgetting, final retained performance, the ablations of the two channels, and the analyses of task discrepancy and layer-wise gradients. For continual pretraining work, the most reusable part is the sample-level risk measurement rather than the full RAPO pipeline.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫实验设置：若遗忘测量干净，它会削弱“RFT 自带抗遗忘”的 prior；先看任务切换和 risk proxy 是否可靠。
recommendation.en: Skim the experimental setup: if the forgetting measurement is clean, it weakens the prior that RFT is naturally anti-forgetting; check the task shifts and risk proxy first.

paper.title: Trajectory-Guided Forget-Recover Network for Continual LLM Unlearning
paper.abstract: Machine unlearning aims to eliminate the influence of sensitive data on a model. In the real world, unlearning requests arrive continually, which gives rise to two challenges. First, an unlearning intervention may redistribute target-related computation across remaining pathways, allowing previously forgotten knowledge to re-emerge. Second, repeated unlearning interventions may progressively reduce the model capacity needed to preserve retained utility. To address these challenges, we propose th

summary.core_problem: 解决持续LLM遗忘场景下，遗忘操作导致已消去知识复现、多次遗忘逐步损害模型保留效用的问题
summary.importance: 提出持续LLM遗忘的新方法，属于方法创新，通过通道级轨迹追踪平衡遗忘效果与模型能力保留
summary.technical_approach: 提出TFR-Net，追踪跨请求的通道级风险，分离持续目标相关通道与瞬态热点，仅抑制持续通道；同时再激活对保留效用贡献高、遗忘风险低的休眠通道恢复容量，仅当效用退化在容忍范围内时接受恢复
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验设置、模型规模与效果对比数据

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses two key challenges in continual LLM unlearning: re-emergence of previously forgotten knowledge after interventions, and progressive degradation of retained utility across repeated unlearning requests
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel continual unlearning method, contributing a channel-level trajectory tracking framework to balance unlearning efficacy and model capability preservation
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces TFR-Net, which tracks channel-level risk across unlearning requests, separates persistent target-related channels from transient hotspots to suppress only persistent ones, and reactivates dormant channels with high retained utility contribution and low forget risk to recover capacity, with recovery accepted only if utility degradation stays within predefined tolerance
summary_en.experiments: No specific experimental setup, model scale, or performance comparison data is provided in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 持续unlearning的通道级方法，对预训练数据隐私防护的后处理方案有参考，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Channel-level continual unlearning approach, useful as reference for post-hoc privacy protection of pretrained models; abstract suffices

paper.title: Quo Vadis, World Modeling?
paper.abstract: Continually improving agents require dynamic interaction feedback beyond static supervision, yet direct real-environment interaction is costly, slow, unsafe, and hard to parallelize. World modeling offers a natural intermediate proxy that allows agents to query lower-cost, more controllable feedback before committing to real actions. Classical world models instantiate this proxy primarily through future physical-state prediction, a formulation useful yet narrow for agents that require actionable

summary.core_problem: 讨论现有 world model 过度聚焦物理状态预测，难以为持续学习 agent 提供可执行、可验证、可复用的交互反馈。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是概念框架和问题重定义：把 world modeling 从“预测未来物理状态”扩展到“为 agent 提供可用信息转移的交互代理”。对通用 agent、RL 后训练、模拟环境和 verifier 设计有一定参考价值，但不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies 的概念，将世界模型按功能组织为若干类代理反馈源，例如执行结果、检索到的经验或技能、验证信号等。核心是 taxonomy 和设计空间梳理，而不是新的训练算法或模型架构。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看主要是概念性综述或立场论文，未体现明确模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或定量实验结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that conventional world models are too centered on physical state prediction and do not provide the actionable feedback needed by continually improving agents.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is mainly conceptual: it reframes world modeling as agent-usable information transitions rather than only future-state prediction. This is relevant to agent training loops, RL-style feedback, simulators, and verifiers, but it is not a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes the notion of Agent-Centric Interactive World Proxies and organizes the design space around functional feedback channels such as execution outcomes, retrieved experiences or skills, and verification signals. The main artifact is a taxonomy and framing rather than a new optimization or modeling method.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests a conceptual survey or position paper, with no clear model scale, training data, baselines, or quantitative results reported.

recommendation.zh: 适合作为 agent 反馈闭环的概念备查；预训练侧只需看 taxonomy，别期待可复现实验信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as a conceptual map for agent feedback loops; for pretraining work, skim the taxonomy and do not expect reproducible empirical signals.

paper.title: Learning What to Remember and What to Internalize in LLM Self-Evolution via Adaptive Memory-Parameter Coordination
paper.abstract: Large language model agents increasingly operate in dynamic environments where tool interfaces, APIs, and user requirements change after deployment. Existing self-evolution methods mainly follow two paradigms: harness-based approaches, which externalize feedback into editable memories or skills for rapid adaptation, and parameter-based approaches, which internalize experience into model parameters for deeper capability improvement. However, using either mechanism alone creates a trade-off betwee

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM智能体自进化方法分为两类：基于线束的外部记忆/技能方案（适配快、灵活性高但能力深度不足）和基于参数的微调/强化学习方案（能力内化深但成本高、适配慢）。单一范式存在灵活性与性能的固有权衡，且无法根据知识类型、学习阶段动态选择进化通道。
summary.importance: 明确了知识波动性是选择外部存储还是参数内化的核心判据，提出的双通道协调框架为部署后持续进化的智能体设计提供了可行思路，对研究持续预训练与外部记忆的结合机制也有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出COVE（通道编排的波动性感知进化）框架，包含三个核心机制：一是任务感知路由器，根据任务特征、执行反馈、失败信号，将每个任务分配到对应的进化通道（外部记忆或参数更新）；二是阶段感知调度器，监控性能平台期、数据充足度、冷启动失败三类信号，决定何时继续线束侧探索、何时启动参数训练；三是KnowledgePO双模态知识优化，线束侧记忆提升采样和数据收集质量，参数侧学习选择性内化稳定知识，同时通过反背诵信号防止易变知识被固化到模型参数中。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen3-8B模型，在Lean定理证明（MiniF2F）和动态接口表格问答（WikiTableQuestions）两个任务上验证。诊断实验发现：线束侧记忆积累在定理证明任务上的性能提升不足3%，即使单任务检索记忆数从2条增加到8条；参数学习方案在API接口改名后，调用正确率从96.5%下降到54%，说明易变知识不适合存入参数。COVE在两类任务上均优于单通道进化策略。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第2节两种进化范式的诊断对比实验（结论参考价值较高），以及第3节COVE的三个核心机制设计；实验验证部分可快速浏览。预计阅读时间20分钟左右。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent self-evolution methods fall into two paradigms: harness-based external memory/skill approaches (fast adaptation and high flexibility but limited capability depth) and parameter-based fine-tuning/RL approaches (deep internalization but high cost and slow adaptation). Relying on either single paradigm creates an inherent trade-off between flexibility and performance, and lacks dynamic channel selection based on knowledge type and learning stage.
summary_en.importance: Identifies knowledge volatility as the core criterion for deciding whether to store knowledge externally or internalize it into parameters. The proposed dual-channel coordination framework provides a feasible思路？不对，是feasible approach for designing post-deployment continuously evolving agents, and also offers insights for studying the combination of continual pretraining and external memory mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The COVE (Channel Orchestrated Volatility-aware Evolution) framework includes three core mechanisms: First, a Task-aware Router assigns each task to an evolution channel (external memory or parameter update) based on task characteristics, execution feedback, and failure signals. Second, a Stage-aware Scheduler monitors three signals — performance plateau, data sufficiency, and cold-start failure — to decide when to continue harness-side exploration and when to initiate parameter training. Third, KnowledgePO dual-modal knowledge optimization: harness-side memories improve rollout and data collection quality, while parameter-side learning selectively internalizes stable knowledge and uses anti-recitation signals to prevent volatile knowledge from being memorized into model parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on two tasks — Lean theorem proving (MiniF2F) and table QA with dynamic interfaces (WikiTableQuestions) — based on the Qwen3-8B model. Diagnostic experiments show: harness-side memory accumulation yields less than 3% improvement on theorem proving, even when the number of retrieved memories per task increases from 2 to 8; the parameter-based approach's API call accuracy drops from 96.5% to 54% after interface renaming, indicating volatile knowledge is unsuitable for parameter storage. COVE outperforms single-channel evolution strategies on both task types.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading. Focus on Section 2 for the diagnostic comparison between the two evolution paradigms (the empirical findings are particularly informative), and Section 3 for the three core mechanisms of COVE. The experiment validation section can be browsed quickly. Estimated reading time: ~20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 探讨Agent持续学习中记忆与参数更新的trade-off，对post-train阶段如何固化Agent能力有启发，可关注其路由机制设计。
recommendation.en: Explores the trade-off between memory and parameter updates in Agent continual learning, offering insights into solidifying Agent capabilities during post-training; the routing mechanism design is worth noting.

paper.title: When Unlearning Fails: Reliable Data Deletion under Post-Training in Agent Networks
paper.abstract: Self-improving federated agent networks keep training after deployment by collecting new trajectories with the current policy and feeding them back into later rounds. This closed loop makes unlearning harder than a one-time model repair. When a data owner requests deletion, the target data may have already shaped later retained trajectories, so retraining or model-side unlearning can leave an influence echo that returns as the network continues to operate. We show that this echo survives retaine

summary.core_problem: 自改进的联邦 agent 网络在部署后继续收集轨迹并训练，删除某个数据源时，目标数据的影响可能已经通过后续保留轨迹传播，导致常规 unlearning 失效。
summary.importance: 贡献是 post-training 闭环下的数据删除问题定义和方法，不是单次模型修补；对持续训练、agent 数据治理和训练信号污染有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MUTE，用轻量 server ledger 记录部署、采集和聚合过程，估计待删除数据对后续 retained trajectories 的下游影响；随后通过 forget-retain update 去除当前残留，并对高影响保留轨迹进行 quarantine 或降权，以阻断 influence echo 在后续训练中回流。
summary.experiments: 摘要声称 influence echo 能在 retained-data retraining 后存活，并随 forget-shaped retained data 数量增加而增强；未给出具体模型规模、agent 环境、任务数量或数值提升，需要看正文确认实验设置是否足够干净。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies data deletion in self-improving federated agent networks, where post-deployment trajectories collected by the current policy can carry forward the influence of data that later needs to be forgotten.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a post-training-loop formulation of unlearning, rather than a one-shot model repair problem. It is relevant to continual training, agent data governance, and contamination of training signals.
summary_en.technical_approach: MUTE uses a lightweight server ledger over deployment, collection, and aggregation records to estimate downstream influence from the data to be deleted. It removes current residue with a forget-retain update and quarantines or downweights high-influence retained trajectories to prevent the influence echo from re-entering later training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that the influence echo survives retained-data retraining and grows with the amount of forget-shaped retained data. It does not specify model sizes, environments, or quantitative gains; the cleanliness of the setup needs checking in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 概念比方法更值得看：post-train 闭环里的数据影响会转写到 retained trajectories，实验干净度需打折。
recommendation.en: The concept matters more than the method: post-training loops can rewrite deleted-data influence into retained trajectories, though the setup needs scrutiny.

paper.title: SkillSmith: Learning to Compose Parametric Skills and Textual Knowledge
paper.abstract: Agentic systems driven by large language models (LLMs) regularly feature two key mechanisms to autonomously solve complex problems: synthesizing text-based knowledge and procedures from past experiences and building parametric (weight-space) skill libraries for recurring sub-goals. To date, research has largely treated these as orthogonal pursuits: either organizing textual knowledge through composition and reflection, or consolidating parametric skills via weight-space merging. Consequently, th

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent 系统里“文本知识库”和“参数化技能库”彼此割裂的问题，让模型能联合利用文字经验与可组合的权重技能来完成新任务。
summary.importance: 贡献更像 agent/continual skill composition 范式探索，而不是基座预训练本身；但它把模型权重当作可被语言模型读取和推理的另一种模态，这个设定对未来统一表示、参数外化和技能库设计有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillSmith：用 prefix-tuning 作为参数化技能载体，把 prefix 权重与描述技能关系的文本一起喂给增强后的 LLM，让模型在推理时联合组合文本知识和 prefix 技能，面向目标能力进行 in-context 式技能合成与选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整数值细节，但核心实验应围绕复杂任务中对文本记忆、经验反思与 prefix 技能库的联合使用，比较仅文本方法、仅权重合并方法以及联合方法的性能差异。由于只看到摘要，尚无法确认模型规模、数据量和提升幅度，阅读时需重点核对实验是否 clean、是否真正优于简单检索或 prefix ensemble。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单包含 Adhiguna Kuncoro、Arthur Szlam、Zohar Yahav 等，具备较强研究背景；摘要中的机构字段异常，无法仅据当前信息可靠确认机构。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the split between textual knowledge stores and parametric skill libraries in agent systems, aiming to let a model jointly use both for new tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is more of an agent/continual skill-composition idea than a core pretraining paper, but the notion of treating model weights as another modality that an LM can read and reason over is conceptually interesting for unified representations and externalized skill libraries.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillSmith uses prefix-tuning as the carrier of parametric skills, then augments an LLM to ingest both prefix weights and textual descriptions of skill relations. The model composes textual knowledge and prefix skills at inference time to target new capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide full numerical details, but the key experiments likely compare text-only memory/reflection methods, weight-space skill methods, and the proposed joint approach on compositional agentic tasks. Since only the abstract is available, the main thing to verify is whether gains remain after controlling for simple retrieval or prefix ensembling baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Adhiguna Kuncoro, Arthur Szlam, and Zohar Yahav, suggesting a strong research pedigree; however, the institution field is malformed, so affiliations cannot be confirmed from the provided metadata alone.

recommendation.zh: 点子比结果更值得看：把 prefix 权重当可读模态这件事可能影响技能库设计，但先别上头，重点核对它是否真的优于简单检索+prefix 选择。
recommendation.en: The idea matters more than the headline result: treating prefix weights as a readable modality could matter for skill libraries, but first check whether it beats simple retrieval plus prefix selection.

paper.title: The Art of Not Forgetting A Local Learning Architecture for Continual Learning
paper.abstract: We introduce CMP (Cognitive Memory Primitive), a continual-learning architecture that repre?sents inputs as sparse relational codes, stores them in a two-tier competitive memory, and learns through local updates without end-to-end backpropagation through its feature-generating system. We investigate whether combining sparse representations, local learning, and persistent memory can reduce catastrophic forgetting relative to conventional backpropagation-based continual?learning approaches. On a c

summary.core_problem: 解决持续语言建模中的灾难性遗忘问题，探索无需端到端反向传播的局部学习架构。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出认知记忆原语（CMP）架构，结合稀疏表示、局部学习与持久记忆，降低端到端反向传播带来的遗忘。
summary.technical_approach: CMP将输入表示为稀疏关系码，存储在双层竞争记忆中，通过局部更新学习，无需对特征生成系统做端到端反向传播。
summary.experiments: 在域增量字节级语言建模协议上，参数量匹配的CMP比在线EWC训练的Transformer反向转移更低；15域三种子实验中遗忘行为更稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses catastrophic forgetting in continual language modeling by exploring a local learning architecture without end-to-end backpropagation.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing Cognitive Memory Primitive (CMP), an architecture combining sparse representations, local learning, and persistent memory to reduce forgetting from end-to-end backpropagation.
summary_en.technical_approach: CMP represents inputs as sparse relational codes, stores them in a two-tier competitive memory, and learns via local updates without end-to-end backpropagation through its feature-generating system.
summary_en.experiments: On a domain-incremental byte-level language modeling protocol, parameter-matched CMP exhibits lower backward transfer than a Transformer trained with online EWC; shows more stable forgetting across 15-domain three-seed experiments.

recommendation.zh: 非Transformer架构的持续语言建模探索，仅在小范围字节级任务上验证，作为持续学习的另类思路备查即可。
recommendation.en: Non-transformer continual learning approach for byte-level LM; only validated on small-scale tasks, useful as a reference for alternative CL paradigms.

paper.title: Progressive Multimodal Alignment for Continual Instruction Tuning
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) rely on a projector to align visual representations with the language embedding space, making it central to cross-modal understanding. In Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT), however, shifting visual distributions and evolving instruction semantics cause this shared projector to drift, leading to projector-level forgetting, an issue largely overlooked by methods that focus primarily on the LLM backbone. We introduce Progressive Multimodal Align

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型持续指令微调中，视觉分布和指令语义变化导致 projector 漂移，并进一步造成跨模态对齐遗忘的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 MLLM 后训练中的稳定性-可塑性方法，关注点从 LLM backbone 转向视觉-语言 projector。它对做多模态 continual tuning 和 mid-training 的团队有参考价值，但不是通用预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: Progressive Multimodal Alignment 先用轻量 representation descriptor 检测多模态分布漂移，只在需要时逐步扩展 projector experts。可扩展 router 根据多模态特征融合多个 expert 输出，同时保留原始预训练 projector 作为稳定对齐锚点，用来减少旧任务对齐被覆盖。
summary.experiments: 给定摘要未提供模型参数量、数据集、任务序列、baseline 或具体提升幅度。摘要声称该渐进机制在保持稳定性和可塑性之间取得平衡，并以次线性方式增加 projector 容量。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses projector drift and alignment forgetting during continual instruction tuning of multimodal large language models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a stability-plasticity method for MLLM post-training, shifting attention from the LLM backbone to the vision-language projector. It is relevant to teams doing multimodal continual tuning or mid-training, but it is not a general pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: Progressive Multimodal Alignment detects multimodal distribution shifts with a lightweight representation descriptor and expands projector experts only when needed. An expandable router combines expert outputs based on multimodal features, while the original pretrained projector is retained as a stable alignment anchor to reduce overwriting of prior alignments.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied abstract does not include model sizes, datasets, task sequences, baselines, or numerical gains. It claims that the progressive mechanism balances stability and plasticity while growing projector capacity sub-linearly.

recommendation.zh: 若在做 MLLM continual tuning，只看 projector drift 和 anchor 设计；对文本预训练无直接动作。
recommendation.en: If you run MLLM continual tuning, read the projector-drift and anchor design; it gives no direct action item for text pretraining.

paper.title: UniMem: Complementary Episodic-to-Parametric Memory for Boundary-Agnostic Task Streams
paper.abstract: Memory is essential for LLM agents to accumulate task experience and reuse task-specific execution strategies. However, real-world deployment over boundary-agnostic and evolving task streams exposes a fundamental stability-plasticity dilemma. External retrieval-based memory can rapidly absorb new evidence, but it often fails to internalize recurring execution patterns and incurs inference-time retrieval overhead. Parametric memory enables stable and efficient execution once learned, but typicall

summary.core_problem: 解决边界未知、持续变化的任务流中，LLM agent 记忆系统在快速适应新任务与稳定复用旧策略之间的稳定性-可塑性冲突。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 长期运行中的记忆管理问题，贡献类型偏方法设计与系统机制，而不是基座预训练本身。对 pretrain 研究员的价值主要在于“外部记忆与参数记忆如何分工”的接口启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UniMem，自路由地协调 episodic memory 与 parametric memory。核心做法是用可学习 routing tokens 作为记忆控制器：新颖或稀疏任务先写入 episodic buffer 供检索增强执行；重复出现的模式再逐步 consolidation 到参数记忆中，以减少推理时检索开销并提升稳定复用能力。
summary.experiments: 从摘要看，实验重点应是 boundary-agnostic task streams 下的持续任务表现、检索开销与长期稳定性对比，但当前给出的摘要被截断，缺少模型规模、数据集、baseline 和具体增益数字，暂时只能判断其验证场景偏 continual agent memory，而非 clean 的 pretraining setup。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the stability-plasticity trade-off in LLM agent memory under boundary-agnostic, evolving task streams, where agents must absorb new tasks without forgetting reusable execution patterns.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent memory-management paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining paper. Its value to pretraining researchers lies in the interface between external episodic memory and internal parametric memory.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniMem introduces a self-routing framework that coordinates episodic and parametric memory via learnable routing tokens. Novel or sparse tasks are stored in an episodic buffer for retrieval-augmented execution, while recurring patterns are gradually consolidated into model parameters for more efficient and stable reuse.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the evaluation likely focuses on continual task streams, retrieval overhead, and long-horizon stability. However, the provided abstract is truncated, so model sizes, datasets, baselines, and quantitative gains are not available; the setup appears more agent-centric than pretraining-centric.

recommendation.zh: 更像 agent memory 系统论文，不会直接改写 pretrain prior；若你在想 RAG memory 如何向参数记忆迁移，可只看路由与 consolidation 设计。
recommendation.en: This is more of an agent-memory systems paper than a pretraining one; read only if you care about how retrieval memory might consolidate into parametric memory.

paper.title: MIITA: Memory-Induced Inference-Time Adaptation for Continual Learning with Small Language Models
paper.abstract: Continual learning (CL) is essential for small language models (SLMs) to adapt to evolving real-world needs in resource-constrained deployments. However, directly updating their limited parameter space causes catastrophic forgetting. While memory-based methods naturally address this by decoupling knowledge retention from parameters, existing approaches designed for large language models (LLMs) rely on abundant storage and strong in-context reasoning that SLMs lack. To address these challenges, w

summary.core_problem: 在小语言模型的监督式 continual learning 中，避免直接更新参数导致的灾难性遗忘，同时控制存储和推理成本。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理时适配和外部记忆结合的后训练方法；它不直接改进预训练，但对低资源 continual adaptation、参数外知识保留和 memory-augmented LM 有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: MIITA 将监督经验存成 compact correction-direction prototypes，并附带 semantic anchors；推理时用语义相似度和不确定性信号检索相关 prototype，再通过 gated temporary hidden-state adaptation 临时改变中间表示。它避免 backbone 参数更新、prompt 扩展和 test-time backprop。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调面向 constrained-storage supervised continual learning，并与依赖大存储或强 ICL 的 LLM memory 方法区分；未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称、baseline 数量或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets supervised continual learning for small language models, aiming to avoid catastrophic forgetting under constrained storage.
summary_en.importance: It is a post-training and inference-time adaptation method rather than a pretraining contribution. The useful signal is the representation of past supervision as external correction directions instead of parameter updates or long prompts.
summary_en.technical_approach: MIITA stores supervised experiences as compact correction-direction prototypes with semantic anchors. At inference time, it retrieves prototypes using semantic and uncertainty cues, then applies them through gated temporary hidden-state adaptation. The backbone is not updated, prompts are not extended, and no test-time backpropagation is used.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames the experiments around constrained-storage supervised continual learning for SLMs and contrasts with memory methods designed for LLMs. It does not provide concrete model sizes, datasets, baseline counts, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图即可；correction-direction memory 有点意思，但若只在 SLM-CL 成立，外推到基座训练很弱。
recommendation.en: Skim the method figure; correction-direction memory is interesting, but evidence limited to SLM continual learning should not shift pretraining priors.

paper.title: MEUSLI: a Multilingual Projector for LLM-based ASR and Beyond
paper.abstract: Lightweight projectors are an established way to connect pre-trained speech encoders with large language models (LLMs), mapping acoustic features into token-level embeddings for tasks like ASR and spoken question answering. Existing systems, however, typically only support a few languages and are often limited to English. We introduce MEUSLI, the first open-science multilingual projector family that links a Whisper encoder with open-source multilingual LLMs, enabling fully open-source end-to-end

summary.core_problem: 如何用轻量projector把预训练语音编码器（Whisper）对接到开源多语LLM，实现多语ASR并可扩展到更多语言与任务？
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏工程/配方：开放的多语projector家族与训练流程；对“语音作为LM统一建模”的预训练范式启发有限，但对speech-to-LLM接口与continual learning有可借鉴细节。
summary.technical_approach: 训练一个轻量投影层将Whisper声学特征映射到LLM token级embedding空间；强调多语覆盖（28种欧洲语言）与用continual learning扩展到未见语言；并展示同一projector可迁移到语音翻译、主题识别等任务。
summary.experiments: 端到端开源ASR覆盖28种语言；包含高/低资源语言对比与少量每语言监督（“几小时”级别）迁移实验；摘要未给出具体WERR/CER数值与基线清单。

summary_en.core_problem: How to connect a pretrained speech encoder (Whisper) to open multilingual LLMs via a lightweight projector for multilingual ASR and easy extension to new languages/tasks?
summary_en.importance: Primarily an engineering/recipe contribution: an open multilingual projector family and training procedure; modest direct impact on pretraining paradigms, but useful for speech-to-LLM interfacing and continual learning details.
summary_en.technical_approach: Train a lightweight projector mapping Whisper acoustic features into token-level embeddings for an LLM; support 28 European languages and extend to unseen languages via continual learning; reuse the projector for speech translation and topic ID with few hours of supervision per language.
summary_en.experiments: Open-source end-to-end ASR for 28 languages; high/low-resource comparisons and few-hour-per-language adaptation; abstract does not provide concrete error rates or full baselines.

recommendation.zh: 不是“语音LM预训练”而是Whisper→LLM接口工程；只需看continual learning扩语种的做法，别期待统一tokenization或新目标函数。
recommendation.en: More Whisper→LLM plumbing than speech-LM pretraining; skim the continual-learning recipe for adding languages, don’t expect new tokenization or objectives.

institutions: Center for Augmented Intelligence, Fondazione Bruno Kessler, Trento

paper.title: Learning on the Job: Continual Learning from Deployment Feedback for Frozen-Weights Agents
paper.abstract: AI agents encounter learning opportunities in every episode they run, and discard nearly all of them: the underlying models are frozen at deployment, so an agent that resolves a difficult request today starts from zero when it recurs tomorrow. Yet ordinary operation already produces feedback, in the form of outcome verdicts and after-the-fact corrections. We show that this feedback is a sufficient signal for continual learning when the frozen model is paired with an external memory that distils

summary.core_problem: 部署后的 agent 往往冻结模型权重，单次任务中得到的结果判定和事后修正没有被转化为后续可复用的经验。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent continual learning 的系统方法。它不更新模型权重，而是用外部自然语言记忆吸收部署反馈；对长期运行 agent 的经验积累有参考意义，但与基座预训练关系较远。
summary.technical_approach: 方法将每个 episode 的 outcome verdict 或 after-the-fact correction 蒸馏成可检索的自然语言规则，存入外部 memory。下次遇到相似任务时，agent 检索这些规则辅助决策。对照组是 static RAG，即从完整政策语料中检索，而不是从历史 episode 中学习规则。
summary.experiments: 在 τ-bench 的 banking domain 上评测。相对 static-RAG control，使用一比特 outcome verdict 学习使 single-trial success 达到 baseline 的 1.6 倍；使用 corrections 学习达到 2.6 倍，并解决了 baseline 从未完成的 84 个任务中的 22 个。摘要提到覆盖 Mistral Large 和一个 open-weights model，但未给出完整模型与任务配置。

summary_en.core_problem: Deployed agents often keep model weights frozen, so outcome verdicts and post-hoc corrections from each episode are not converted into reusable experience.
summary_en.importance: This is a system method for continual learning in agents. It uses external natural-language memory rather than weight updates to absorb deployment feedback. The idea is relevant for long-running agents, but only weakly connected to base pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Each episode is distilled into retrievable natural-language rules using either a one-bit outcome verdict or after-the-fact corrections. Future episodes retrieve these rules as memory. The control is static RAG over the full policy corpus, rather than learning from previous episodes.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is on the banking domain of τ-bench. Against a static-RAG control, learning from one-bit outcome verdicts improves single-trial success to 1.6x the baseline; learning from corrections improves it to 2.6x and solves 22 of 84 tasks the baseline never solves. The abstract mentions Mistral Large and an open-weights model but does not provide the full model or task setup.

recommendation.zh: 看结果表就够；把反馈写成可检索规则很实用，但 banking setup 限制了泛化判断。
recommendation.en: The result table is enough; rule memory from feedback is practical, but the banking setup limits any generalization claim.

paper.title: SiGMA: Sign-Guided Merging and Adaptation for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
paper.abstract: Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning (MCIT) is crucial for adapting Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to evolving a sequence of downstream tasks. Prior methods mostly utilize Mixture of Experts or expansion merge approach, primarily focusing on catastrophic forgetting, yet they still suffer from negative interference during inference, where newly learned updates overwrite useful prior knowledge and degrade overall performance. To address this, we propose SiGMA (Sign Guided Merging and

summary.core_problem: 多模态持续指令调优中，新任务更新会覆盖旧知识，导致推理时负向干扰和灾难性遗忘。
summary.importance: 持续学习方向的方法改进，提出基于参数符号的调优与合并策略。
summary.technical_approach: SiGMA 包含两部分：训练时用符号引导的自适应调优减少与旧知识的参数冲突，推理时用符号引导的合并选择性放缩显著参数以保留任务特有知识。
summary.experiments: 在 UCIT 基准上测试，与 MoE 和 expansion merge 类方法对比，声明在遗忘和整体性能上更优，具体模型规模和提升幅度未在摘要中给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal continual instruction tuning suffers from negative interference at inference, where new task updates overwrite previously learned knowledge and cause catastrophic forgetting.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement in continual learning; proposes a sign-guided parameter tuning and merging strategy.
summary_en.technical_approach: SiGMA has two components: sign-guided adaptive tuning during training to reduce parameter collisions with past knowledge, and sign-guided merging at inference to selectively scale salient parameters and preserve task-specific knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the UCIT benchmark against MoE and expansion merge baselines; claims better forgetting resistance and overall performance, with model scale and exact gains not specified in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 持续指令调优的增量工作，参数符号引导思路与 TIES-Merging 同源，对预训练无直接价值，作为文献备查。
recommendation.en: Incremental continual instruction tuning work; sign-guided merging is related to TIES-Merging and has limited direct value for pretraining; keep as literature reference.

paper.title: Continual Video-MLLM Adaptation over Evolving Domains
paper.abstract: Video multimodal large language models have shown strong capability in video understanding, yet their adaptation to sequentially evolving domains remains underexplored. In real-world deployments, video data often arrives continuously from heterogeneous domains, requiring the model to acquire new domain-specific knowledge without overwriting previously learned capabilities. Existing continual learning methods typically rely on shared adaptation spaces, which can induce severe cross-domain interfe

summary.core_problem: 现有持续学习方法在视频多模态大模型顺序适配异质演化域时存在严重跨域干扰与灾难性遗忘问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出参数高效的域隔离专家路由框架解决Video-MLLM持续适配问题
summary.technical_approach: 提出Distribution-Aware Expert Routing（DAER）框架，冻结预训练Video-MLLM backbone，维护域隔离的轻量专家模块，引入域内分布感知路由机制实现细粒度域 specialization
summary.experiments: 在多个异质视频域的持续适配任务上验证了方法可有效缓解灾难性遗忘与跨域干扰，具体量化指标需参考正文实验部分

summary_en.core_problem: Existing continual learning methods suffer from severe cross-domain interference and catastrophic forgetting when sequentially adapting video multimodal LLMs to heterogeneous evolving domains
summary_en.importance: Method innovation, proposing a parameter-efficient domain-isolated expert routing framework for continual Video-MLLM adaptation
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose the DAER (Distribution-Aware Expert Routing) framework: freeze the pretrained Video-MLLM backbone, maintain domain-isolated lightweight expert modules, introduce intra-domain distribution-aware routing for fine-grained specialization
summary_en.experiments: Validated effective mitigation of catastrophic forgetting and cross-domain interference on multiple heterogeneous video domain continual adaptation tasks; refer to main text experiments for quantitative metrics

recommendation.zh: Video-MLLM持续适配的专家路由方法，域隔离轻量专家的思路对多模态持续预训练或MoE路由设计有弱参考，仅看§3方法节即可
recommendation.en: Expert routing method for continual Video-MLLM adaptation with domain-isolated lightweight experts; weak reference for multimodal continual pretraining or MoE routing design, check §3 only.

paper.title: Gate-Zero Growth: A Geometric Framework for Function-Preserving Continual Learning
paper.abstract: We introduce \emph{gate-zero growth}, a function-preserving (FP) operator for continual learning that adds new residual blocks through a zero-initialised gate. Under a transversality condition, gate-zero growth induces \emph{rank separation} in the functional Jacobian: old directions are unchanged, new-weight directions are exactly flat at the growth point, and new gate directions are the only first-order source of new functional variation. As gates open during continual learning, function drift

summary.core_problem: Transformer 持续学习中如何在新增残差块扩容时严格保持旧函数不变，并在后续训练中可控地偏离以最小化遗忘。
summary.importance: 提出一种 function-preserving 扩容算子 gate-zero growth，给出函数漂移和 Jacobian 泄漏的形式化界，为 continual pretrain / 扩容式训练提供了一个干净的几何框架。
summary.technical_approach: 新增残差块通过零初始化门控接入；在横截性条件下证明 rank separation：旧方向不变、新权重方向在增长点处严格平坦、仅新门控方向提供一阶函数变化；门打开时函数漂移为 O(||α||²)、Jacobian 泄漏为 O(||α||_∞)。
summary.experiments: 在 WikiText-103 → BookCorpus 上做 300M → 857M Transformer 扩容，gate-zero growth 在 Isolation 和 Freeze-Nothing 两种设置下旧域遗忘 Δ_A < 0.1，而非 FP 对照 G_stack 遗忘大一个数量级。

summary_en.core_problem: How to grow Transformers in continual learning by adding residual blocks while exactly preserving the old function, then controllably departing to minimize forgetting.
summary_en.importance: Proposes gate-zero growth, a function-preserving growth operator with formal bounds on function drift and Jacobian leakage, offering a clean geometric framework for continual pretraining and model expansion.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inserts new residual blocks via zero-initialized gates; proves rank separation under a transversality condition: old directions unchanged, new-weight directions exactly flat at the growth point, only new gate directions contribute first-order functional variation; as gates open, drift is O(||α||²) and Jacobian leakage O(||α||_∞).
summary_en.experiments: On WikiText-103 → BookCorpus, grows a 300M→857M Transformer; gate-zero growth achieves near-zero old-domain forgetting (Δ_A < 0.1) under both Isolation and Freeze-Nothing, while non-FP control G_stack shows an order-of-magnitude larger forgetting.

recommendation.zh: 持续扩容/continual pretrain 方向可备查，几何分析干净，但规模仅 300M→857M，结论能否外推到十亿级存疑。
recommendation.en: Useful reference for continual-pretrain/model-growth work; the geometric analysis is clean, but scale (300M→857M) is too small to trust extrapolation to billion-scale regimes.

paper.title: AlphaWiSE: Adaptive Weight Interpolation for Continual Multimodal Representation Learning
paper.abstract: Multimodal models such as CLIP learn a shared embedding space for cross-modal retrieval, but continual adaptation to sequentially arriving data can disrupt the cross-modal alignment acquired from earlier phases. Conventional continual-learning methods return a single checkpoint, which commits every retrieval direction to the same stability-plasticity trade-off. We propose AlphaWiSE, a post-hoc weight-space interpolation method that composes two frozen source checkpoints. For each aligned paramet

summary.core_problem: 解决 CLIP 类多模态表示在连续学习中适应新数据时，旧阶段跨模态对齐被破坏的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态持续学习方法。它不直接讨论 LLM 预训练，但 weight-space interpolation、稳定性-可塑性权衡、跨模态对齐保持，对 continual pretrain 和 checkpoint 合成有间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AlphaWiSE，一种后处理权重空间插值方法。它冻结两个源 checkpoint，对每个按 key 对齐的参数张量学习一个共享标量插值系数；系数在小规模 exemplar memory 上拟合，最终物化为一个同架构、同参数量的插值 checkpoint，不增加推理开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在 audio-image-text retrieval 的连续学习设置中，相比强 continual-learning baseline 取得一致改进；未给出模型规模、记忆库大小、数据集名称或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the loss of cross-modal alignment when CLIP-like multimodal representations are continually adapted to sequential data.
summary_en.importance: This is a continual multimodal representation-learning method. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but its weight-space interpolation setup is relevant to continual pretraining and checkpoint merging.
summary_en.technical_approach: AlphaWiSE performs post-hoc weight-space interpolation between two frozen source checkpoints. For each aligned parameter tensor, it learns one scalar interpolation coefficient on a small exemplar memory and materializes a single checkpoint with the same architecture and parameter count.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports consistent improvements over strong continual-learning baselines on audio-image-text retrieval. It does not provide model scale, dataset names, memory size, or exact gains.

recommendation.zh: 读方法就够了；逐张量标量插值是便宜的 checkpoint 合成基线，可放进 continual pretrain 消融。
recommendation.en: Read the method only; per-tensor scalar interpolation is a cheap checkpoint-merging baseline worth adding to continual-pretraining ablations.

paper.title: Do Agent Optimizers Compound? A Continual-Learning Evaluation on Terminal-Bench 2.0
paper.abstract: Most reported gains from agent-optimization methods are one-shot: an agent is optimized against a fixed benchmark and the resulting improvement is reported as if it were a stable property of the method. This does not test the setting that matters for deployed agents, where optimization is applied recursively as new failures and new tasks appear over time. The central question this raises is whether optimizer-driven gains compound: after an agent has been optimized once, can it be optimized again

summary.core_problem: 检验 agent optimizer 在持续到来的新任务上是否能“复利式”累积收益，而不是只在一次性静态 benchmark 上看起来有效。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测设定而不是新 agent 方法。它把 agent 优化从单阶段静态评测改成两阶段 continual-learning 评测，直接暴露现有优化器是否会遗忘旧收益。这对看 agent scaling、test-time optimization 和部署稳定性的人有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 基于 Terminal-Bench 2.0 构建两阶段 continual-learning evaluation，在相同优化预算下比较 GEPA、Meta Harness 和 RELAI-VCL 三类 agent-harness optimization 方法。重点不是提出新优化器，而是控制预算与任务到达顺序，观察第一轮优化后的收益在第二轮新任务到来后能否保留、迁移或被侵蚀。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明三种方法在传统单阶段静态设定下都优于 baseline agent，但在引入新任务后的持续学习设定中，收益不再稳定累积，部分方法出现旧任务收益回退或新旧任务兼顾失败。由于摘要未给出具体数值、agent backbone 和任务规模，当前更应把它当作评测协议信号，而不是结论终局。
summary.authors_note: 作者包含 Soheil Feizi。Feizi 在鲁棒性、评测与模型行为分析方面有较强辨识度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether gains from agent optimizers actually compound when new tasks arrive over time, instead of merely looking good in a one-shot static benchmark setting.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation protocol, not a new agent method. By turning agent optimization into a two-phase continual-learning test, it exposes whether current optimizers preserve earlier gains or simply overfit to a fixed benchmark. This is relevant for people tracking agent scaling, test-time optimization, and deployment stability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on Terminal-Bench 2.0, the paper introduces a two-phase continual-learning evaluation and compares GEPA, Meta Harness, and RELAI-VCL under matched optimization budgets. The point is not to invent another optimizer, but to control budget and task arrival so one can measure whether improvements from phase one survive phase two.
summary_en.experiments: According to the abstract, all three methods beat the baseline agent in the conventional single-phase static setting. Once new tasks are introduced, however, the gains do not reliably compound, and some methods appear to lose prior improvements or fail to balance old and new tasks. Since the abstract omits exact numbers, backbone details, and task counts, the result should be treated as a strong evaluation signal rather than a settled empirical law.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Soheil Feizi, who is well known for work on robustness, evaluation, and model behavior analysis.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是新 agent 算法，而是把“优化有效”这件事测得更干净；若你关心 test-time scaling 或 agent 训练闭环，只看设定和主表即可。
recommendation.en: Not a new agent algorithm, but a cleaner way to test whether optimization really sticks; if you care about test-time scaling or agent training loops, the setup and main table are the only parts worth reading.

paper.title: Local Redundancy: An Information-Theoretic Measure of Plasticity from Synthetic Memorization
paper.abstract: Plasticity -- a neural network's ability to adapt to new tasks -- is critical for continual and transfer learning. Existing measures, such as effective rank, dead neuron fraction, and weight norm, lack theoretical grounding and correlate poorly with performance on new tasks. We introduce local redundancy, an information-theoretic measure derived from universal compression theory. We define local redundancy as the worst-case redundancy of a local model family -- parameters in an infinitesimal nei

summary.core_problem: 现有神经网络可塑性度量（如有效秩、死神经元比例、权重范数）缺乏理论依据，与新任务性能相关性差，无法准确评估模型适应新任务的能力。
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，首次提出基于信息论的局部冗余度量作为可塑性的有理论支撑指标，并给出高效可计算的下界估计方法。
summary.technical_approach: 从通用压缩理论出发定义局部冗余（局部模型族沿梯度方向的最坏情况冗余），证明合成记忆任务上的期望平方梯度范数是其可计算下界，可用于预测迁移性能和预训练checkpoint选择。
summary.experiments: 在持续图像分类和时间序列迁移学习任务上验证，局部冗余比现有启发式度量更能准确预测下游性能，可用于预训练checkpoint筛选。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing neural network plasticity measures (e.g., effective rank, dead neuron fraction, weight norm) lack theoretical grounding and correlate poorly with performance on new tasks, failing to accurately assess a model's ability to adapt.
summary_en.importance: Analytical contribution proposing the first information-theoretic local redundancy measure as a principled plasticity metric, with an efficiently computable lower bound.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines local redundancy (worst-case redundancy of a local model family along gradient directions) from universal compression theory, proves that expected squared gradient norm on a synthetic memorization task is a computable lower bound, usable for transfer performance prediction and pretraining checkpoint selection.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on continual image classification and time series transfer learning tasks; local redundancy predicts downstream performance better than existing measures and enables pretraining checkpoint selection.

recommendation.zh: 可塑性度量思路对LLM持续预训练checkpoint筛选有参考，但未在LLM上验证，看摘要即可。
recommendation.en: Plasticity measurement idea has reference value for LLM continual pretraining checkpoint selection, but not validated on LLMs; read abstract only.

paper.title: Continual Learning with Elastic Regularization and Synthetic Replay for Federated MLLM Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Federated fine-tuning of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) across distributed networks enables privacy-sensitive adaptation to evolving data streams, yet a fundamental obstacle prevents robust deployment in dynamic environments: catastrophic forgetting, wherein sequential task updates erase previously acquired knowledge across visual, linguistic, and cross-modal representations. Addressing this challenge is especially critical for autonomous networked AI operating in safety-sensitive doma

summary.core_problem: 解决联邦环境下对 MLLM 进行连续微调时的灾难性遗忘问题，尤其是视觉、语言和跨模态模块在顺序任务更新中的知识保留。
summary.importance: 贡献是把 continual learning 的弹性正则和 synthetic replay 嵌入 federated MLLM fine-tuning。它不是基座预训练工作，但对 continual post-train、隐私场景模型更新和多模态模块级遗忘分析有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 FedCMM，在联邦优化环中加入三层保护。参数层使用 modality-aware elastic weight consolidation，分别为 vision encoder、language backbone 和 cross-modal projector 计算 Fisher information，并对重要参数施加弹性约束；摘要还提到 synthetic replay，用合成样本缓解旧任务遗忘。其思路主要是将已有 EWC/replay 迁移到 MLLM 联邦微调。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 MLLM 参数规模、任务集合、客户端数量、数据规模或数值提升。能确认的是实验目标为动态分布式数据流下的多模态连续微调，并关注旧任务保持和新任务适应的权衡。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses catastrophic forgetting during federated continual fine-tuning of MLLMs, especially retention across visual, language, and cross-modal modules under sequential task updates.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is the integration of elastic regularization and synthetic replay into federated MLLM fine-tuning. It is not base pretraining work, but it is mildly relevant to continual post-training, privacy-constrained updates, and module-wise forgetting in multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: FedCMM adds continual-learning safeguards inside the federated optimization loop. At the parameter level, modality-aware EWC computes separate Fisher information matrices for the vision encoder, language backbone, and cross-modal projector, constraining important parameters. The abstract also mentions synthetic replay to preserve prior task behavior. The method appears to adapt existing EWC and replay ideas to federated MLLM fine-tuning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide the MLLM scale, task suite, number of clients, dataset sizes, or quantitative gains. The evaluation is framed around dynamic distributed data streams and the trade-off between retaining prior tasks and adapting to new ones.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 continual post-train 备查；只看 Fisher 按模块拆分的设计，方法主体更像 EWC/replay 迁移。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a continual post-training reference; the only part worth checking is the module-wise Fisher design, since the core is mostly EWC/replay transfer.

paper.title: Interference and Retention in Continual Learning
paper.abstract: Continual learning commonly relies on post-hoc mechanisms such as replay, elastic regularization, or distillation. This work argues that forgetting should instead be modeled directly as interference between tasks. In the frozen-feature regime, forgetting from learning a new task is exactly the interference energy induced on the old task. In deep networks, the same quantity is recovered through path-averaged curvature with minimal additional forward passes.   When task supports are disjoint, forg

summary.core_problem: 把 continual learning 中的遗忘建模为任务之间的 interference，而不是只在训练后用 replay、正则或蒸馏补救。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析加方法设计。它对 continual pretraining、模型合并和参数隔离有间接参考价值，尤其是如何判断新数据或新任务会不会破坏已有能力。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 frozen-feature regime 下证明，新任务学习造成的旧任务遗忘等于旧任务上诱导出的 interference energy；在深度网络中，用 path-averaged curvature 近似恢复该量，只需少量额外 forward pass。基于此提出 IGFA：当任务方向一致时共享参数方向，冲突时保护方向，不依赖 replay 或 Fisher 信息。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 IGFA 在 continual learning benchmarks 上，当任务结构可分时实现 lossless retention；当任务支持重叠且方向冲突时，存在不可消除的 distortion floor。摘要未列出具体模型规模、数据集名称、baseline 列表或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The work models forgetting in continual learning as task interference, rather than treating it as something to be patched after training with replay, regularization, or distillation.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanism-analysis and method paper. It is indirectly relevant to continual pretraining, model merging, and parameter allocation because it gives a way to reason about whether new tasks or data will damage retained capabilities.
summary_en.technical_approach: In the frozen-feature regime, the paper shows that forgetting from a new task equals the interference energy induced on the old task. For deep networks, it estimates the same quantity through path-averaged curvature with few additional forward passes. The resulting IGFA method shares directions when tasks align and protects directions when they conflict, without replay or Fisher estimation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract states that IGFA achieves lossless retention on benchmarks when tasks are structurally separable, while conflicting overlap creates a non-zero distortion floor. It does not provide specific model sizes, dataset names, baselines, or numeric gains.

recommendation.zh: LLM 证据不足，但 interference energy 的形式值得记下；做 continual pretrain 时可借来设计冲突诊断。
recommendation.en: LLM evidence is missing, but the interference-energy framing is worth keeping for conflict diagnostics in continual pretraining.

paper.title: When Does Continual Learning Require Learning
paper.abstract: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly capable, the next question is how can we enable models to continually learn? Today, the field largely frames this as a problem of context management and mitigating forgetting. We argue this framing is incomplete: continual learning is fundamentally about increasing model competence as the world changes. We disentangle this change along two axes -- space, where the model encounters new domains, and time, where the underlying data drifts under a
