summary.core_problem: 当前LLM持续学习研究大多将问题框定为缓解灾难性遗忘，或完全依赖上下文管理、检索增强规避权重更新，缺少统一评测框架在接近真实部署的条件下公平对比提示优化、参数更新、上下文压缩等不同技术路线的方法，无法回答不同分布偏移场景下各方法的适用边界，以及什么时候必须通过模型更新实现持续学习。
summary.importance: 将持续学习的定义从“避免遗忘”修正为“在变化的环境中持续提升能力”，拆分出空间（新领域偏移）、时间（固定任务下的数据漂移，包含慢趋势适配、离散事实更新、智能体自驱状态累积三类子场景）两个维度的环境变化，为持续预训练、持续后训练研究提供了更贴近落地需求的评测基准。跨方法族的对比结论清晰给出了不同技术路线的取舍边界，可为部署方案选型提供直接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 首先形式化定义持续学习为环境变化过程中的模型能力提升，将环境变化拆解为两个轴：空间轴对应传统的领域/任务分布偏移，时间轴对应固定任务下的数据漂移，进一步拆分为慢趋势适应、离散事实更新、模型自身动作导致的智能体状态累积三类子场景。随后设计机制无关的统一顺序评测协议，将现有通用LLM基准改造为随时间逐步展开的任务序列，在相同的Qwen3-8B底座上，对4大类共8种方法（提示优化、离线有监督更新、在线RL、上下文压缩）开展公平对比，覆盖领域适配、智能体交互、金融时序分析、时间敏感知识更新四类任务。
summary.experiments: 核心跨方法对比结论：1）提示优化类方法（GEPA、ACE）对历史轨迹拟合速度快，向后传输准确率高，但在未来任务上性能急剧衰减，存在对历史轨迹的过拟合；2）蒸馏类方法（SDFT、SDPO）的知识累积过程更稳定，但无法快速融入新信息、校正过时知识；3）上下文压缩类方法（Cartridges、In-place TTT）主要提升内存使用效率，对新任务学习能力无实质增益；4）在线RL类方法（GRPO）在知识更新任务上表现最优，但对奖励信号的噪声与不稳定性高度敏感；5）在智能体状态累积场景下，基于提示的操作手册方法（ACE）和基于权重更新的SFT都可以累积交互经验，在所有交互链长度下均优于零样本基线，但绝对性能仍会随交互链长度增加而衰减。整体结论为：纯提示方法在大部分真实持续学习场景下能力不足，方法选择需要与目标场景的空间/时间偏移类型匹配。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对持续学习问题的维度拆分、结果部分的跨方法取舍总结，无需深入了解每个对比方法的实现细节，核心收获是不同偏移类型对应的最优方法族映射，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM continual learning research largely frames the problem as catastrophic forgetting mitigation, or avoids weight updates entirely via context management and retrieval augmentation. No unified evaluation framework enables fair comparison across prompt optimization, parametric update, and context compression approaches under realistic deployment conditions, leaving unclear the boundary conditions for each method and when actual model learning is strictly required.
summary_en.importance: This work reframes continual learning as competence gain in a changing environment rather than mere forgetting avoidance, and decomposes real-world shift into two axes: spatial (new domain/task shift) and temporal (fixed-task drift including slow trend adaptation, discrete fact updates, and agentic state accumulation from the model's own actions). This framing and associated benchmark provide a more deployment-relevant evaluation setup for continual pretraining and post-training research. The cross-method comparison results outline clear tradeoffs across technical approaches to support practical deployment decision-making.
summary_en.technical_approach: First formalize continual learning as improving model competence as the environment evolves, with change decomposed along two axes: space for classical domain/task distribution shift, and time for fixed-task drift, further split into slow trend adaptation, discrete fact update, and agentic state accumulation. Then design a mechanism-agnostic sequential evaluation protocol that adapts standard LLM benchmarks into temporally unfolding task sequences, enabling apples-to-apples comparison of 8 methods across 4 families (prompt optimization, offline supervised update, online RL, context compression) on a shared Qwen3-8B backbone, spanning domain adaptation, agentic web tasks, financial time series analysis, and time-stamped knowledge update tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Key cross-method findings: 1) Prompt optimization approaches (GEPA, ACE) fit quickly to past trajectories with strong backward accuracy, but suffer sharp degradation on future tasks due to overfitting to historical context; 2) Distillation-based methods (SDFT, SDPO) accumulate knowledge stably over time, but fail to rapidly incorporate new information or correct outdated beliefs; 3) Context compression approaches (Cartridges, In-place TTT) improve memory efficiency but deliver no substantial gain on new task learning; 4) Online RL methods (GRPO) achieve the best performance on knowledge update tasks, but are highly sensitive to reward noise and instability; 5) On agentic state accumulation tasks, both prompt-based playbooks (ACE) and weight-based SFT compound experience to outperform zero-shot baselines at all interaction chain lengths, though absolute performance still decays as chain length grows. The core takeaway is that prompt-only approaches are insufficient for most real-world continual learning regimes, and method selection should be matched to the specific type of temporal or spatial shift in the target deployment.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a framework and empirical comparison paper. Focus on the problem decomposition in the introduction and the cross-method tradeoff summary in the results section; there is no need to dive into implementation details of each compared method. The key high-value takeaway is the mapping between shift type and best-performing method family. Expected reading time is 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 持续学习的两轴拆解比常见遗忘视角更贴近持续预训练真实需求，重点读 §3 的评测协议设计与不同方法族的横向对比。
recommendation.en: The two-axis decomposition of continual learning is closer to real continual pretraining needs than the usual forgetting perspective; focus on §3 for the evaluation protocol and cross-family comparison.

paper.title: ReCoLoRA: Spectrum-Aware Recursive Consolidation for Continual LLM Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts a large language model to one task cheaply, but across a task sequence LoRA-style methods keep stacking low-rank updates on the same frozen weight, so each new task tends to overwrite the previous ones. We present ReCoLoRA (Recursive Consolidation of Low-Rank Adapters), a spectrum-aware framework for continual fine-tuning: adapters are initialized from a randomized SVD of the pretrained weight, per-layer effective ranks are selected by an elbow criterion, a

summary.core_problem: 解决 LoRA 类参数高效微调在连续任务序列中反复叠加低秩更新、导致旧任务能力被新任务覆盖的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练与 continual fine-tuning 方法改进。它不直接推进预训练目标或数据配比，但对长期维护一个基座模型的多轮适配、adapter 合并和能力遗忘有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReCoLoRA。方法先用预训练权重的随机 SVD 初始化 adapter，再用 elbow criterion 为每层选择有效秩；训练时先适配主子空间，再逐步开放残差容量。每个新任务开始前，它不回到原始预训练权重，而是对当前已吸收前序任务的 effective weight 重新分解，得到冻结残差、慢速更新主成分和新的 adapter。
summary.experiments: 在六任务 continual GLUE 序列上测试四个 7B-8B 级别 backbone。摘要称 ReCoLoRA 在四个 backbone 中有三个取得最高 final average score，并与常规 LoRA/continual PEFT 设定对比。摘要未给出完整数值和所有 baseline 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses catastrophic overwriting in sequential LoRA-style fine-tuning, where multiple low-rank updates are stacked on the same frozen base weight.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training and continual adaptation contribution rather than a pretraining method. It is relevant for maintaining long-lived foundation models through repeated task adaptation and adapter consolidation.
summary_en.technical_approach: ReCoLoRA initializes adapters from a randomized SVD of pretrained weights, selects per-layer effective ranks using an elbow criterion, adapts the principal subspace before opening residual capacity, and recursively re-decomposes the current effective weight before each new task into a frozen residual, a slowly updated principal component, and a fresh adapter.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on a six-task continual GLUE sequence across four 7B-8B backbones. The abstract reports the best final average score on three of the four backbones against continual PEFT baselines, but does not provide full numerical details.

recommendation.zh: 这是 continual PEFT 的干净小改法；看 adapter 重分解逻辑即可，不必按预训练方法读。
recommendation.en: A clean continual-PEFT tweak; read the recursive adapter decomposition, not as a pretraining recipe.

paper.title: UI-MOPD: Multi-Platform On-Policy Distillation for Continual GUI Agent Learning
paper.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal foundation models and agent systems have driven GUI agents from single-platform task execution toward cross-platform interaction. However, building multi-platform GUI agents remains challenging. On one hand, high-quality and executable cross-platform interaction trajectories are still scarce, and existing data often suffer from limited platform coverage. On the other hand, different platforms exhibit distinct interaction conventions, making joint or continual traini

summary.core_problem: 解决 GUI agent 在多平台持续学习中的两个难点：高质量跨平台交互轨迹稀缺，以及联合/持续训练时的平台行为混淆与灾难性遗忘。
summary.importance: 这是通用 agent 方向里相对像样的一篇，贡献在于把数据构建和 continual distillation 结合到 GUI agent。对预训练研究员的直接价值有限，但对“多环境 teacher routing + on-policy distillation”这类训练接口设计有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先构建 Uni-GUI 跨平台交互数据集，再提出 UI-MOPD：在持续学习框架中引入 multi-teacher on-policy distillation。系统根据当前环境动态选择平台特定 teacher，把平台行为先验蒸馏到共享 student，以减轻不同平台交互规范冲突带来的能力退化。核心不是单次离线 imitation，而是带环境条件的 on-policy 蒸馏与 continual adaptation。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、平台数量、数据量和提升幅度。可预期实验会比较 joint training、sequential finetuning、单 teacher distillation 等基线，并报告跨平台任务成功率、遗忘程度和持续学习稳定性。由于缺少细节，当前更适合把它当 agent training recipe 读，而不是能力结论来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华深研院、清华大学、小米、哈工大、浙大、鹏城实验室。属于国内较强的多模态/agent 组合团队，但不是基座预训练主线论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two bottlenecks in multi-platform GUI agents under continual learning: scarce high-quality executable trajectories and behavioral interference/forgetting across platforms.
summary_en.importance: This is a reasonably solid general-agent paper. Its value for pretraining researchers is indirect, but the combination of cross-platform data construction and environment-conditioned on-policy distillation is relevant to training-interface design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces Uni-GUI, a cross-platform GUI interaction dataset, and UI-MOPD, a continual-learning method with multi-teacher on-policy distillation. A platform-specific teacher is selected dynamically based on the current environment, and its behavioral prior is distilled into a shared student to reduce cross-platform interference. The key idea is not plain offline imitation, but environment-aware on-policy distillation under continual adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, number of platforms, dataset scale, or exact gains. The likely evaluation compares joint training, sequential finetuning, and simpler distillation baselines on task success, forgetting, and continual-learning stability across platforms. Given the missing details, it is better read as an agent-training recipe than as a definitive capability result.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Tsinghua SIGS, Tsinghua University, Xiaomi, HIT, Zhejiang University, and Peng Cheng Laboratory. It comes from a strong multimodal/agent ecosystem, though it is not a core pretraining paper.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，但“按环境切 teacher 做 on-policy 蒸馏”这个接口设计值得借；只看方法图和 continual ablation，别被 GUI 成绩带跑。
recommendation.en: Not deeply tied to pretraining, but the environment-conditioned teacher routing for on-policy distillation is worth stealing; read the method figure and continual-learning ablations, not the GUI scores.

institutions: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University

paper.title: Hidden Forgetting in Continual Multimodal Learning: When Accuracy Survives but Grounding Fails
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models must continually adapt to evolving tasks and domains, yet standard continual learning metrics mainly measure whether old answers remain correct, leaving the stability of multimodal grounding largely unexamined. We study this overlooked failure mode and ask whether a continually adapted MLLM can preserve not only what it answers, but also how it uses visual, textual, OCR, chart, and document evidence. We identify \emph{hidden evidence-use forgetting}, where answer

summary.core_problem: 现有多模态持续学习方法主要围绕答案准确率评估和缓解遗忘，但存在一种被答案指标掩盖的「隐藏遗忘」——模型在历史任务上的答案准确率保持稳定，但支撑答案的多模态证据使用模式发生漂移（如从依赖视觉接地证据转向依赖语言先验捷径），导致推理可靠性下降，而现有方法未覆盖这一维度的遗忘。
summary.importance: 揭示了多模态持续学习中此前被忽视的证据使用层面的遗忘，拓展了持续学习的评估维度，对需要高接地可靠性的多模态模型持续适配场景（如安全敏感应用）有参考价值，也为持续学习的约束设计提供了新的方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出无回放的依赖约束持续学习框架（RCL）。核心思路是将前一阶段的模型作为行为参考，通过反事实通道干预（逐一抑制视觉区域、OCR、图表元素等证据通道）估计两个模型的模态依赖剖面（即各通道对预测的贡献程度）；在适配新任务时，联合优化三项损失：当前任务损失、答案输出分布保留损失、证据依赖模式保留损失。框架仅更新参数高效的适配模块，推理时无额外开销。
summary.experiments: 在8阶段多模态任务流上的先导实验有三个核心发现：一是答案保留不代表证据使用保留，许多任务转换中答案准确率下降不足2%，但证据敏感度漂移幅度很大；二是顺序LoRA有14.4%的诊断切片处于隐藏漂移区，输出层蒸馏虽将平均准确率下降从2.72%降至1.57%，但隐藏漂移比例升至66.3%，在OCR、图表、文档类任务上尤为突出；三是提出的RCL框架可同时提升答案保留率和证据接地稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第1章隐藏遗忘的问题提出、第2章先导研究的实验发现，以及第3章的依赖约束损失设计，预计阅读时间25-35分钟。关注评估方法的读者可重点查看证据使用向量的构造和隐藏遗忘的度量指标。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing continual multimodal learning methods evaluate and mitigate forgetting primarily via answer accuracy, but overlook a form of "hidden forgetting": a model may retain correct answers on historical tasks while shifting its reliance across multimodal evidence channels (e.g., from grounded visual evidence to linguistic prior shortcuts), which degrades reasoning reliability without being detected by standard evaluation metrics.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies a previously underexplored dimension of forgetting in continual multimodal learning, expanding the evaluation scope of continual adaptation. It is relevant for MLLM deployment scenarios requiring high grounding reliability, such as safety-critical applications, and provides a new direction for designing constraints in continual learning pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed replay-free Reliance-Constrained Learning (RCL) framework uses the previous-stage model as a behavioral reference. It estimates modality reliance profiles for both the reference and current models via counterfactual channel interventions—selectively suppressing evidence channels such as visual regions, OCR tokens, or chart elements to measure their contribution to predictions. During adaptation to a new task, the framework jointly optimizes three losses: current task loss, answer output distribution preservation loss, and evidence reliance pattern preservation loss. Only parameter-efficient adaptation modules are updated, with no additional inference cost.
summary_en.experiments: Pilot experiments on an 8-stage multimodal task stream show three key findings: 1) Answer preservation does not guarantee evidence-use preservation, with many task transitions exhibiting large evidence-sensitivity drift despite less than 2% accuracy drop; 2) Sequential LoRA has 14.4% of diagnostic slices in the hidden drift region, while output-level distillation reduces average accuracy drop from 2.72% to 1.57% but increases hidden drift to 66.3%, most pronounced in OCR, chart, and document tasks; 3) The RCL framework improves both answer retention and evidence grounding stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on the introduction of hidden forgetting in Section 1, the pilot study findings in Section 2, and the reliance-constrained loss design in Section 3. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes. Readers interested in evaluation methods may also check the construction of evidence-use vectors and hidden forgetting metrics.

recommendation.zh: 发现了多模态持续学习的关键盲区——准确率不变但证据 grounding 漂移，反事实依赖估计的方法可直接迁移到预训练行为一致性评估，重点看§2的失效模式分析和§3.2的干预方法。
recommendation.en: Identifies a critical blind spot in multimodal continual learning (preserved accuracy but shifted evidence grounding); counterfactual reliance estimation can be directly adapted to pretraining behavior consistency evaluation, focus on §2 failure mode analysis and §3.2 intervention design.

paper.title: InduceKV: Fixed-Footprint Continual Adaptation of Multimodal LLMs via Inducing KV Memories
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models must adapt to evolving tasks and domains, yet continual improvement under bounded deployment footprint remains difficult because repeated parameter updates or growing replay stores can accumulate adaptation state over time. We study fixed-footprint continual adaptation: the deployed adaptation state is kept under a fixed memory budget, while the backbone model is left unchanged and task-specific updates are externalized. We propose InduceKV, a retrieval-based met

summary.core_problem: 多模态大模型在持续适配新任务与新领域时，现有方法难以同时满足「固定部署内存占用」的约束——参数更新类方法（如PEFT、专家路由）会不断增加模型状态、可能扰动预训练跨模态接口，回放类方法则受限于内存预算难以平衡历史能力保留与新任务学习。
summary.importance: 将多模态持续适配从「参数增量更新」问题重构为「预算约束下的外部记忆分配」问题，提供了完全冻结骨干网络、通过注意力原生KV记忆注入实现能力增量的技术路径，对需要严格控制部署后模型状态、避免扰动预训练基座的持续适配场景有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 冻结全部MLLM骨干参数，将任务增量知识编码为注意力兼容的外部KV记忆条目。每个条目包含两部分：一是固定表示空间中的单位范数检索键（由前缀最后一层隐状态池化得到），二是逐层KV载荷（通过固定平均池化矩阵将前缀KV压缩至统一长度m，保证所有记忆条目长度一致）。推理时通过余弦相似度检索相关记忆，将其KV载荷作为额外缓存令牌注入每层自注意力参与生成。记忆库构建采用双层优化：内层拟合轻量检索校准参数以适配当前任务，外层在固定记忆预算下选择条目，同时优化当前任务似然、历史锚点集的能力保留，以及检索空间中的冗余感知谱覆盖正则项以降低记忆冗余。
summary.experiments: 在持续指令调优、持续视觉问答等多种多模态持续学习场景下，性能优于现有基线方法。完整消融实验与量化结果需参考原文全文学术版本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注第1章中「固定内存占用（fixed footprint）」持续适配的问题定义、第2章的KV记忆构造方式与双层优化框架，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。关注部署效率的读者可查看推理时KV注入的开销分析相关章节。

summary_en.core_problem: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) require continual adaptation to new tasks and domains in production, but existing methods cannot satisfy a fixed deployment memory footprint constraint while preserving historical competencies and generalizability. Parameter-updating approaches (e.g., PEFT, expert routing) grow model state over time and risk disrupting the pretrained cross-modal interface, while replay-based methods struggle to balance retention and new task learning within tight memory budgets.
summary_en.importance: This work reframes continual MLLM adaptation as a budgeted external memory allocation problem rather than a parameter increment problem, providing a path for capacity expansion via attention-native KV memory injection without modifying the pretrained backbone. It is relevant for deployment scenarios requiring strict bounds on model state size and minimal perturbation to the base model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The entire MLLM backbone is frozen, and task-specific knowledge is stored as external, attention-compatible KV memory entries. Each entry has two components: a unit-norm retrieval key (pooled from final-layer prefix hidden states) in a fixed representation space, and layer-wise KV payloads compressed to a uniform length m via a static average pooling matrix to ensure consistent entry size. At inference, relevant memories are retrieved via cosine similarity and injected as additional cache tokens into each layer’s masked self-attention. The memory bank is built via bilevel optimization: an inner loop fits lightweight retrieval calibration parameters for the current task, while an outer loop selects a budgeted subset of entries to jointly optimize current-task likelihood, retention on historical anchor sets, and a redundancy-aware spectral coverage regularizer in the frozen retrieval space.
summary_en.experiments: The method outperforms existing baselines across multiple continual multimodal learning settings, including continual instruction tuning and continual VQA. Full ablation studies and detailed quantitative results are available in the full version of the work.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim read, focus on the problem definition of fixed-footprint continual adaptation in Section 1, and the KV memory construction + bilevel optimization framework in Section 2. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes. Readers interested in deployment efficiency may also check the section on inference overhead of KV injection.

recommendation.zh: 多模态LLM的固定内存持续适配方案，核心是KV记忆的检索式复用，可参考§3的双层选择策略设计，无需通读全文。
recommendation.en: Fixed-footprint continual adaptation for MLLMs via retrieval-augmented KV memories; focus on §3's bilevel selection design for parameter-efficient adaptation, skip full text.

paper.title: Episodic-to-Semantic Consolidation Without Identity Drift
paper.abstract: Long-running adaptive intelligent agents face a structural tension between knowledge consolidation and information integrity. Memory consolidation is conventionally treated as an agent-changing operation: a model is fine-tuned, a prompt rewritten, a policy distilled, or a reflection appended to the context that governs future behaviour. In regulated autonomic deployment this is a liability because the agent operates under commitments and audit contracts that bind to a specific, cryptographically

summary.core_problem: 解决长时自适应智能体在记忆整合过程中，因修改模型/提示/策略导致的身份漂移问题，避免违反受监管部署下的加密认证身份约束。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次提出将记忆整合与身份绑定清单解耦的形式化框架，证明身份不变性，为受监管Agent合规部署提供可行路径。
summary.technical_approach: 将记忆整合定义为从情景记忆到独立寻址语义记忆层的确定性函数，语义层不纳入身份哈希计算，不修改规划器或身份清单；通过结构引理证明身份在整合过程中保持不变。
summary.experiments: 未开展实证基准测试，核心工作为智能体表示的形式化定义与身份不变性的理论证明。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses identity drift in long-running adaptive agents caused by memory consolidation operations (fine-tuning, prompt edits, policy distillation) that violate cryptographically certified identity constraints in regulated deployments.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes the first formal framework decoupling memory consolidation from identity-bound manifests and proves identity invariance, enabling compliant autonomic agent deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Defines consolidation as a deterministic function mapping episodic memory to a separately addressable semantic knowledge layer excluded from identity hash computation, leaving the planner and identity manifest unmodified; proves invariance via a structural lemma on the manifest.
summary_en.experiments: No empirical benchmarks reported; work focuses on formal agent representation and proof of identity invariance through consolidation operations.

recommendation.zh: 属于受监管Agent的合规记忆设计，和预训练直接关联弱，仅作为持续学习身份漂移的类比参考，不用读正文。
recommendation.en: Focuses on regulated agent compliance and identity-preserving memory; weak direct relevance to LLM pretraining, only useful as analogy for continual learning drift mitigation.

paper.title: EVAF: A Test-Retest Protocol for Selective Parametric Consolidation
paper.abstract: Long-running language agents need mechanisms for deciding which experiences should persist after the working context is gone. Retrieval systems can reinsert past text, but they do not by themselves show that an experience has been selectively consolidated into the model's own behavior. We introduce EVAF, an Echo-Valence Attractor Field mechanism for gated LoRA consolidation, and a test-retest protocol for measuring selective parametric consolidation under controlled interference. Across GPT-2 an

summary.core_problem: 长时程交互的 agent 不仅需要“检索式记忆”（把过去内容取回来），还需要回答一个更难的问题：哪些经历应该被写入参数，形成持久的行为偏好/写作风格/人格特征，而不是永远停留在外部检索里？论文试图把“选择性参数巩固（selective parametric consolidation）”变成可测量、可证伪的机制问题，并提出一套 test-retest 协议来检测参数层面的持久印记是否真的发生、是否稳定。
summary.importance:
这篇更贴近持续学习与 posttrain→pretrain 反馈：它把“是否发生了参数写入”从主观叙事变成可重复测量的签名（parametric signatures），并强调跨尺度规律（不同模型规模下巩固门控的行为）。如果结论站得住，它对预训练研究的价值在于：
- 给 continual pretrain / online fine-tuning 一个更可控的目标：不是泛化提升，而是“哪些交互会改变模型”。
- 把 persona/偏好类更新与检索系统解耦，明确两者是不同时间尺度的组件（query-time vs cumulative）。
- 提供一种评估协议，避免把短期上下文效应误判为参数层面的长期改变。
但从给出的全文片段看，形式化与几何设定较重，是否能落到大规模、真实 agent 数据流上，还需要看后文实验与消融是否充分。
summary.technical_approach:
论文提出 EVAF（Echo-Valence Attractor Field）框架，借鉴互补学习系统（CLS）：快的工作记忆负责绑定近期经历，慢的参数存储只巩固“同时满足新奇度（surprise）与情绪/价值标记（valence）”的内容。
- 关键建模对象是 prefix hidden state s(t)，被视为快时标工作记忆，并施加几何约束：把每个 token 的隐藏向量近似看作落在高维薄壳/球面上的 product manifold（利用高维集中现象）。这类设定意图让“吸引子/回声（echo）”更可测。
- 选择性门控：用 surprise×valence 的双门决定哪些片段触发参数更新（可能通过参数高效更新如 LoRA/adapter 一类实现，文中也提到会复用 continual learning 的算法成分，如 replay、EWC-style anchors 等）。
- EVAF 的重点不是提出一个更强的检索记忆系统，而是提出一套机制证据：通过 test-retest 的方式，在不同时间点重复测量同一提示下的行为与内部表征，区分“上下文残留/检索注入”与“参数巩固”。
由于提供的内容在 §4 之后被截断，具体的门控公式、更新规则、以及“parametric signatures”如何计算，需要依赖论文后续章节才能完整确认。
summary.experiments:
片段中提到现有检索系统在 LongMemEval/LoCoMo 等 verbatim recall 上可达 90–99%，但这不是 EVAF 的目标。EVAF 声称会在 §4.10–§4.11 给出可测量的参数签名，并在 §6.3 讨论与检索的互补关系。
当前可见内容未给出具体实验数字（模型规模、数据流长度、巩固触发比例、遗忘曲线、对照基线提升幅度等）。如果全文实验部分提供了跨尺度规律与消融（去掉 valence 或 surprise 门、去掉 anchor/replay、不同 PEFT 配置），那将是判断其可信度的关键。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 45–60 分钟，偏理论）：
- 先读 Introduction：明确它区分 retrieval vs consolidation 的问题定义，以及它不以 recall benchmark 为目标。
- 精看 §4 与 §4.10–§4.11：这里应给出“parametric signatures / test-retest protocol”的操作化定义，是整篇能否落地的关键。
- 看 §6.3：理解它如何与检索系统分工，避免把 EVAF 当作 RAG 替代品。
- 阅读时重点问三个问题：
  1) 如何排除纯上下文效应，证明是参数写入？
  2) 选择性门控是否真的需要 valence×surprise，还是任意启发式都行？
  3) 跨模型规模是否出现稳定规律，能否指导 continual pretrain 的 recipe？

summary_en.core_problem: For long-horizon agentic LLMs, retrieval answers “what happened before?” at query time, but it does not answer which experiences should permanently change the model’s behavior via parameter updates. The paper targets selective parametric consolidation: defining when and how interaction fragments leave a persistent imprint (e.g., persona/style shifts) and proposing a falsifiable test–retest protocol to detect whether such parametric writes occurred and persisted.
summary_en.importance: This is closer to continual learning and the posttrain→pretrain interface than to classic pretraining recipes. The main value proposition is methodological: turning “did the model actually consolidate?” into measurable parametric signatures rather than narrative claims. If validated, it could help (1) design online/continual finetuning rules that control *which* interactions are allowed to change the model, (2) cleanly separate retrieval-time memory from cumulative behavioral drift, and (3) avoid confusing short-term context effects with long-term parameter changes. The risk is that the framework may be heavy on geometric formalism; the practical impact depends on whether the full paper demonstrates robust experiments and ablations on realistic streams and scales.
summary_en.technical_approach:
EVAF (Echo-Valence Attractor Field) is framed in the complementary learning systems (CLS) spirit: a fast working-memory state and a slow parametric store with selective consolidation.
- State geometry: the prefix hidden state s(t) is treated as fast working memory constrained to a per-token product manifold (motivated by high-dimensional thin-shell concentration). This is used to make “echo/attractor” effects more measurable.
- Dual-gate selectivity: consolidation is triggered by a combination of surprise (novelty) and valence (value/emotional tag), mirroring the CLS idea that only salient novel events shape the slow store.
- Algorithmic ingredients: the paper positions itself as reusing continual-learning components (e.g., replay, EWC-style anchoring, PEFT updates) but focusing on characterizing the consolidation decision and its signatures.
- Evaluation protocol: a test–retest setup intended to distinguish retrieval/context carryover from true parametric change by repeatedly probing behavior/representations over time.
The provided excerpt cuts off before the full formal definition of the signatures and the exact update rules; those details likely live in §4.10–§4.11 and later sections.
summary_en.experiments:
The excerpt notes that retrieval-based memory systems reach ~90–99% on verbatim recall benchmarks (LongMemEval, LoCoMo), but EVAF is not aiming to compete there. It claims measurable parametric signatures in §4.10–§4.11 and discusses complementarity with retrieval in §6.3.
No concrete experimental numbers are visible in the provided content (model sizes, stream lengths, consolidation rates, retention curves, gains vs baselines). The credibility hinges on whether the full paper includes strong ablations (removing valence or surprise gates, removing anchoring/replay, varying PEFT capacity) and cross-scale regularities.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (45–60 minutes, theory-leaning):
- Read the Introduction to lock in the retrieval vs consolidation distinction and the intended scope.
- Spend most time on §4 and especially §4.10–§4.11 where the parametric signatures and test–retest protocol should be operationalized.
- Read §6.3 to understand how EVAF is meant to coexist with retrieval systems rather than replace them.
- While reading, keep three checks: (1) how they rule out pure context effects, (2) whether valence×surprise is necessary or just one heuristic, and (3) whether they show stable scaling behavior that could inform continual pretraining recipes.

recommendation.zh: 探讨了 Agent 经验的参数化巩固（Continual Learning / LoRA 更新），对理解模型如何内化知识有启发，可关注其测试协议。
recommendation.en: Explores parametric consolidation of agent experiences (Continual Learning / LoRA updates), offering insights into how models internalize knowledge; the test protocol is worth noting.

paper.title: Continual Learning for Sequential Personalization of Small Language Models: A Stability Monitoring Analysis
paper.abstract: Small Language Models (SLMs) are increasingly being considered for deployment on edge devices such as laptops, enabling private, low-latency, and locally personalized applications. However, personalization requires models to adapt over time to evolving user- or task-specific data, placing them in a continual learning setting. This creates the risk of catastrophic forgetting, where learning new information degrades performance on previously learned tasks or broader model capabilities. Recent benc

summary.core_problem: 研究小语言模型在边缘设备上进行连续LoRA个性化时，如何监控灾难性遗忘和通用能力漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练/个性化场景的分析协议；它不直接推进预训练方法，但对continual post-train和用户侧适配的稳定性监控有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文采用顺序LoRA适配，每个适配阶段保存checkpoint，并同时评估当前任务、历史任务和固定reference set；用checkpoint-level轨迹观察任务收益、遗忘程度和参考集性能漂移。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明研究对象是SLM的连续LoRA个性化，并引用TRACE一类发现LLM持续微调会损伤通用能力的背景；未给出具体模型参数量、任务集合、基线或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to monitor catastrophic forgetting and general-capability drift during sequential LoRA personalization of small language models on edge devices.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an analysis protocol for post-training personalization. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is useful for thinking about continual adaptation and stability monitoring.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study performs sequential LoRA adaptation, saves checkpoints after each stage, and evaluates each checkpoint on the current task, previously seen tasks, and a fixed reference set to track forgetting and reference-set drift.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames the study around SLM personalization and references TRACE-style findings on continual fine-tuning degrading aligned LLM capabilities. It does not report concrete model sizes, baselines, or numeric results.

recommendation.zh: 当作continual SFT监控协议备查即可；真正有用的是checkpoint-level reference drift，而不是SLM个性化结论本身。
recommendation.en: Use it as a reference for continual SFT monitoring; the useful piece is checkpoint-level reference drift, not the SLM personalization result itself.

paper.title: From Weights to Features: SAE-Guided Activation Regularization for LLM Continual Learning
paper.abstract: Weight-space regularization methods such as Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) are the standard approach to catastrophic forgetting in continual learning. However, those methods tend to underperform when applied to large language models. We argue that such underperformance can be partly explained by the ``polysemantic'' nature of large language models: per-weight importance estimates utilized by EWC-style regularization are too coarse and cannot isolate the knowledge that needs protection. In th

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理 LLM 持续学习中的遗忘问题，重点指出 EWC 等权重空间正则在 LLM 上效果弱，原因可能不是单纯调参不足，而是权重和神经元过于多义，不能作为选择性保护知识的合适单位。
summary.importance: 对 continual pretrain 和部署后持续适配有一定参考价值。贡献不在于提出新的预训练目标，而在于把稳定性约束从 weight space 移到 SAE feature space。这个方向把 mechanistic interpretability 中的稀疏特征字典用于训练约束，给出一个更细粒度的知识保护坐标系。它也提示持续学习中的关键问题不只是正则强度，而是约束施加在哪个表示空间。对于不希望保存旧数据、旧 activation 或增加推理路由的场景，这类方法有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法使用预训练 Sparse Autoencoder 作为冻结的特征字典。SAE 将模型 dense activation 映射到稀疏、过完备的 feature 表示，这些 feature 通常比单个神经元或单个权重更接近语义选择性。每个任务的数据先经过模型和 SAE，估计哪些 SAE feature 与当前任务相关，并形成 relevance mask。高相关 feature 被视为需要适配的区域，低相关或需保护的 feature 被纳入稳定性约束。训练目标来自一个稳定性-可塑性的约束优化形式，而不是手工加入一个权重漂移惩罚。稳定性约束要求受保护 feature 的漂移不超过预算；可塑性约束要求任务相关 feature 发生足够适配，避免模型通过冻结一切来降低遗忘。拉格朗日松弛和 squared-hinge penalty 产生两个损失：protect loss 和 guide loss。EWC 可以看作这个框架的退化形式：它在权重空间度量漂移，并且没有显式可塑性约束。方法在 mask 构建后只保存紧凑的 SAE feature mask，不保留旧任务样本、旧 activation，也不引入推理期路由。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 TRACE-5000 和 MedCL，分别对应跨域和域内持续学习。结果显示，SAE-guided activation regularization 在 TRACE 上优于同设定下的权重空间正则、梯度投影和部分 replay baseline；在 MedCL 上，在不保存旧任务样本的方法中表现靠前。消融和机制分析强调两点：第一，SAE feature space 中的任务相关表示比 weight space 更容易分离；第二，EWC 的低遗忘往往来自过度压制可塑性，而不是精确保护旧知识。文中还与 SAE-FD 这类 anchor-based feature distillation 区分开来：后者依赖旧任务 anchor 或 activation matching，而该方法试图只用 feature mask 和当前任务数据完成正则。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读约 20–30 分钟。优先看方法部分的三块内容：SAE feature mask 如何构建，protect loss / guide loss 如何从约束优化推出，以及 EWC 为什么是特例。实验部分先看 TRACE-5000 和 MedCL 的主表，再看与 EWC、replay、gradient projection、SAE-FD 的对比。消融建议重点看正则强度、稳定性预算、可塑性预算、SAE feature 选择阈值和层位置。如果只关心预训练侧启发，可以重点读机制分析：它说明持续学习正则的有效性依赖表示坐标系，而不只是 penalty coefficient。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses catastrophic forgetting in LLM continual learning. Its central claim is that weight-space regularizers such as EWC are poorly matched to LLMs because individual weights participate in many entangled features. Protecting a weight is therefore a blunt intervention: it can preserve one concept while unnecessarily constraining unrelated ones.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to continual pretraining and post-deployment adaptation rather than initial base-model training. It proposes a different unit of preservation: SAE features instead of parameters. This is a useful bridge between mechanistic interpretability and training methodology. The main lesson is that continual-learning regularization depends on the coordinate system in which drift is measured. For settings where old data, stored activations, task-specific adapters, or inference-time routing are undesirable, feature-space constraints are a plausible design point.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses a pretrained sparse autoencoder as a frozen feature dictionary over model activations. Task data are encoded into sparse SAE features, and a relevance mask is constructed to identify which features are task-related. The training objective is derived from a constrained optimization view of stability and plasticity. Protected features should not drift beyond a stability budget, while task-relevant features should adapt enough to avoid the degenerate solution of preserving everything and learning little. A Lagrangian relaxation with squared-hinge penalties yields a protect loss and a guide loss. Under this formulation, EWC is a special case that measures drift in weight space and lacks an explicit plasticity constraint. After mask construction, the method keeps compact feature masks rather than previous-task examples, anchor activations, per-task parameters, or inference-time routers.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses TRACE-5000 and MedCL, covering cross-domain and within-domain continual learning. Under matched training conditions, the SAE-guided method outperforms weight-space regularizers, gradient-projection baselines, and several replay-style alternatives on TRACE. On MedCL, it is among the stronger methods that do not retain previous-task examples. The mechanistic analyses support the motivation: task-relevant structure is more separable in SAE feature space than in weight space, and EWC tends to reduce forgetting by suppressing plasticity broadly rather than by selectively preserving old knowledge. The comparison with SAE-FD is also important: SAE-FD relies on stored anchors or activations, while this method aims to operate with masks and current-task data.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the method sections on mask construction, the constrained optimization derivation, and the protect/guide losses. Then inspect the TRACE-5000 and MedCL main tables, followed by comparisons against EWC, replay, gradient projection, and SAE-FD. The most useful ablations are likely the SAE feature threshold, regularization budgets, coefficient sensitivity, and layer choice. For pretraining researchers, the mechanistic evidence is the key part: it argues that the representation space used for constraints can matter as much as the regularization strength.

recommendation.zh: 把SAE用到continual pretrain正则是有意思的方向，但目前看更像小模型概念验证，缺≥7B结果；关注loss推导，暂不据此改训练方案。
recommendation.en: Interesting SAE-based angle on continual-LM regularization, but reads as a small-model proof-of-concept without ≥7B evidence; read the loss derivation, don't change your recipe yet.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: LLM Evolution as an Industry-Scale Ecosystem: A Lifecycle Perspective on Continual Learning
paper.abstract: Continual learning capability is critical for Industrial LLMs, as deployed models must be continuously updated to meet evolving requirements and environments, rather than repeatedly retrained from scratch. However, most existing research focuses on improvements on static benchmarks, failing to capture real industrial needs. In this survey, we reformulate Industrial Continual Learning (ICL) for LLMs as a closed-loop update-and-release problem in a versioned ecosystem, where updates propagate hier

summary.core_problem: 讨论工业 LLM 如何在版本迭代、模型家族和下游应用组成的生态中持续学习，而不是每次需求变化都从头训练或只在静态 benchmark 上优化。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 survey 与问题框架。它把 Industrial Continual Learning 描述为 update-and-release 的闭环问题，关注可塑性下降、版本继承断裂和部署约束，对 continual pretrain 与 posttrain 接口有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 从生命周期视角组织技术图谱：模型版本更新会向行业模型、应用模型和 LLM-powered applications 层级传播；能力需要跨版本和跨模型家族继承。论文提出三类核心挑战，并用五个 lifecycle design principles 梳理已有方法。
summary.experiments: 作为综述，摘要未报告新模型训练、系统实验或定量 benchmark。主要输出是概念框架、挑战分类和工业持续学习技术路线整理。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey studies how industrial LLMs can continually learn within a versioned ecosystem of foundation models, application-specific models, and LLM-powered applications, rather than retraining from scratch or optimizing only static benchmarks.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey and framing contribution. It recasts Industrial Continual Learning as a closed-loop update-and-release problem, with issues such as plasticity erosion, broken capability inheritance, and deployment constraints. It is relevant to continual pretraining and the pretrain-posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper uses a lifecycle perspective: updates propagate hierarchically from foundation models to industrial models and applications, while capabilities must transfer across versions and model families. It identifies three core challenges and organizes existing techniques around five lifecycle design principles.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, the abstract does not report new model training, system experiments, or quantitative benchmarks. The main output is a conceptual framework, challenge taxonomy, and technical landscape for industrial continual learning.

recommendation.zh: 适合快速扫框架图；它的问题定义比方法更有用，可用于检查内部 continual-pretrain 发布链条。
recommendation.en: Skim the framework figure; the problem framing is more useful than the methods and can audit an internal continual-pretrain release pipeline.

paper.title: AgentOdyssey: Open-Ended Long-Horizon Text Game Generation for Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
paper.abstract: For agents to learn continuously from interaction with the world at test time, they must be able to explore effectively, acquire new world knowledge and skills, retain relevant episodic experiences, and plan over long horizons. To evaluate these key abilities of test-time continual learning agents, we introduce AgentOdyssey, a novel evaluation framework that procedurally generates open-ended text games with rich entities, world dynamics, and long-horizon tasks. Critically, AgentOdyssey goes beyo

summary.core_problem: 现有 agent benchmark 多数评估静态推理能力，难以研究模型在部署过程中通过交互、记忆和试错持续学习的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更接近评测基础设施，而不是预训练方法。对基座研究的价值在于，它把 test-time continual learning 拆成可诊断能力：探索、情景记忆、世界知识获取、技能学习和长程规划。这些能力与预训练和后训练的接口相关，尤其是记忆机制、上下文学习、工具使用、长期任务数据合成，以及是否需要参数更新的 test-time training。它不直接给出新的 LM objective，但能帮助判断现有 LLM agent 的瓶颈来自模型先验、上下文管理、记忆压缩，还是规划策略。
summary.technical_approach: AgentOdyssey 是一个可程序化生成开放式文字游戏的评测框架。环境被形式化为 POMDP，状态包含地点图、物体分布、NPC、时间和 agent 自身状态；agent 通过自然语言动作与环境交互，只能看到局部文本观察。生成端使用面向长程游戏的 ontology，定义地点、物体、NPC、action rules 和 step rules。action rules 描述 agent 动作的效果，step rules 描述环境自身动态，例如 NPC 行为。LLM 用于合成实体和规则，随后用程序合成进行验证和自动修复，以保证游戏系统可执行、任务可达、反馈一致。评测端不只看游戏进度，还包含世界知识、情景记忆、物体探索、动作探索、动作多样性和调用成本等诊断指标。
summary.experiments: 提供内容中没有完整实验表格和具体数字。可确认的是，作者评估了多类 agent 范式，并报告当前 agent 在长程、非重置环境中存在明显限制；影响有效任务跨度的因素包括探索效率、短期记忆组织、经验到语义知识的抽象，以及能否把早期经历用于后续规划。作者特别强调短期记忆在 agent test-time training 中的重要性，这一点符合长程环境的直觉：如果经验不能被稳定保留并压缩成决策相关信息，后续参数更新或检索增强都难以发挥作用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–40 分钟。优先看 AgentOdyssey 的 ontology、POMDP formalization、game verification/auto-fixing 机制，以及 metrics 设计。若只关心预训练接口，可跳过具体游戏示例，重点看评测维度如何映射到记忆、知识获取和技能学习。值得深挖的是生成环境的可控性：任务难度是否能随实体数、规则数、依赖链长度稳定扩展；自动验证是否能排除不可解任务；诊断指标是否能预测 agent 在真实长程任务中的失败模式。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a gap in agent evaluation: most benchmarks measure static inference, while real agents may need to learn continuously during deployment through interaction, memory, and trial-and-error.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an evaluation and environment-generation contribution, not a pretraining recipe. Its relevance to foundation-model research is that it decomposes test-time continual learning into concrete abilities: exploration, episodic memory, world-knowledge acquisition, skill learning, and long-horizon planning. These abilities sit at the interface between pretraining, post-training, memory systems, and test-time adaptation. The benchmark can help distinguish whether an agent fails because the base model lacks priors, because the memory system loses useful information, because the planner cannot manage long dependencies, or because test-time updates are poorly conditioned.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentOdyssey procedurally generates open-ended text games. The environment is modeled as a POMDP: the hidden state contains a graph of locations, objects, NPC instances, time, and agent state, while the agent receives partial textual observations and feedback after each natural-language action. The generation engine is built around an ontology for long-horizon games, covering entities such as locations, objects, and NPCs, plus rules such as action rules and step rules. Action rules define the effects of agent actions; step rules define autonomous environment dynamics, such as NPC behavior. LLMs synthesize entities and rules, and a program-synthesis-based verifier checks and repairs generated games so that the resulting environments are executable and internally consistent. The evaluation suite includes not only task progress but also diagnostic metrics for world knowledge, episodic memory, object and action exploration, action diversity, and model cost.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied text does not include full tables or numerical results. The visible claims are that the authors compare diverse agent paradigms and find clear limits in current agents under long-horizon, non-resettable settings. The reported bottlenecks include inefficient exploration, poor short-term memory organization, weak abstraction from episodes into reusable knowledge, and limited ability to use earlier experiences for later planning. The emphasis on short-term memory in test-time training is technically plausible: if recent experience is not preserved and compressed into decision-relevant state, retrieval-based learning and parametric test-time updates both lose useful signal.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–40 minutes. Read the ontology, POMDP formalization, game verification and auto-repair mechanism, and metric definitions. Readers focused on foundation-model training can skip many game examples and focus on how the benchmark operationalizes memory, knowledge acquisition, skill learning, and long-horizon planning. The key points to inspect are controllability and validity: whether difficulty scales cleanly with entity count, rule count, and dependency length; whether verification removes unsolvable games; and whether the diagnostic metrics predict failures in more realistic long-horizon agent tasks.

recommendation.zh: 读评测协议和诊断指标即可；它不是预训练方法，但 test-time continual learning 的任务假设值得纳入 agent eval 视野。
recommendation.en: Read the protocol and diagnostic metrics; it is not a pretraining method, but the test-time continual-learning assumption is worth tracking for agent evaluation.

paper.title: Fast and Slow Variational Continual Learning
paper.abstract: Continual learning remains a major challenge for modern deep networks, partly because commonly used optimizers lack inherent mechanisms for continual adaptation. One such natural mechanism is fast and slow adaptation to balance stability and plasticity. This mechanism has deep roots in neuroscience and biology, but there is no consensus on how to best incorporate it in commonly used optimizers. Here, we show that this can be easily done via the VCL framework, where past posteriors are used as pr

summary.core_problem: 将神经科学启发的快-慢适配机制（稳定性-可塑性平衡）嵌入通用优化器，解决深度网络持续学习的遗忘问题。
summary.importance: 基础优化器设计工作，在变分持续学习框架下提出与 Adam 成本相当的 CoVON 优化器，属于方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 在 VCL 框架中通过合并历史后验实现慢适配（抑制知识漂移），将合并后验作为先验用于 VCL 更新实现快权重更新，并无缝实现在 IVON 优化器中得到 CoVON，复杂度接近 Adam。
summary.experiments: 在持续学习任务上一致优于原 IVON 及基线，具体任务和提升幅度在摘要中截断。

summary_en.core_problem: Embed neuroscience-inspired fast-and-slow adaptation (stability-plasticity balance) into a general-purpose optimizer to mitigate catastrophic forgetting in deep network continual learning.
summary_en.importance: A fundamental optimizer design work proposing the CoVON optimizer under the variational continual learning framework, with computational cost comparable to Adam.
summary_en.technical_approach: Within the VCL framework, implement slow adaptation by merging past posteriors to slow knowledge drift, use the merged posterior as the prior in VCL updates to enable fast-weight adaptation, and integrate the steps seamlessly into the IVON optimizer to obtain Continual IVON (CoVON) with near-Adam complexity.
summary_en.experiments: Consistently outperforms the original IVON and baselines on continual learning tasks; specific tasks and full improvement magnitudes are truncated in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 持续学习场景的优化器设计，对 continuous pretrain 的优化器选型有弱参考价值，可只看优化器更新公式节。
recommendation.en: An optimizer design for continual learning, weakly informative for continuous pretraining optimizer selection; read only the update-rule section if interested.

paper.title: Can Scale Save Us From Plasticity Loss in Large Language Models?
paper.abstract: The loss of plasticity - the ability of a network to learn new information after having already learned older information - is a fundamental challenge in creating artificial neural networks capable of continual learning. Although this phenomenon has been known for decades, it has mostly been studied in older, relatively small architectures and rarely in natural-language domains. To determine whether loss of plasticity remains a problem in the modern transformer-based LLM paradigm, we study plast

summary.core_problem: 可塑性损失指模型经过长期训练后学习新信息的能力下降，该现象区别于灾难性遗忘，此前多在小模型、视觉任务或合成数据场景下验证，尚不清楚现代pre-LN结构的Decoder-only GPT模型在真实自然语言持续预训练场景下是否存在可塑性损失，以及单纯放大参数规模能否缓解该问题。
summary.importance: 该工作直接关联持续预训练、长周期训练动态的核心问题，给出了可塑性损失随模型规模缩放的定量规律，证明单纯靠参数缩放无法完全消除可塑性损失，为长训练周期的预训练流程设计、持续学习方案优化提供了实证参考，对预训练研究有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1）构建多语言持续预训练评测范式：模型按固定顺序循环学习不同语言的语料，每个语言分配固定训练token预算，以模型对训练序列中从未出现的越南语的next-token预测学习效率作为可塑性的量化探针；2）控制训练算力、数据配比、优化器配置完全一致，覆盖5M到314M非嵌入参数量的pre-LN GPT模型开展对照实验；3）同步追踪参数范数增长、休眠单元占比、注意力头坍缩/懒惰化等候选指标，寻找可塑性损失的关联诊断信号。
summary.experiments: 1）所有测试规模的模型均出现可观测的可塑性损失，模型规模越小，可塑性损失出现的训练步数越早；2）可塑性损失的发生步数与模型规模呈亚线性幂律关系，参数放大对可塑性损失的缓解效应存在边际递减，仅靠scaling无法完全消除该问题；3）即使在无突变任务切换的平稳多语言训练设定下，可塑性损失依然会出现，说明此前研究中常用的剧烈分布切换不是该现象的必要触发条件；4）参数范数增长、休眠单元比例上升、部分注意力头进入懒惰状态与可塑性损失存在相关性，但未找到可直接诊断、干预该问题的确定性因果指标。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注可塑性损失 onset 与模型规模的幂律关系、平稳数据下的损失现象两个核心结论，对诊断指标的相关性分析可快速浏览，预计阅读时间20分钟。注意该工作实验的模型规模上限为314M参数，结论能否外推到十亿/百亿参数级大模型仍需验证，但其提出的评测范式和观测到的缩放规律对持续预训练研究有直接参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: Plasticity loss, the degradation of a model's ability to learn new information after extended training (distinct from catastrophic forgetting of old knowledge), has primarily been studied on small models, vision tasks, and synthetic datasets. It remains unconfirmed whether the phenomenon affects modern pre-LN decoder-only Transformers trained on natural language, and whether scaling parameter count alone can mitigate plasticity loss in realistic LLM continual pretraining setups.
summary_en.importance: This work addresses a core problem in long-horizon pretraining dynamics and continual learning, quantifying how plasticity loss scales with model size and demonstrating that parameter scaling alone cannot eliminate the issue. The findings provide empirical grounding for long-run pretraining recipe design and continual learning optimization, with direct relevance to pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors design a multilingual continual pretraining evaluation protocol: models are trained on a cyclic sequence of languages with a fixed token budget per language, and learning efficiency on a held-out Vietnamese next-token prediction probe (never seen during the cyclic training sequence) is used as a quantitative measure of plasticity. Controlled experiments are run across pre-LN GPT models ranging from 5M to 314M non-embedding parameters, with matched training compute, data mixture, and optimizer settings. The authors also track candidate diagnostic correlates of plasticity loss, including parameter norm growth, dormant unit fraction, and collapsed/lazy attention heads.
summary_en.experiments: Key findings include: (1) All tested model sizes exhibit measurable plasticity loss, with smaller models showing earlier onset of degradation. (2) The training step at which plasticity loss emerges follows a sublinear power-law relationship with model size, meaning parameter scaling delivers diminishing returns for mitigation and cannot eliminate the effect entirely. (3) Plasticity loss occurs even under stationary multilingual training without abrupt task switches, showing that sharp distribution shifts, a common setup in prior plasticity research, are not a necessary trigger for the phenomenon. (4) Parameter norm growth, rising dormant unit counts, and lazy attention heads correlate with plasticity loss, but no single causal, actionable diagnostic signal was identified to directly counteract the effect.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the two core findings: the power-law scaling of plasticity onset with model size, and the presence of plasticity loss under stationary training conditions. The correlation analysis for diagnostic metrics can be skimmed. Allocate ~20 minutes for reading. Note that experiments cap at 314M parameters, so extrapolation to billion-parameter scale requires additional validation, but the evaluation protocol and observed trends are directly relevant to continual pretraining research.

recommendation.zh: 读 scaling 图和 probe 设计；它提醒 continual pretrain 不能把“大一点”当修复 plasticity 的方案。
recommendation.en: Read the scaling plot and probe design; it is a useful warning that “make it larger” is not a fix for plasticity in continual pretraining.

paper.title: Is Our Benchmark Enough? An Analysis of Continual Learning for MLLMs
paper.abstract: Continual adaptation is essential for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) deployed across evolving domains, but the state-of-the-art MR-LoRA method highly relies on the assumption that a MLLM-based router is necessary to process complex multimodal inputs. This paper revisits this claim on the MLLM-CL benchmark and argues for two claims. \textbf{First}, routing does not require an MLLM: a simple training-free, replay-free ptotypical routing method (\textsc{RePRo}), uses frozen pretrained fea

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文重新审视 MLLM-CL continual learning benchmark：MR-LoRA 的强性能是否真的来自 MLLM router 和共享专家设计，还是 benchmark 本身的任务过于容易区分。
summary.importance: 对预训练和持续学习研究的启发在于评测诊断。论文指出，当前 MLLM continual learning benchmark 可能主要测到了任务身份识别和专家隔离，而不是持续迁移能力。这个结论会影响后续 continual pretrain / continual SFT 的评测设计：如果任务在冻结表征空间里已经近似线性可分，那么复杂 router、共享专家、甚至部分遗忘指标都可能给出误导性结论。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 RePro，即 replay-free prototypical routing。每个任务训练一个隔离 LoRA expert。训练完成后，为每个任务采样 128 个 support examples，用冻结 CLIP vision encoder 提取 [CLS] 表征，计算 L2 归一化任务中心。推理时，对输入图像提取冻结视觉特征，与各任务 prototype 做 cosine similarity，选择最近任务对应的 LoRA expert。Multimodal-RePro 进一步从冻结 LLM backbone 的 instruction hidden states 得到文本 prototype，并用视觉相似度和文本相似度的最大值融合。这个方法没有可训练 router，也不需要 replay buffer。论文还系统测试 shared-expert MoE 类设计，发现共享专家没有带来收益；训练 loss 正常收敛，说明问题不主要是优化失败，而是 benchmark 缺少足够的可迁移共享结构。
summary.experiments: 在 DCL 设置下，RePro 的准确率为 67.85，接近 MR-LoRA 的 MLLM router 版本 68.01；Multimodal-RePro 达到 68.25。计算成本差距很大：MR-LoRA 的 MLLM router 每次决策约 1.3×10^13 FLOPs，延迟约 72 ms；RePro 约 4.1×10^4 FLOPs，延迟约 0.06 ms，FLOPs 低 8 个数量级，延迟低 3 个数量级。共享专家实验显示，多种参数化 routing / shared expert 方案均未超过隔离专家。论文把这些结果归因于 MLLM-CL 任务在预训练表征空间中高度可分，以及 benchmark 只使用单一 canonical task order，导致结论对 curriculum 敏感。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 15–25 分钟。先看 RePro 定义和 Table 1，确认它如何用 prototype routing 替代 MLLM router。再看附录或成本表中的 FLOPs / latency 对比，这是论文最清楚的工程信号。shared expert 部分可快速读，重点看负结果的解释：loss 收敛但性能不提升。最后看任务可分性可视化和 benchmark desiderata，那里对设计下一代 MLLM continual learning benchmark 更有用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether the MLLM-CL benchmark actually requires a multimodal LLM router and shared expert mechanisms, or whether it mostly rewards identifying which task an input belongs to.
summary_en.importance: The main value is benchmark diagnosis. The results suggest that current continual-learning evaluation for MLLMs may overestimate the need for heavy routing and underestimate the difficulty of measuring transfer. If tasks are already well separated in frozen pretrained feature spaces, isolated experts plus a cheap task classifier can look strong without demonstrating meaningful continual adaptation. This matters for continual pretraining and continual SFT, where benchmark structure can easily shape the perceived value of architectural choices.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes RePro, a replay-free prototypical router. After training one isolated LoRA expert per task, it samples 128 support examples for each task, extracts frozen CLIP visual features, normalizes them, and stores a task centroid. At inference time, the input is routed to the expert whose centroid has the highest cosine similarity. A multimodal variant also builds text prototypes from frozen LLM hidden states over the instruction and fuses visual and textual similarity scores. No trainable router and no replay buffer are needed. The paper also evaluates shared-expert MoE-style alternatives and finds that they do not improve performance over strict isolation, even though their training losses converge normally. This points to limited transferable structure in the benchmark rather than a simple optimization issue.
summary_en.experiments: On the DCL setting, RePro reaches 67.85 accuracy, essentially matching MR-LoRA with an MLLM router at 68.01. Multimodal-RePro slightly improves to 68.25. The cost difference is large: the MLLM router requires about 1.3×10^13 FLOPs and 72 ms per decision, while RePro uses about 4.1×10^4 FLOPs and 0.06 ms. The shared-expert experiments are negative across representative designs. The authors connect these results to two benchmark properties: task clusters are highly separable in pretrained representation space, and evaluation relies on a single canonical task order.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15–25 minutes. Read the RePro formulation and Table 1 first, then check the FLOPs and latency comparison. The shared-expert section is useful mainly for the negative result and its interpretation. The most relevant part for foundation-model researchers is the benchmark analysis: task separability, sensitivity to task order, and the proposed requirements for future continual MLLM benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 值得看实验设计和任务可分性分析；它提醒 continual MLLM 的 router 论文可能在 benchmark artifact 上赢。
recommendation.en: Read the setup and task-separability analysis; it is a useful warning that continual MLLM routing gains may be benchmark artifacts.

paper.title: Sparsity, Superposition, and Forgetting: A Mechanistic Study of Representation Retention in Continual Learning
paper.abstract: Continual learning (CL) systems often forget previously acquired knowledge, yet the mechanisms driving forgetting remain hard to isolate in practice because real datasets entangle many factors. We present a controlled, toy-world framework that makes these mechanisms observable and testable. Using a synthetic generator-separator pipeline, we define ground-truth latent features, build tasks with tunable sparsity and overlap, and introduce measurable quantities for representation strength and super

summary.core_problem: 在可控环境中分离并量化持续学习中的遗忘机制：稀疏性、特征叠加(superposition)与暴露历史如何共同决定表征保留。
summary.importance: 机制分析取向：把“遗忘/干扰”拆成可测量量并拟合动力学关系；对 continual pretrain / domain-adaptive pretrain 的干扰现象有间接启发，但仍是 toy-world 结论。
summary.technical_approach: 构造 synthetic generator-separator 流水线，显式定义 ground-truth latent features；通过可调稀疏度与任务重叠控制 superposition；定义 representation strength 与 directional overlap；用 SINDy 拟合 retention、superposition、exposure history 的稀疏动力学关系；用 effective rank 做任务级容量分配分析。
summary.experiments: 在合成任务序列上做受控实验，观察任务边界处 superposition 的瞬态变化、长期趋势与保留强度的关系；未涉及大模型/真实语料。

summary_en.core_problem: Isolate and quantify mechanisms of forgetting in continual learning via a controlled toy framework linking sparsity, superposition, and exposure history to representation retention.
summary_en.importance: Mechanistic analysis: turns forgetting/interference into measurable quantities and fits simple dynamics; indirectly relevant to continual/domain-adaptive pretraining, but conclusions are toy-regime.
summary_en.technical_approach: Synthetic generator-separator pipeline with ground-truth latent features; tasks with tunable sparsity/overlap; metrics for representation strength and directional overlap (superposition); SINDy-based sparse dynamical relations among retention, superposition, and exposure; effective-rank analysis for capacity allocation across tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled synthetic task sequences showing superposition trends and transient dips at task boundaries and their relation to retention; no large-scale models or real corpora.

recommendation.zh: 把“遗忘=干扰+容量分配”做成可测量 toy 动力学；只当概念工具看，重点扫指标定义与 SINDy 拟合那段。
recommendation.en: A clean toy mechanistic decomposition of forgetting into interference/capacity signals; treat it as a conceptual toolkit—skim the metric definitions and the SINDy dynamics fit.

paper.title: Catastrophic Forgetting is Low-Rank: A Function-Space Theory for Continual Adaptation
paper.abstract: Catastrophic forgetting in continual adaptation is usually studied through parameter drift, replay, or distillation, but these views do not identify which output-space directions are vulnerable. We give a function-space account in the NTK regime: new-task training induces old-task prediction drift through the cross-task kernel, yielding a closed-form predictor for the forgetting vector before any new-task gradient step. In frozen-backbone linear-head PEFT-CL, where the model is linear in the tra

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 continual adaptation 中的遗忘到底发生在输出空间的哪些方向，而不只是度量参数漂移或旧任务准确率下降。核心问题是：在新任务训练前，能否用可计算的函数空间量预测旧任务预测值会如何漂移。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 continual pretrain、instruction tuning 和 PEFT-CL 的诊断层面。论文把遗忘从参数空间问题改写为 NTK 诱导的函数空间干扰问题，给出一个可预测、可分解的视角。它的贡献不是提出一个新的通用抗遗忘算法，而是说明遗忘常集中在少数旧任务 NTK 特征模态上。这对设计 replay、正则化、adapter/LoRA 更新约束有直接启发：如果遗忘是低秩的，保护所有参数或所有输出方向都可能过宽，针对 vulnerable subspace 的方法可能更有效。
summary.technical_approach: 方法从两任务 continual regression 出发：模型先在 Task A 上得到参数 θ_A，再从 θ_A 出发训练 Task B。作者在 θ_A 处做 NTK 线性化，用 Task B 的残差 r_B 和任务间 kernel K_AB 推导旧任务预测漂移：Δf_A ≈ -K_AB (K_BB + λI)^-1 r_B。这里 K_AB 是 Task A probe 输入与 Task B 训练输入之间的跨任务 NTK，K_BB 是 Task B 自身 NTK。关键点是这些量都在 Task B 更新前、θ_A 处计算，因此可以预先预测遗忘方向和幅度。对于冻结 backbone、只训练共享线性 head 的 PEFT-CL 场景，模型对可训练参数是线性的，因此该预测近似退化为数值精度内的精确结果。对于 adapter、LoRA 或 full fine-tuning，它是局部 NTK 近似。论文进一步分析 K_AA 的特征分解，说明 Δf_A 落在 Im(J_A)=Im(K_AA) 中，并且能量集中在少数 eigenmodes。在线性 head 情况下，K_AA 还可写成输出维度与 feature Gram 的 Kronecker 结构，从而给出 vulnerable rank 约为 C × k_G 的缩放规律。
summary.experiments: 主要实验证明预测式在冻结 backbone + 线性 head 设置下几乎精确。Split-MNIST、Split-CIFAR-10 上，预测遗忘向量与真实遗忘向量的 cosine similarity 大于 0.99；在 ViT-B/16 和 DINOv2 等 transformer backbone 上，1 - cosine similarity 可低至 1e-6 量级；冻结 ResNet-18 上 cosine similarity 约为 0.994。谱分析显示，旧任务遗忘能量集中在很少的 Task-A NTK eigenmodes 中：在 Split-MNIST/CIFAR-10 上，1 到 6 个模态即可承载 50% 到 90% 的遗忘能量。论文还用 spectral regularization 作为验证工具，显示在共享 head benchmark 上有稳定收益，但作者明确把它定位为理论诊断的实证支持，而不是主要算法贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction 和 Theory 部分，重点看 Proposition 1 的推导，以及 Δf_A = -K_AB (K_BB + λI)^-1 r_B 这个式子如何连接新任务残差、跨任务 kernel 和旧任务漂移。然后看低秩结构与 Kronecker factorization 的段落，这是对 PEFT-CL 最有用的部分。实验部分优先看 Figure 1、Appendix C 中线性 head 精确性的验证，以及 eigenmode energy concentration 的图表。预计阅读 30 到 45 分钟即可把主线读完；如果要借鉴到 continual pretrain 或 LoRA 训练约束，需要细读附录中的 NTK 计算和 frozen-backbone 设定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks which output-space directions are vulnerable during continual adaptation. Instead of treating forgetting as parameter drift or a scalar drop in old-task performance, it tries to predict the actual old-task prediction shift before any new-task update is taken.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining-oriented work is diagnostic. Continual pretraining, instruction tuning, and PEFT-based maintenance all face forgetting, but many mitigation methods regularize parameters or replay data without identifying the function-space directions that drift. This work shows that, in a useful linearized regime, forgetting is often concentrated in a small number of NTK eigenmodes. That suggests a more selective design space for replay, distillation, and adapter constraints: protect the vulnerable function subspace rather than penalizing all parameter movement uniformly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis considers two-task continual regression. After training on Task A, the model is at θ_A; Task B training starts from this point. The model is linearized around θ_A, and the Task-A prediction shift induced by Task-B training is derived in closed form: Δf_A ≈ -K_AB (K_BB + λI)^-1 r_B. K_AB is the cross-task NTK between Task-A probe inputs and Task-B training inputs, K_BB is the Task-B NTK, and r_B is the Task-B residual evaluated at θ_A. The important operational detail is that all terms are computed before Task-B optimization. In frozen-backbone linear-head PEFT, the model is exactly linear in the trainable parameters, so the predictor is exact up to numerical precision. For LoRA, adapters, and full fine-tuning, it becomes a local NTK approximation. The paper then decomposes the shift in the eigenbasis of K_AA and shows that the forgetting vector lies in the image of the Task-A Jacobian. For a frozen backbone with a trainable shared linear head, K_AA admits a Kronecker structure, yielding an effective vulnerable rank on the order of C times the feature-Gram effective rank.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical results support the function-space predictor in the regimes where the assumptions are appropriate. On Split-MNIST and Split-CIFAR-10, the predicted and realized forgetting vectors have cosine similarity above 0.99. With frozen transformer backbones such as ViT-B/16 and DINOv2 under linear-head adaptation, the mismatch reaches float32-level precision, with 1 - cosine similarity around 1e-6 in the appendix. A frozen ResNet-18 case reports cosine similarity around 0.994. Spectral measurements show that forgetting energy is highly concentrated: on Split-MNIST/CIFAR-10, only 1 to 6 Task-A NTK eigenmodes account for roughly 50% to 90% of the energy. Spectral regularization is used as an instrument to validate the diagnosis and gives consistent gains on shared-head settings, but it is not positioned as the central contribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should focus on the derivation of Proposition 1 and the spectral interpretation that follows it. The key equation is the closed-form predictor involving K_AB, K_BB, and the Task-B residual. The most relevant experimental evidence is in Figure 1, the eigenmode concentration plots, and the appendix results for frozen ViT/DINOv2 linear heads. Budget around 30–45 minutes for the main argument. Readers interested in applying the idea to LoRA or continual pretraining should spend extra time on the assumptions behind the NTK linearization and the Kronecker factorization for shared linear heads.

recommendation.zh: 函数空间视角的低秩遗忘结论对持续预训练的PEFT设计有参考，重点看§3的NTK推导与遗忘秩的Kronecker缩放规则。
recommendation.en: The low-rank forgetting finding from the function-space view informs PEFT design for continual pretraining; focus on §3 NTK derivations and the Kronecker scaling rule.

paper.title: LatentGym: A Testbed For Cross-Task Experiential Learning With Controllable Latent Structure
paper.abstract: We envision continually learning agentic systems that become more useful over time: as they encounter sequences of related tasks, they should infer the hidden structure shared across those tasks and use it to improve future decisions. This cross-task experiential learning capability is pivotal in domains such as personalization and interactive assistance, but existing training/evaluation frameworks do not provide shared, controllable latent structures and cannot measure whether or why agents imp

summary.core_problem: 评测智能体是否能在一串相关任务中识别共享的隐变量，并把历史经验转化为后续决策收益。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent / continual learning 评测资产。它把“跨任务经验学习”拆成可控 latent structure、探索质量和利用质量，比只看最终成功率更适合诊断模型为什么没有真正适应。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 LatentGym，一组带有 ground-truth latent variable 的可控环境。每个环境的任务序列共享隐藏结构，系统记录 agent 的交互行为，并用专门指标区分 exploration：动作是否收集到关于 latent 的信息；exploitation：模型是否使用已收集的信息改进后续决策。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示作者用 LatentGym 研究 frontier models 在相关任务序列上的适应失败机制，但未给出具体模型清单、参数量、任务数量和提升幅度。实验重点不是训练新模型，而是用受控环境拆解失败来源。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates whether agents can infer shared latent structure across a sequence of related tasks and convert prior interactions into better future decisions.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an agent and continual-learning evaluation contribution. Its value is the controlled latent structure and the separation of exploration from exploitation, which is more diagnostic than reporting aggregate task success.
summary_en.technical_approach: LatentGym provides environments organized around a ground-truth latent variable. The suite measures whether an agent's actions acquire information about the latent variable and whether the agent later uses that information to improve decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports empirical studies on why frontier models fail to adapt across related tasks, but does not specify the model list, parameter scales, number of environments, or quantitative gains. The emphasis is diagnostic evaluation rather than training a new model.

recommendation.zh: 只看环境构造和 exploration/exploitation 指标；它不改预训练 recipe，但给 agent 记忆和在线适应评测一个更干净的 setup。
recommendation.en: Read the environment design and the exploration/exploitation metrics; it does not change pretraining recipes, but gives a cleaner setup for evaluating agent memory and online adaptation.

paper.title: Retrievable Gradients: Continual Post-Training Without Cumulative Weight Drift
paper.abstract: Continual post-training enables models to absorb emerging knowledge after deployment, but repeatedly updating shared parameters can accumulate weight drift, potentially causing catastrophic forgetting and degrading general capabilities. Retrieval-augmented generation avoids such parameter drift, yet often lacks the depth of parametric knowledge integration. In this paper, we propose ReGrad (Retrievable Gradients), a new paradigm that treats gradients as retrievable units of knowledge. ReGrad pre

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是持续后训练中的“知识更新”和“权重漂移”冲突。CPT 可以把新知识写入参数，但反复更新同一组共享参数会累积漂移，带来遗忘和通用能力下降。RAG 可以避免改参数，但新知识只通过上下文注入，不一定能像参数知识一样被模型使用。ReGrad 试图在两者之间找一个折中：把梯度当作可检索的参数化知识单元，在需要时临时写入模型，用完即丢弃。
summary.importance: 对预训练和持续学习研究的启发在于，它把“更新模型”从一次性修改全局权重，改成了检索式、局部化、可逆的参数适配。这个视角比普通 adapter/RAG 更接近训练动态本身：梯度不只是优化中间量，也可以被看作某个文档对参数空间的方向性约束。贡献主要是范式层面的，尤其适合思考 continual pretrain / post-train 的接口：新知识是否必须永久合并进基座参数，还是可以以可索引的参数增量形式存在。限制也比较明确：梯度存储、检索延迟、临时更新成本、梯度间干扰，以及安全回滚，都决定了它距离大规模在线服务还有工程门槛。
summary.technical_approach:
ReGrad 分两阶段。离线阶段，对每个文档计算文档特定梯度，并存入带索引的 Gradient Bank。在线阶段，对用户 query 检索相关梯度，只把这部分梯度临时应用到模型权重上，再进行生成；生成结束后丢弃临时权重，恢复基座模型。这样避免把所有文档的更新累积到一个共享参数状态里，也避免无关知识对当前 query 产生参数干扰。

关键设计不是简单缓存 next-token LM 梯度。原始语言建模梯度主要优化文档重构，容易学到表层 token 模式；下游知识使用需要回答问题、抽取隐含事实、对文档内容做推理。为此，ReGrad 引入 bi-level meta-learning：内层用文档诱导的梯度更新模型，外层用下游监督评价更新后的模型表现。这个目标会调整梯度的形成和应用方式，使临时适配更接近 query-driven 的知识使用，而不是复述文档。

它可以单独使用，不把检索文本放入上下文，只通过参数临时适配注入知识；也可以和 RAG 结合，同时提供文本证据和可检索梯度。这个组合很重要，因为文本上下文负责显式证据，梯度适配负责改变模型的参数状态，两者不是同一种信号。
summary.experiments: 给定正文显示实验覆盖通用场景和领域场景，包括法律与医学。主要结论有两点：第一，在 parameter-only 设置下，ReGrad 优于 continual post-training 和其他参数更新基线，说明文档梯度可以作为有效的可检索适配单元；第二，和 in-context RAG 结合后性能进一步提升，说明可检索梯度与文本检索提供互补信号。正文片段没有给出完整表格、参数规模、数据规模和具体提升数字，因此不宜补写精确数值。值得关注的消融应包括：原始 LM 梯度与 meta-learned 梯度的差异、检索 top-k 梯度数量、Gradient Bank 规模、只用梯度与梯度+文本的对比、对遗忘和通用能力保持的影响。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 CPT 和 RAG 取舍的定义，这部分给出了方法动机。然后重点看方法章节里的 Gradient Bank、在线临时权重适配、bi-level meta-learning 目标。实验部分优先看三类表格或图：ReGrad 与 CPT/RAG/参数编辑方法的主结果；raw LM gradients 与 meta-learned gradients 的消融；临时更新是否降低遗忘和权重漂移。若关注持续预训练，可以深挖它与 LoRA、adapter、parameter editing、episodic memory 的关系，尤其是梯度存储成本和服务时动态更新成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a concrete failure mode in continual post-training: newly acquired knowledge is written into the same shared weights, so repeated updates accumulate weight drift and can degrade general capabilities. RAG avoids this by keeping knowledge outside the model, but the knowledge is injected through context rather than through parameter-space adaptation. ReGrad proposes a middle ground: store document-induced gradients as retrievable knowledge units, apply only query-relevant gradients temporarily at inference time, and restore the base model after generation.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the reframing of gradients as reusable units of parametric memory. For continual pretraining and post-training, this changes the design space from permanent global weight updates to selective and reversible adaptation. It is especially relevant to researchers studying model updating, forgetting, and the pretrain–posttrain boundary. The idea is not just another RAG variant: it asks whether parametric knowledge can be externalized without losing the computational path of parameter adaptation. The practical risks are also clear: gradient-bank storage, retrieval quality, inference-time update overhead, gradient interference, and safe rollback all matter for scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ReGrad has an offline and an online phase. Offline, the system computes document-specific gradients and stores them in an indexed Gradient Bank. At inference time, a query retrieves relevant gradients. These gradients are temporarily applied to the model weights, the model generates an answer, and the adapted weights are discarded afterward. This avoids accumulating unrelated document updates into a single global parameter state.

A key point is that the method does not rely on raw next-token language-modeling gradients alone. Such gradients are optimized for reconstructing documents and may overfit surface token patterns. Downstream use requires question answering, factual extraction, and reasoning over document content. ReGrad therefore introduces a bi-level meta-learning objective: the inner step applies a document-induced gradient, while the outer objective evaluates the adapted model on downstream supervision. This trains the gradient construction and application process so that temporary adaptation improves task behavior rather than only document likelihood.

The method can be used without retrieved text, as a parameter-only adaptation mechanism. It can also be combined with in-context RAG, where retrieved documents provide textual evidence and retrieved gradients provide parameter-space adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The provided content reports experiments in both general and domain-specific settings, including law and medicine. In the parameter-only setting, ReGrad outperforms continual post-training and other parametric updating baselines. When combined with in-context retrieval, it further improves performance, suggesting that gradient retrieval and text retrieval carry complementary information. The supplied text does not include the full result tables, model sizes, data scales, or exact numerical gains, so precise numbers should not be inferred. The most important ablations to inspect are raw LM gradients versus meta-learned gradients, the number of retrieved gradients, gradient-bank scale, parameter-only versus gradient-plus-text settings, and retention of general capabilities.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the motivation section, where the CPT–RAG trade-off is laid out clearly. Then focus on the method details for the Gradient Bank, temporary weight adaptation, and the bi-level meta-learning objective. In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison against CPT/RAG/parametric update baselines, the ablation on raw versus meta-learned gradients, and any analysis of forgetting or weight drift. For pretraining researchers, the most useful follow-up question is how this compares with LoRA-style episodic adaptation, parameter editing, and retrieval-augmented memory under realistic serving constraints.

recommendation.zh: 点子是新的：把梯度当知识单元检索，值得看方法设定；但先别急着信效果，重点审 meta-objective 和在线适配开销是否真的比小步持续微调更干净。
recommendation.en: The idea is genuinely fresh—retrieve gradients as knowledge units—but read it for the setup, not the headline gains; the real question is whether the meta-objective and online adaptation cost beat cleaner continual-update baselines.

paper.title: When the Same Musical Knowledge Forgets Differently: A Clean Probe of Pathway-Dependent Forgetting
paper.abstract: A model can learn that the piano piece Für Elise is calm and reflective by listening to the audio or by reading a text description, but does it matter which route that knowledge took when it is later at risk of being forgotten? Forgetting research in multimodal models measures what knowledge is lost under adaptation, yet has not asked whether acquisition route affects how easily that knowledge is forgotten. We call this untested premise the Pathway-Invariant Assumption. Music understanding enabl

summary.core_problem: 在多模态模型中，同一知识通过不同模态（如音频或文本）习得后，在面临灾难性遗忘时，其遗忘程度是否与习得路径有关？
summary.importance: 首次提出了“路径依赖的遗忘”概念，挑战了多模态知识表征中隐含的“路径不变性假设”，对理解多模态预训练和持续学习机制有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 利用音乐理解任务（同一音乐片段和文本描述对应相同的感知内容）构建了一个干净的测试床。在多个不同架构的音频-语言模型上，对比了通过文本路径和音频路径习得的知识在相同适应压力下的遗忘情况。
summary.experiments: 在多个音频-语言模型上观察到一致的不对称性：在相同的适应压力下，文本路径的知识比匹配的音频路径知识更容易被遗忘。
summary.authors_note: 中科院信工所、国科大、西澳大学、北航合作。

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal models, when the same knowledge is acquired through different modalities (e.g., audio or text), does the degree of forgetting under catastrophic forgetting depend on the acquisition pathway?
summary_en.importance: Introduces the concept of 'pathway-dependent forgetting', challenging the implicit 'pathway-invariant assumption' in multimodal knowledge representation, providing insights into multimodal pretraining and continual learning mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Constructed a clean testbed using music understanding tasks (where the same music clip and text description correspond to identical perceptual content). Compared the forgetting of knowledge acquired via text and audio pathways under identical adaptation pressure across multiple audio-language models with distinct architectures.
summary_en.experiments: Observed a consistent asymmetry across multiple audio-language models: text-pathway knowledge is forgotten more than matched audio-pathway knowledge under identical adaptation pressure.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration among IIE CAS, UCAS, UWA, and Beihang University.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了多模态模型中“文本知识比音频知识更容易遗忘”的反常识现象，对设计多模态持续预训练（continual pretrain）的 data replay 策略有直接启发。
recommendation.en: Reveals the counter-intuitive phenomenon that 'text knowledge is more easily forgotten than audio knowledge' in multimodal models, offering direct insights for designing data replay strategies in multimodal continual pretraining.

paper.title: ECA: Efficient Continual Alignment for Open-Ended Image-to-Text Generation
paper.abstract: Incremental Learning (IL) for Open-ended Image-to-Text Generation (OpenITG) enables models to continuously generate accurate, contextually relevant text for new images while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Unlike prior studies, this paper addresses a more practical scenario in which the predominant category of visual data shifts over time as environments evolve. In this context, we introduce a new notion of continual alignment, which incrementally adapts the alignment module within pre

summary.core_problem: 解决开放式图像到文本生成中视觉类别分布随时间变化时，预训练 VLM 的跨模态对齐模块如何持续适配且不遗忘旧能力的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是 VLM continual alignment 的方法设计，关注不保留旧原始数据的增量学习场景。它和 native multimodal pretraining 有弱相关，但更偏 continual learning 和 VLM 适配，不是基座预训练主线。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Efficient Continual Alignment，将增量学习限制在预训练 VLM 的 alignment module。方法包含 Mixture of Query 模块来适配任务特定 query tokens，并结合 Fisher 信息相关的约束来减少对既有对齐表示的干扰；整体是 exemplar-free，不访问旧任务原始数据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体 VLM backbone、参数量、任务数量、数据规模、baseline 和数值提升；实验应围绕 Open-ended Image-to-Text Generation 的连续类别迁移和遗忘程度评估。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to continually adapt the alignment module of pretrained VLMs for open-ended image-to-text generation when the dominant visual categories shift over time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a continual alignment method for VLMs under an exemplar-free incremental learning setting. It is weakly relevant to native multimodal pretraining, but the main focus is adaptation and forgetting rather than base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Efficient Continual Alignment updates the alignment module inside pretrained VLMs. It uses a Mixture of Query module to adapt task-specific query tokens and Fisher-information-based constraints to reduce interference with previously learned cross-modal alignment, without storing raw data from prior tasks.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the VLM backbone, parameter scale, number of tasks, dataset size, baselines, or exact gains. The evaluation likely measures open-ended image-to-text generation under sequential category shifts and forgetting.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 VLM continual tuning 备查；若只关心基座训练，看 MoQ 和 Fisher 约束设计即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a VLM continual-tuning reference; for base-model work, only the MoQ and Fisher-constraint design is worth a quick look.

paper.title: FOGO: Forgetting-aware Orthogonalization Optimizer
paper.abstract: We argue that forgetting is not confined to continual learning but is a general optimization phenomenon: during standard training, dominant mini-batch gradients suppress rare but useful update directions, causing short-term forgetting at every step. When such knowledge is never revisited, these losses compound into long-term forgetting-the classical failure mode of continual learning. We introduce FOGO, a scalable optimizer that continuously detects and resolves gradient interference across both
