summary.core_problem: 解决 competitive programming agent 框架“每题都从零开始、无法积累经验”的问题，在不更新底层 LLM 权重的前提下实现持续学习。
summary.importance: 这是代码 agent 方向的系统性改进，贡献点在于把经验积累做成显式知识网络和闭环进化流程，而不是基座模型训练。对预训练研究员的价值有限，但可作为“非参数记忆替代权重更新”的案例参考。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Solvita，将求解流程拆成 Planner、Solver、Oracle、Hacker 四个专职 agent，形成策略选择、程序生成、认证监督、定向攻击的闭环。每个 agent 配一个可训练的图结构知识网络，把 pass/fail、测试质量、对抗漏洞等结果信号转成强化学习式更新，用外部知识结构而非模型权重承载经验。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、题库和提升幅度，但应在 competitive programming benchmark 上与静态多 agent、检索增强和单次求解 baselines 比较。关键看点不是绝对分数，而是跨任务累积后是否真有持续收益，以及 Hacker/Oracle 信号是否带来稳定改进。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学、清华大学等。工作更接近代码智能体系统设计，而非基础模型训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the statelessness of competitive-programming agents, aiming to accumulate experience across tasks without updating the underlying LLM weights.
summary_en.importance: This is a coding-agent systems paper. Its main contribution is explicit experience accumulation through graph-structured knowledge networks and a closed-loop evolution pipeline, not foundation-model training. For pretraining researchers, the value is limited but it is a useful example of non-parametric memory replacing weight updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: Solvita decomposes problem solving into four specialized agents—Planner, Solver, Oracle, and Hacker—forming a loop of strategy selection, code synthesis, certified supervision, and targeted hacking. Each agent is paired with a trainable graph-structured knowledge network, and outcome signals such as pass/fail, test quality, and adversarial vulnerabilities are converted into reinforcement-like updates to the external knowledge structure rather than the base model weights.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or gains, but the evaluation likely compares against static multi-agent systems, retrieval-based methods, and single-shot coding baselines on competitive programming benchmarks. The key question is not absolute score but whether cross-task accumulation yields durable gains and whether the Oracle/Hacker signals improve robustness.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Nanjing University, Tsinghua University, and others. The work is much closer to coding-agent system design than to foundation-model training.

recommendation.zh: 这是把“经验写进外部图记忆”而不是权重里的代码 agent 方案；对 pretrain 不是主线，只需看系统闭环和失败信号设计，别把分数提升当成可迁移结论。
recommendation.en: This is a coding-agent design that stores experience in external graph memory instead of weights; not core pretraining material—just inspect the loop and feedback signals, and ignore headline gains.

paper.title: Early Data Exposure Improves Robustness to Subsequent Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: How can we train models whose post-trained capabilities survive subsequent fine-tuning? Rather than focusing on downstream interventions to mitigate forgetting of upstream capabilities, we study how upstream training choices - that is, the manner in which a capability is acquired - shape how robustly that capability is retained. We investigate this question in a controlled three-stage language-model pipeline: pretraining, post-training to acquire a target capability, and downstream fine-tuning o

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 pretrain、post-train 和下游 fine-tune 之间的耐久性问题：一个能力在 post-training 后表现相同，不代表它在后续 fine-tuning 后能同样保留。作者关心的是，上游训练阶段如何让能力更不容易被后续适配破坏。
summary.importance: 这篇值得精读，因为它把灾难性遗忘从“下游 fine-tune 阶段的补救问题”前移到了“上游训练配方的设计问题”。具体贡献不是提出复杂算法，而是给出一个清晰且可操作的信号：把少量未来 post-training 数据提前混入 pretraining，可以改善后续 fine-tuning 后的能力保留。这个结果对持续预训练、mid-training 数据编排、领域能力注入和安全能力保留都有直接参考意义。贡献量级属于机制和训练流程层面的实证发现；实验规模到 135M 和 1B，尚不是生产级大模型规模，但控制变量较干净，结论可迁移性值得继续验证。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构造了一个三阶段管线：先在通用语料 D_pre 上预训练，再在较小的目标语料 D_post 上 post-train 获得目标能力，最后由下游用户在新目标 D_ft 上做监督 fine-tuning。核心干预很简单：在第一阶段预训练时，提前混入一部分最终会用于 post-training 的 D_post 数据。评估时不只看 post-training 刚结束时的目标域 loss，而是固定下游 fine-tuning 方法并扫描学习率，画出下游性能、post-training 能力保留和通用预训练分布性能之间的 tradeoff frontier。这个设计很关键，因为同样的即时 post-training loss 可能对应完全不同的后续保留能力。作者还做了 compute-matched 分配实验，比较把稀缺目标数据全部放在 pretraining、全部放在 post-training，或分配在两个阶段。结果显示最优点通常在中间，而不是任一极端。理论解释是，早期暴露让目标能力更容易进入较专门、较稳定的特征子空间，后续 fine-tuning 对这些特征的干扰更小。作者还把 replay 和 dropout 放在同一视角下考察：replay 通过交错旧数据减小新目标更新的覆盖，dropout 通过减少特征共适应提升表示稳健性；二者与早期数据混入有互补性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 135M 和 1B 参数模型、两个 post-training 领域和两个下游 fine-tuning 任务。主要结果有四点。第一，post-training 结束后的即时能力不是可靠预测指标；若只看 D_post 上的当前性能，不同训练配方可能看起来接近，但后续 fine-tuning 后 retention 差异明显。第二，早期混入 D_post 数据能改善 retention 与下游 fine-tuning loss 的前沿，在若干设置中即使即时 post-training 指标变化很小，后续保留也更好。第三，在固定目标数据或计算预算的分配实验中，把全部目标数据放在早期或晚期都不是最佳，早期暴露加后期强化的组合更稳。第四，replay 和 dropout 都能进一步改善 tradeoff frontier，并且不是简单替代早期混入。文中给出的数字级信息包括模型规模 135M/1B、三阶段数据设置、多个学习率扫描和多任务组合；由于提供内容未包含完整结果表，具体 loss 改善幅度不宜臆测。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction、Preliminaries、Section 4 和 Section 5。Figure 1 用来把三阶段问题定义读清楚；Table 1 需要看实验设置是否覆盖自己关心的 post-train 和 fine-tune 场景；Figure 2 是核心结果，重点看 frontier 而不是单点指标。Section 4.1 说明为什么即时 post-training 性能会误导；Section 4.2 的 compute-matched 分配实验最接近实际训练配方问题；Section 4.4 可看 replay、dropout 与早期混入的互补关系；Section 5 的理论部分适合带着一个问题读：早期数据暴露究竟是在提高目标域记忆，还是在改变特征分解和梯度干扰路径。进一步深挖时，应关注不同混入比例、数据重复次数、目标域数据质量和模型规模扩大后结论是否保持。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why some post-trained capabilities survive later fine-tuning while others are quickly forgotten, even when the models look equally good immediately after post-training. The central question is whether upstream training choices can make acquired capabilities more durable before downstream fine-tuning happens.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong fit for pretraining and post-training interface research. It reframes forgetting as an upstream training-design problem, not only a downstream mitigation problem. The main practical signal is simple: exposing the model to some eventual post-training data during pretraining can improve retention after later fine-tuning. This matters for continual pretraining, mid-training data schedules, domain capability injection, and safety-behavior preservation. The evidence is controlled and reaches 1B parameters, so it should be read as a clean empirical result and a training-design hypothesis rather than a finished scaling claim for frontier models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup has three stages. A model is pretrained on a broad corpus D_pre, post-trained on a smaller target corpus D_post, and then fine-tuned by a downstream user on a new objective D_ft. The main intervention is to mix part of D_post into the pretraining stage before the dedicated post-training stage. The evaluation is not based on immediate post-training loss alone. Instead, the downstream fine-tuning method is fixed, the learning rate is swept, and the resulting frontier between downstream loss, retained D_post capability, and general D_pre performance is compared across upstream recipes. This is the right measurement because two models with similar post-training loss can occupy different retention frontiers after fine-tuning. The paper also runs compute-matched allocation experiments, comparing all early exposure, all late exposure, and mixed schedules. The optimum tends to lie between the extremes. The proposed explanation is feature-level: early exposure lets the target capability be represented in more specialized and less interfering features, making it less vulnerable to later updates. Replay and dropout are evaluated under the same lens. Replay reduces overwriting by interleaving earlier data, while dropout discourages feature co-adaptation; both provide gains that are complementary to early data exposure.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover 135M and 1B parameter language models, two post-training domains, and two downstream fine-tuning tasks. The main results are consistent. First, immediate post-training performance is not a reliable predictor of retention after downstream fine-tuning. Second, mixing some target data into pretraining improves the retention-versus-downstream-loss frontier, sometimes with little visible effect on immediate post-training metrics. Third, under a fixed budget of target-data exposure, neither putting all exposure in pretraining nor putting all exposure in post-training is best; a split allocation performs better. Fourth, replay and dropout further improve the frontier and do not simply replace early exposure. The available text specifies model scales, the three-stage design, learning-rate sweeps, and the qualitative frontier shifts, but not enough complete tables to report exact loss deltas without guessing.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction, Preliminaries, Section 4, and Section 5 carefully. Figure 1 defines the three-stage pipeline. Table 1 is important for understanding the post-training and downstream fine-tuning settings. Figure 2 is the main result; focus on the tradeoff frontier rather than a single score. Section 4.1 explains why immediate post-training performance can be misleading. Section 4.2 is the most relevant part for training-recipe design because it studies how to allocate scarce target data across stages. Section 4.4 covers replay and dropout as complementary interventions. Section 5 is worth reading with one question in mind: does early exposure merely add memory of the target domain, or does it change the feature decomposition so later gradients interfere less?

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改变你对“post-train 学到就算学到”的默认看法；建议立刻在内部做 early-mix ablation，因为它讨论的是能力写入位置，而不是又一个遗忘补丁。
recommendation.en: This should update the prior that a capability learned in post-training is 'already there'; replicate the early-mix ablation internally, because the paper is about where capabilities get written, not another forgetting patch.

paper.title: Learning with Rare Success but Rich Feedback via Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation
paper.abstract: Enabling Large Language Models (LLMs) to continuously improve from environmental interactions is a central challenge in post-training. While on-policy self-distillation offers a promising paradigm, existing methods predominantly treat environmental feedback as a passive conditioning signal. Consequently, they heavily rely on successful demonstrations and struggle to learn in rare-success regimes. To bridge this gap, we introduce Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation (RESD), a framework that tran

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很棘手的 post-train 学习问题：当环境奖励极稀疏、成功轨迹几乎拿不到，但环境又能返回较丰富的执行反馈时，模型怎样从失败中稳定起步。已有 on-policy self-distillation，如 SDPO/OPSD，已经把轨迹级稀疏奖励改写成 token 级蒸馏信号，但它们通常只是把环境反馈原样拼到 teacher prompt 里，默认模型自己会从这些原始错误信息中提炼出可学习的修正信号。作者指出，真正的瓶颈不只是有没有反馈，而是反馈是否被组织成可迁移、可复用、可监督的形式。尤其在 rare-success regime 下，teacher 几乎只能依赖失败轨迹来给 student 提供监督；如果失败反馈只是未结构化日志、报错信息或 binary outcome，teacher 给出的 token 分布改进会很弱，学生也很难靠单次 rollout 自举起来。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，更接近 pretrain↔post-train 接口上的一个信号工程问题：如何把环境交互中的弱信号转成更密、更稳定的学习目标。启发点有两层。第一，self-distillation 的效果高度依赖“反馈表示”，而不是只依赖蒸馏目标形式；这和预训练里数据格式、标注结构、target design 影响训练动态是同一类问题。第二，它提示一种比纯 RL 更样本节省的 bootstrapping 路径：先把失败经验转成局部纠错知识，再用蒸馏把这些知识压回基础策略；等成功率起来后，再让 reward-based optimization 接管。这种分阶段思路，对持续学习、在线 mid-train、agentic post-train 都有参考价值。贡献量级上，它更像一个实用而清晰的训练框架改造，不是新理论范式，但在“稀疏成功 + 丰富反馈”的设置里有明确增益。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation（Resd）。整体仍沿用 on-policy self-distillation 框架：当前策略 πθ 采样轨迹，旧策略或滑动平均策略 πθ_old 作为 self-teacher，在更“特权”的上下文下输出每一步 token 分布，student 去拟合 teacher 的分布。训练目标写成统一的 f-divergence 形式，兼容 forward KL、reverse KL、JSD 等，并对 likelihood ratio 做 clipping 来稳住训练。

Resd 的新增部分不在 loss，而在 teacher context 的构造。它做了两层增强：
1. retrospective reflection：对每条失败轨迹，额外生成一段回顾式反思，内容不是泛泛总结，而是定位局部错误、解释为什么失败、指出如果当时做什么会更好。这样 teacher 在重看同一轨迹时，不再只看到原始环境反馈，而是看到一份已经被语言化、因果化、局部化的纠错说明。
2. persistent global playbook：把训练过程中反复出现、可复用的经验教训沉淀成一个持续更新的“手册”。后续 teacher prompt 不只带当前轨迹的 reflection，还会带上相关 playbook 条目。这样监督信号不再局限于单条 rollout，而是能跨 step 复用失败中提炼出的策略知识。

这两点合起来，等于把环境反馈从 passive conditioning 变成 active supervision。和标准 SDPO/OPSD 的区别，不是 teacher 更强，也不是引入外部 oracle，而是先对失败反馈做解释层加工，再让 self-teacher 在这个 enriched context 下重估 token 分布。作者还强调该模块是 plug-and-play 的，原则上可接到不同 self-distillation objective 上。

从机制上看，这个设计为什么可能有效：raw feedback 往往是结果级、全局级、低带宽的；reflection 把它变成局部决策层面的错误归因，playbook 再把一次性经验变成跨样本先验。对于 token-level distillation，这种结构化上下文更容易改变 teacher 在关键决策点的条件分布，而不是只在结尾处给出模糊惩罚。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不是大规模通用 benchmark，而是在线流式学习协议下的持续改进能力。任务被刻意设计成：对模型较新、初始成功率低、但环境能返回较丰富执行反馈。作者关心的是 rare-success 初期能否靠失败自举，而不是高成功率阶段的最终上限。

主要结果层面，Resd 相比标准 self-distillation baseline 有稳定提升，尤其在早期学习阶段更明显；和 GRPO 相比，在只用单次 rollout per prompt 的条件下，Resd 的起步速度更快。这一点很关键，因为它说明结构化反馈可以在成功样本几乎没有时先把策略推离随机探索区，而纯 reward optimization 往往要等到足够多成功轨迹出现后才开始有效。

从文中描述看，作者还做了若干对照：
- 直接拼接原始失败反馈 vs. 加 reflection：前者改进有限，后者能显著增强 teacher supervision。
- 只有局部 reflection vs. reflection + global playbook：playbook 带来跨 step 的知识保留，减少每次都从头解释失败。
- 与 reward-based 方法比较：Resd 在 sample efficiency 和 early-stage bootstrap 上更占优，但作者并没有宣称替代 RL，而是把 RL 视为成功率上升后的互补优化器。

给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字、参数量和数据规模细节，因此无法可靠填入具体百分点、模型大小或 token 数。能确认的是，实验协议强调 online streaming、single-rollout setting，以及在 sparse binary reward 之外利用 rich execution feedback。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三处。

第一，看 Introduction 和 Figure 1。这里把问题界定得很清楚：不是 self-distillation 无效，而是 raw failure feedback 的表示太弱。Figure 1 应该是理解作者动机的关键图。

第二，看方法部分里 teacher context 的构造流程。重点不是 f-divergence 公式本身，而是 reflection 如何生成、playbook 如何维护、它们怎样进入 teacher prompt。这里决定了方法到底是在“做更好的提示工程”，还是在“做可持续的监督信号重写”。

第三，看实验中的 early-stage curves 和 ablation。优先关注 rare-success 初期、single-rollout 条件下的学习曲线，以及 raw feedback / reflection / playbook 三者的拆分对比。这些结果最能说明方法是否真的在从失败中学习，而不是只是在成功样本出现后放大收益。

如果时间有限，预计 20–30 分钟可以完成泛读：读引言、方法总览、两三个核心实验图表即可。若想判断它对 continual pretrain 或 online post-train 是否有迁移价值，再补 appendix 里关于 f-divergence 选择和训练稳定性的说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in online post-training: how to improve from interaction when successful trajectories are extremely rare, yet the environment provides rich execution feedback. Existing on-policy self-distillation methods such as SDPO/OPSD already replace sparse trajectory rewards with token-level supervision from a self-teacher, but they mostly treat environment feedback as a passive prompt attachment. That works poorly in rare-success regimes, because the teacher has to infer corrective supervision almost entirely from failed rollouts. If the feedback remains as raw logs, error strings, or binary outcomes, the resulting teacher distribution is only weakly improved, and the student cannot bootstrap effectively.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface because it studies how weak interaction signals can be converted into denser and more reusable learning targets. Two points matter. First, the effectiveness of self-distillation depends heavily on feedback representation, not just on the divergence objective. That is closely related to target design and data formatting issues in pretraining. Second, it suggests a practical bootstrapping recipe for sparse-reward settings: first turn failures into localized corrective knowledge, distill that knowledge back into the base policy, and only rely more on reward optimization once success becomes frequent enough. The contribution is best read as a clean training-framework improvement rather than a new learning paradigm, but it addresses a real bottleneck in rare-success online learning.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Reflection-Enhanced Self-Distillation (Resd), keeps the standard on-policy self-distillation backbone. The current policy πθ samples trajectories. A self-teacher, instantiated from older or moving-average weights πθ_old, is given privileged context and produces token distributions for the same trajectory. The student then matches the teacher distribution with a unified f-divergence objective, with clipped likelihood ratios for stability. The loss family can recover forward KL, reverse KL, JSD, and related variants.

The main change is not in the loss but in how the teacher context is constructed. Resd adds two layers of structure:
1. Retrospective reflection. For each failed rollout, the system generates a reflection that diagnoses likely local mistakes, explains why the trajectory failed, and states what correction would have helped. This converts raw failure feedback into a more explicit error-attribution signal.
2. Persistent global playbook. Recurrent lessons extracted from failures are stored in a reusable playbook that persists across training steps. Future teacher prompts can condition not only on the current trajectory and its reflection, but also on accumulated reusable lessons.

This changes feedback from passive conditioning into active corrective supervision. Compared with standard SDPO/OPSD, the novelty is not a stronger external teacher and not a different policy class. The novelty is an intermediate interpretation layer that rewrites failure feedback into a form that can more directly alter the teacher’s token-level posterior.

Mechanistically, the design is sensible. Raw environment feedback is often global, low-bandwidth, and outcome-level. Reflection turns it into localized causal guidance. The playbook then amortizes that guidance across future examples. For token-level distillation, this should matter because the teacher can shift probability mass at the actual decision points that caused failure, rather than merely seeing a vague end-of-trajectory penalty.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation focuses on online continual-improvement settings rather than static offline benchmarks. Tasks are chosen to be relatively novel to the model, to start in a rare-success regime, and to provide rich execution feedback despite sparse binary rewards. The central question is whether the method can bootstrap from failures before successful demonstrations become common.

The main empirical finding is that Resd consistently outperforms standard self-distillation baselines, with the largest gains appearing in the early learning phase. Relative to GRPO, Resd improves faster at the beginning while using only a single rollout per prompt. That result is important because it supports the paper’s main claim: structured feedback can move the policy out of the pure-exploration regime even when successful trajectories are nearly absent, whereas reward-based optimization often becomes effective only after enough successes appear.

The paper also appears to include the key ablations one would want:
- raw failure feedback versus reflection-enhanced feedback;
- local reflection alone versus reflection plus a persistent playbook;
- comparison against reward-based optimization.
These comparisons support the interpretation that the gains come from better supervision extraction from failures, not from a stronger teacher or more rollouts.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, parameter counts, or exact dataset/task sizes, so I cannot reliably state concrete model scales or percentage improvements. What is clear is the protocol emphasis: online streaming training, single-rollout supervision, sparse binary reward, and rich execution feedback.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts.

First, read the introduction and inspect Figure 1 carefully. That is where the paper makes its strongest conceptual point: the bottleneck is not self-distillation per se, but the weak structure of raw failure feedback.

Second, in the method section, spend time on how reflections are generated, how the playbook is maintained, and how both are inserted into the teacher context. That is the actual contribution. The f-divergence formulation is useful but not the main reason to read the paper.

Third, look at the early-stage learning curves and the ablations. The most informative evidence is whether the method helps in the rare-success phase under a single-rollout budget, and whether reflection and playbook each contribute separately.

A practical skim should take around 20–30 minutes: introduction, method overview, and the main experimental figures. If you want to assess transfer to continual pretraining or online post-training pipelines, then also check the appendix discussion on divergence choice and training stability.

recommendation.zh: 值得看它如何把“失败反馈”变成 token 级纠错监督；但要重点审计反思生成是否泄漏答案/引入额外算力，先读方法与消融再信结论。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the mechanism that converts failure feedback into token-level corrective supervision; scrutinize leakage/extra-compute in reflection generation—read method + ablations before trusting the gains.

paper.title: Continual Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models via Program Memory
paper.abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), particularly Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), has become a standard approach for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) under limited compute. However, in continual settings where models are updated sequentially with small datasets, conventional LoRA updates struggle to balance rapid adaptation and knowledge retention. Existing methods typically treat the low-rank space as a homogeneous update region, lacking mechanisms to regulate how short-term updates are con

summary.core_problem: 在持续微调（Continual Fine-Tuning）场景下，传统的 LoRA 更新会将不同任务的知识写入同一个低秩子空间，导致严重的灾难性遗忘和任务间干扰。
summary.importance: 提出了一种结构化的 LoRA 记忆机制，在不增加推理开销的前提下，显著缓解了 LLM 在持续学习中的遗忘问题，为 PEFT 在动态数据流中的应用提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProCL 框架，将 LoRA 适配器划分为多个“程序记忆槽”（Program Memory Slots）。训练时，通过输入条件注意力机制动态检索并组合这些槽，将不同输入的更新路由到不同的参数区域，从而减少干扰。同时，保留原始 LoRA 权重作为稳定的分布式表示。定期将动态组合的权重“巩固”到持久化适配器中。推理时，直接使用合并后的持久化适配器，无需动态路由。
summary.experiments: 在文本分类和问答的持续学习基准上，ProCL 相比现有持续 LoRA 策略（如正交正则化或小波核方法），在知识保留和跨任务泛化上表现更好，且在问答等复杂生成任务中优势更明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对现有 LoRA 持续学习方法局限性的分析，以及 Background 中关于 ProCL 动态路由和巩固机制的数学表达。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In continual fine-tuning scenarios, standard LoRA updates write knowledge from different tasks into the same low-rank subspace, leading to severe catastrophic forgetting and inter-task interference.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a structured memory mechanism for LoRA that significantly mitigates forgetting in LLM continual learning without adding inference overhead, offering a new perspective for PEFT in dynamic data streams.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the ProCL framework, which partitions LoRA adapters into multiple 'program memory slots'. During training, an input-conditioned attention mechanism dynamically retrieves and composes these slots, routing updates for different inputs to distinct parameter regions to minimize interference. The original LoRA weights are maintained as a stable distributed representation. Periodically, the dynamically composed weights are 'consolidated' into a persistent adapter. During inference, this merged persistent adapter is used directly, eliminating the need for dynamic routing.
summary_en.experiments: On continual learning benchmarks for text classification and question answering, ProCL outperforms existing continual LoRA strategies (e.g., orthogonal regularization or wavelet kernel methods) in knowledge retention and cross-task generalization, with particularly pronounced advantages in complex generative tasks like QA.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the analysis of limitations in existing continual LoRA methods, and the Background section for the mathematical formulation of ProCL's dynamic routing and consolidation mechanisms. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 结构化LoRA插槽的调度思路可迁移到持续预训练的参数复用场景，重点看内存槽的注意力检索机制即可。
recommendation.en: The scheduling logic of structured LoRA slots can be migrated to parameter reuse in continual pretraining, focus on the attention-based slot retrieval mechanism.

institutions: Deakin Applied AI Initiative, Deakin University

paper.title: Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs
paper.abstract: Learning from past experience benefits from two complementary forms of memory: episodic traces -- raw trajectories of what happened -- and consolidated abstractions distilled across many episodes into reusable, schema-like lessons. Recent agentic-memory systems pursue the consolidated form: an LLM rewrites past trajectories into a textual memory bank that it continuously updates with new interactions, promising self-improving agents without parameter updates. Yet we find that such consolidated m

summary.core_problem: 研究“持续记忆巩固（consolidation）”在 LLM agent 中是否可靠：当代理把已解决任务的轨迹反复压缩成文本化抽象记忆，并在后续任务中持续更新这份记忆时，记忆是否会稳定变得更有用，还是会逐步漂移并反噬性能。论文把“输入经验是否有用”这个变量尽量控制住（用已成功轨迹或直接用 ground-truth 解），从而把问题聚焦到“巩固/改写这一步本身是否会引入系统性错误”。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法贡献，但对“用 LLM 作为可持续自我改写的知识压缩器/记忆巩固器”这一类范式给出强负面证据：在不做参数更新的前提下，反复的文本抽象更新会产生累积误差，导致记忆效用先升后降，甚至低于无记忆基线。对做 continual pretrain / self-training / 反复蒸馏的人也有间接启发：如果训练信号来自模型自写的总结或规则，且不断覆盖旧内容，错误会以‘看似更抽象更通用’的形式固化，最后表现为泛化边界被破坏、任务间互相干扰、对分布窄流的过拟合。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是把“记忆巩固”形式化为一个反复执行的 lossy rewrite loop：代理从轨迹池中抽取若干 episode（可能按任务/相似性分组），用 LLM 将其改写为更短的‘lesson/cheatsheet’条目写入 memory bank；后续再用这份 memory 做检索或直接拼接进上下文来解新任务；同时 memory 会被持续刷新（streaming updates）。论文系统比较了：
1) Static-All vs Stream：同一批轨迹，一次性全量巩固（Static）与按时间/批次流式巩固（Stream）会收敛到不同记忆状态，且 Stream 更容易崩。
2) 抽象记忆 vs 纯情景记忆（episodic-only）：不做抽象，只把原始轨迹当 in-context demonstrations 追加到上下文，作为对照。由于轨迹池固定，这个对照用来定位问题是否来自“抽象改写”而非“经验质量”。
3) 记忆容量/更新轮次/任务切换：观察效用曲线是否出现先升后降，以及任务间覆盖。
机制分析给出三类失败源：
- 误分组（misgrouping）：把不共享潜在结构的 episode 混在一起抽象，导致生成的规则本身就不一致。
- 过度抽象丢失适用条件（missing applicability conditions）：即便分组正确，抽象时把边界条件删掉，形成过泛化条目，进而在相邻任务上产生干扰。
- 窄流过拟合（overfitting under narrow streams）：输入流重复/近重复时，抽象会贴合实例表面特征，导致同任务内泛化变差。
整体结论是：把“保留证据（episodic）”和“形成抽象（semantic）”合并成同一个持续改写循环，在当前 LLM 上不稳定。
summary.experiments:
覆盖 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、WebShop、AppWorld 以及一个更可控的测试床（文中提到用于放大巩固失败）。关键现象：
- ScienceWorld：不同记忆大小下，效用随更新步数先上升后下降（图 1a），出现“memory erosion”。
- WebShop：AWM 风格的蒸馏记忆随着样本规模增大反而退化，而原始轨迹（Raw Traj.）更稳健（图 1b）。图中给出 50 个 held-out episodes 的 success rate，并同时报告括号内的平均分指标；曲线显示抽象记忆在更大 #examples 下出现明显下滑，而 raw 轨迹保持较高水平。
- ARC-AGI 切片（19 题）：GPT-5.4 在无记忆时可达 100%（作者选取其可全对的子集作为“可解上限”）。在每次巩固都使用 ground-truth solution 的条件下，Static（一次性巩固全池）在 R=10、R=50 仍保持 94.7%，而 Stream（逐题流式更新）到 Round 10 掉到 52.6%（图 2），相当于在“原本能做对的题”上被记忆改写拖垮。
- 论文还强调更新顺序/分批会导致不同终态，以及任务切换时的覆盖效应（正文提到 Fig. 8b/8c、Fig. 11 等），用来支撑“巩固步骤本身引入不确定性与干扰”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Fig.1 与 Fig.2：把“先升后降”和“stream 崩盘但 static 稳”的核心现象抓住。
- 再看实验设置表（文中 Setting/Figure 对照）确认他们如何控制轨迹质量（已成功轨迹、GT 解）。
- 重点扫 §6 机制：misgrouping / 丢失适用条件 / 窄流过拟合，这三点对应现实系统里最常见的三种记忆写入策略错误。
- 如果你做 continual pretrain / self-distillation：把“Stream vs Static”的差异当作一个类比，思考在线覆盖式训练信号为何更容易累积偏差；同时注意 episodic-only 对照已经很强，说明‘先别急着抽象’在工程上可能是更稳的默认。
summary.authors_note: 伊利诺伊大学香槟分校（UIUC）；通讯作者 Dylan Zhang（shizhuo2@illinois.edu）。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether LLM agents can serve as reliable long-term “memory consolidators”: if an agent repeatedly compresses solved trajectories into textual abstractions (lessons/cheatsheets) and continuously updates that memory over time, does the memory become more useful and stable, or does it drift and eventually harm performance. The study controls for trajectory usefulness (successful rollouts or even ground-truth solutions) to isolate failures caused by the consolidation/rewrite step itself.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining-method paper, but it provides concrete negative evidence against a popular agent-memory design pattern: iterative textual consolidation is not “at worst neutral” for today’s LLMs. The broader pretraining-relevant takeaway is about iterative self-generated supervision and overwrite dynamics: when the training/knowledge signal is repeatedly rewritten into more abstract rules, small errors can accumulate as seemingly general statements, blurring applicability boundaries and increasing cross-task interference—failure modes that rhyme with continual self-distillation and online data curation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They model consolidation as an iterative lossy rewrite loop. A fixed pool/stream of episodes is grouped (by task or similarity), then an LLM rewrites them into compact memory entries; the agent later conditions on this memory (retrieval or direct context injection) to solve tasks; memory is refreshed repeatedly under different schedules. Key comparisons are:
- Static-All vs Stream: consolidate the same trajectory pool in one shot vs update memory batch-by-batch/episode-by-episode.
- Abstracted memory vs episodic-only control: append raw trajectories as in-context demonstrations without abstraction, keeping the experience pool fixed to attribute differences to consolidation.
- Vary memory size, refresh rounds, and task-switching to probe erosion and interference.
Mechanism analysis attributes failures to (1) misgrouping heterogeneous experiences before abstraction, (2) abstraction dropping applicability conditions and producing overgeneral rules that interfere with neighboring tasks, and (3) overfitting under narrow/repetitive streams where abstractions latch onto instance-level artifacts.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluations span ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, AppWorld, plus a controlled testbed designed to make consolidation failures salient. Main results:
- ScienceWorld: memory utility rises early but then declines with continued consolidation across memory sizes (memory erosion; Fig. 1a).
- WebShop: AWM-style distilled memory degrades as the number of examples increases, while raw-trajectory episodic context remains robust (Fig. 1b; success rate over 50 held-out episodes, with an additional average-score metric in parentheses).
- ARC-AGI slice (19 problems): GPT-5.4 solves the slice at 100% with no memory. With ground-truth solutions used at every consolidation step, Static consolidation stays at 94.7% even after R=10 and R=50 refresh rounds, but Stream consolidation collapses to 52.6% by Round 10 (Fig. 2), demonstrating that the rewrite schedule alone can turn solvable problems into failures.
They also report strong order/grouping sensitivity and task-overwrite effects (referenced figures include 8b/8c and 11).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Start with Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 to internalize the two core phenomena: “improve-then-degrade” and “streaming updates collapse while static stays stable.”
- Check the setup details to see how they ensure trajectories are useful (successful rollouts / ground-truth solutions), which is crucial for the causal claim.
- Read the mechanism section (§6) for the three failure modes; map each to common engineering choices in memory writing and continual self-training.
- If your work touches continual pretraining or self-distillation, treat Static vs Stream as an analogy for offline vs online overwrite dynamics and ask what safeguards are missing when the model is both the compressor and the editor of its own knowledge.
summary_en.authors_note: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC); corresponding author Dylan Zhang (shizhuo2@illinois.edu).

recommendation.zh: 读实验设计和失败样例；它改变我对“LLM 总结记忆可稳定累积能力”的先验。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental setup and failure cases; it weakens the prior that LLM-written memory summaries accumulate capability reliably.

institutions: IIIS, Tsinghua University, Work done at UIUC

paper.title: Learning, Fast and Slow: Towards LLMs That Adapt Continually
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are trained for downstream tasks by updating their parameters (e.g., via RL). However, updating parameters forces them to absorb task-specific information, which can result in catastrophic forgetting and loss of plasticity. In contrast, in-context learning with fixed LLM parameters can cheaply and rapidly adapt to task-specific requirements (e.g., prompt optimization), but cannot by itself typically match the performance gains available through updating LLM parameter

summary.core_problem: 这项工作关注 RLVR 等参数更新式适配的一个瓶颈：所有任务信号都写入同一组模型权重，会带来基座行为偏移、熵下降、泛化变差和后续任务可塑性下降。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 pretrain 与 posttrain 接口。它不是新的预训练目标，但提出了一个清晰的训练分工：长期、可复用的能力进入慢权重，短期、任务相关的策略先由文本上下文承载。这个视角对 continual pretrain、RL pretrain、mid-training 也有参考意义，因为它把“更新权重”从唯一适配通道降级为多个适配通道之一。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Fast-Slow Training。慢变量是模型参数 θ，用 RLVR 更新；快变量是文本脚手架 ϕ，包括 system prompt、指令和任务上下文，用 GEPA 这类自动 prompt 优化器更新。训练时不是先 RL 再做 prompt tuning，而是让两者交替演化。慢权重部分沿用 ScaleRL/RLVR 设置：对每个 query 采样一组 rollout，用 verifier 给 0/1 或区间 reward，计算 group-relative advantage，再用带截断重要性采样的 REINFORCE/CISPO 目标更新策略。快权重部分用 GEPA 维护 prompt population，通过 rollout 反馈和冻结反思模型生成自然语言 critique，再产生 prompt mutation。FST 保留 K 个 prompt，而不是只保留一个最优 prompt，因为不同 prompt 可能覆盖任务分布的不同区域；RL 更新时从 prompt population 中采样，让策略在多个条件行为下学习。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学、代码和一般推理类 RLVR 任务。给出的关键结果有四类：第一，在匹配 RL reward 时，FST 最多可减少约 3× rollout；第二，性能上限高于只更新参数的 RL baseline；第三，在相同 reward 下，慢权重相对 base policy 的 KL 最多降低约 70%，说明 reward 提升不完全依赖权重远离初始模型；第四，两阶段任务迁移实验中，RL-only 在第二阶段继续训练时会退化到接近 0% 的表现，而 FST 仍能继续适配。动态切换任务的 continual setting 中，FST 对目标变化的响应也更快。给定内容未显示具体模型规模、每个任务的样本量和表格数值，需要读实验章节确认这些细节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中五个 advantage 的定义，它们决定了这项工作的评价口径。然后看 Preliminaries 和 FST 方法部分，重点确认 prompt population 如何与 RL rollout 共享样本、GEPA 更新频率如何设置、慢权重更新时是否对不同 prompt 做均匀采样。实验部分优先看四类曲线：reward-vs-rollout、KL-vs-reward、两阶段任务迁移、动态任务切换。真正值得深挖的是 credit assignment：哪些收益来自更好的 prompt，哪些收益被固化进参数，以及二者是否会在长训练中相互干扰。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a limitation of parameter-only adaptation in RLVR-style post-training: every signal, from reusable skills to transient task heuristics, is written into the same model weights, which can move the policy away from its base behavior and reduce future plasticity.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is at the pretrain–posttrain boundary. It reframes adaptation as a multi-channel optimization problem rather than pure weight updates. This matters for continual pretraining and RL-based training because it suggests that some short-horizon task signal should remain in an external, cheap-to-update textual channel instead of being permanently absorbed into parameters.
summary_en.technical_approach: Fast-Slow Training separates slow parametric weights θ from fast textual weights ϕ. The slow side is optimized with RLVR following a ScaleRL-like recipe: group rollouts per query, verifier-based rewards, group-relative advantages, and a truncated importance-sampling REINFORCE/CISPO objective. The fast side is optimized with GEPA, which maintains a population of prompts, uses rollouts to obtain natural-language critiques from a frozen reflection model, and proposes textual mutations. FST interleaves these two optimizers. Instead of training a policy first and tuning the prompt afterward, the prompt population and the policy co-evolve. The method keeps multiple prompts because GEPA returns a Pareto frontier; different prompts can work better on different parts of the task distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover RLVR settings in math, code, and general reasoning. Reported findings include up to 3× fewer rollouts to match RL reward, a higher final reward ceiling than RL-only baselines, and up to 70% lower KL to the base policy at matched reward. In a two-stage transfer setup, RL-only checkpoints collapse to near 0% on the second task, while FST-trained checkpoints retain the ability to adapt. In online task-switching settings, FST reacts faster to changing objectives. The provided content does not expose model sizes, exact data budgets, or full tables, so those details need to be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20–30 minutes. Start with the five claimed advantages in the introduction, then read the formal setup and FST algorithm to see how prompt populations are sampled during RL. In the experiments, prioritize reward-versus-rollout, KL-versus-reward, sequential task transfer, and dynamic task-switching results. The most useful question to track is credit assignment: which improvements stay in the prompt channel, which ones are consolidated into weights, and whether the two channels compete during longer training.

recommendation.zh: 快慢双尺度学习的范式很有启发性，可作为持续预训练避免遗忘的候选方案做内部ablation
recommendation.en: The dual-time-scale fast-slow learning paradigm is highly inspiring; it can be trialed as a candidate for catastrophic forgetting mitigation in continual pretraining ablations.

paper.title: Skill Neologisms: Towards Skill-based Continual Learning
paper.abstract: Modern LLMs show mastery over an ever-growing range of skills, as well as the ability to compose them flexibly. However, extending model capabilities to new skills in a scalable manner is an open-problem: fine-tuning and parameter-efficient variants risk catastrophic forgetting, while context-based approaches have limited expressiveness and are constrained by the model's effective context. We explore skill neologisms--i.e., soft tokens integrated in the model's vocabulary and optimized to improv

summary.core_problem: 论文讨论的是如何在不更新模型权重的前提下，为已训练好的 LLM 增加可复用、可组合的新技能。目标不是学习一个任务前缀，而是学习一种“技能词”：模型在上下文中看到这个新 token 后，能更稳定地调用某类程序性能力，并且能和已有技能或其他独立学到的技能组合。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在持续学习和 tokenizer/embedding 接口。传统 continual pretraining 或 fine-tuning 会改权重，容易带来遗忘和安全侧效应；prompt tuning 往往绑定到具体任务，组合性弱。Skill neologism 把新增能力压缩到 vocabulary-level 的软 token 中，提供了一种介于 in-context learning、prompt tuning 和权重更新之间的接口。它不能替代真正的继续预训练，但给出了一个研究问题：预训练模型内部已经形成的程序性电路，能否通过少量新增 embedding 被选择性激活和重组。
summary.technical_approach: 方法有两个关键设计。第一是 skill-centered training：训练数据中的每个样本都需要目标技能，同时混入模型已掌握的多种技能组合。这样做的目的不是让 token 记住训练分布，而是迫使它表示一个可迁移的操作能力。第二是 vocabulary-level integration：把一段可学习的连续向量作为新的 vocabulary element 加入 embedding 空间，模型主体参数冻结，只优化这些 skill tokens。它和普通 prompt tuning 的差异在于，prompt tuning 多数是任务前缀，位置和模板依赖更强；这里的新 token 被当作词表成员使用，目标是像自然语言中的新词一样，被插入到不同上下文中并触发对应技能。论文还用 Arora and Goyal 的技能组合形式化框架描述训练和测试分布，例如要求 token 在训练中见到目标技能与若干已知技能的组合，在测试中和未见过的技能组合。
summary.experiments: 实验重点是受控组合场景，而不是大规模开放域能力扩展。论文先观察到现成 LLM 的词表中已经存在带有程序性知识倾向的 token，即某些 token 会稳定改变模型的解题行为。随后训练 skill neologisms，并测试三个性质：不改权重学习新技能；和训练外的技能组合；多个独立学习的 skill token 零样本组合。消融分析关注两点：token capacity，即一个技能需要多少软 token 才能承载稳定信号；training composition complexity，即训练样本中技能组合复杂度如何影响泛化到新组合。总体结果支持一个受限但清晰的结论：当模型原本已经具备相关电路时，新增软 token 可以作为技能选择器，而不是完整学习器。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 skill-based continual learning 的 P1–P3 定义，以及 Method 中 skill-centered training 和 vocabulary-level integration 的具体实现。实验部分优先看组合泛化和独立技能零样本组合的设置，再看 token capacity 的消融。需要谨慎读的是“学习新技能”的边界：这类方法更像激活和重组已有能力，不应理解为在冻结模型中凭空注入模型完全不会的算法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to extend a frozen LLM with reusable and composable procedural skills. The proposed unit is not a task-specific prompt prefix, but a learned “skill word”: a new soft vocabulary item that can be placed in context to bias the model toward a particular capability and compose with other skills.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance for pretraining is the interface between frozen model capabilities, continual learning, and the tokenizer/embedding layer. Standard continual pretraining or fine-tuning updates weights and can introduce forgetting. In-context learning is limited by context and often lacks adaptation strength. Skill neologisms explore a narrower but useful regime: if the pretrained model already contains the circuits needed for a skill, can a small number of new embedding vectors select and recombine those circuits in a controlled way?
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two design choices. First, skill-centered training uses data where every example requires the target skill while also involving diverse skills already mastered by the model. This discourages the token from becoming a dataset shortcut and pushes it toward a reusable procedural representation. Second, vocabulary-level integration adds learnable soft tokens as new vocabulary elements while freezing all model weights. This differs from conventional prompt tuning, which usually learns a task-bound prefix. Here the learned vectors are intended to behave like newly introduced words that can be inserted into different prompts. The formal setup follows a skill-composition view: examples are associated with tuples of skills, and the key test is whether a token trained with some combinations transfers to unseen combinations.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical setup is controlled rather than open-ended. The paper first shows that pretrained LLM vocabularies already contain tokens that appear to carry procedural biases. It then trains skill neologisms and evaluates three properties: learning without weight updates, composition with out-of-distribution skills, and zero-shot composition of independently learned skill tokens. The ablations study token capacity and the complexity of skill mixtures during training. The main finding is bounded but useful: when the frozen model already has the relevant latent machinery, learned vocabulary-level soft tokens can act as skill selectors and compositional handles.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the definition of skill-based continual learning properties P1–P3, the construction of skill-centered data, and the distinction between vocabulary-level neologisms and prompt tuning. In the experiments, prioritize the out-of-distribution composition tests and the ablations on token capacity. The important limitation is that these tokens are better viewed as activating and recombining existing model capabilities, not as a full substitute for continual pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 看 compositionality 实验和 token 分析；若结果稳，它会改变“新技能必须改权重或塞上下文”的默认取舍。
recommendation.en: Read the compositionality tests and token analysis; if robust, it weakens the default choice between weight updates and long-context demos.

paper.title: SPHERE: Mitigating the Loss of Spectral Plasticity in Mixture-of-Experts for Deep Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: In deep reinforcement learning (DRL), an agent is trained from a stream of experience. In a continual learning setting, such agents can suffer from plasticity loss: their ability to learn new skills from new experiences diminishes over training. Recently, Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) networks have been reported to enable scaling laws and facilitate the learning of diverse skills. However, in continual reinforcement learning settings, their performance can degenerate as learning proceeds, indicating

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 MoE 策略在持续强化学习中为什么会逐步失去学习新任务的能力，并尝试用可计算的谱指标来约束这种 plasticity loss。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 预训练的直接相关性不强，但对 MoE 长程训练稳定性有参考价值。它把“可塑性下降”转成 eNTK 有效秩下降的问题，提供了一个比只看 reward 或梯度范数更结构化的诊断角度。对长期在线训练、RL pretrain、持续学习中的 MoE 路由退化有启发，尤其是如何监控专家特征是否塌缩到少数更新方向。
summary.technical_approach: 论文先用经验 Neural Tangent Kernel 描述策略在函数空间里的更新方向。若 eNTK 的谱熵有效秩下降，表示模型能利用的函数更新方向变少，新任务到来时更难快速适应。直接构造 eNTK 代价很高，因此作者推导 MoE 的分层块分解，把谱可塑性的代理量写成加权 expert feature matrix 的有效秩问题。SPHERE 的做法是在这个加权特征矩阵上加 Parseval penalty，促使专家特征近似正交、分布在超球面上，减少专家表示共线和功能塌缩。它不同于简单的负载均衡或参数重置：负载均衡主要约束 token 或状态分配是否均匀，SPHERE 约束的是专家特征能否提供多样的函数更新方向。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 MetaWorld 和 HumanoidBench 的持续学习设置，并与未正则化 MoE、已有 plasticity 方法进行比较。论文报告 SPHERE 相对普通 MoE 在 MetaWorld 上平均成功率最高提升 133%，在 HumanoidBench 上最高提升 50%。关键现象是：普通 MoE 随训练推进 eNTK 有效秩下降，后续任务性能退化；SPHERE 能在训练后期维持更高的 spectral plasticity，并带来更稳定的跨任务成功率。消融重点应在正则项强度、专家数量、Top-K 路由、DS-MoE 设置，以及谱代理指标和真实性能之间的相关性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 spectral plasticity 的定义，再看方法部分从 eNTK 到 weighted expert feature matrix 的推导，以及 SPHERE 正则项的形式。实验部分重点看 MetaWorld/HumanoidBench 的持续任务曲线、有效秩随训练变化的图、正则强度消融。若关注 LLM MoE，可跳过 MDP 基础定义，重点思考这个指标是否能迁移到 token-level MoE：例如用 expert hidden states 或 FFN activation 构造类似的谱代理，监控长训练中专家功能是否变窄。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why MoE policies lose the ability to learn later tasks in continual reinforcement learning, and proposes a tractable spectral regularizer to preserve plasticity.
summary_en.importance: The work is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to long-horizon MoE training. Its useful contribution is a diagnostic view: plasticity loss can be described as a decline in the effective rank of the empirical NTK, meaning that functional updates collapse into fewer directions. For LLM researchers, this is a useful analogy for monitoring expert specialization, expert collapse, and reduced adaptability during online RL, continual pretraining, or long MoE runs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes plasticity as diversity in function-space update directions, measured by the spectral-entropy effective rank of the empirical Neural Tangent Kernel. Since forming the full eNTK is too expensive, the authors derive a layerwise block decomposition for MoE policies and obtain a proxy based on a weighted expert feature matrix available from forward passes. SPHERE then applies a Parseval-style penalty to this matrix, encouraging expert features to be less collinear and more evenly spread on a hypersphere. This differs from standard MoE load-balancing losses: load balancing controls routing frequency, while SPHERE controls the geometry of expert features and the diversity of functional update directions.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses continual learning benchmarks from MetaWorld and HumanoidBench. SPHERE improves average success over an unregularized MoE baseline by up to 133% on MetaWorld and up to 50% on HumanoidBench. The main diagnostic result is that vanilla MoE policies show a declining eNTK effective rank as training proceeds, while SPHERE maintains higher spectral plasticity and improves later-task performance. The important ablations are the regularization strength, number of experts, Top-K routing choices, DS-MoE variants, and the correlation between the spectral proxy and downstream success.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: 25–35 minutes. Focus on the definition of spectral plasticity, the derivation that turns the eNTK objective into a weighted expert-feature proxy, and the exact SPHERE regularizer. In the experiments, prioritize the continual-learning curves, the effective-rank plots, and the regularization ablations. For LLM MoE work, the useful question is whether a similar feature-spectrum diagnostic can be built from expert activations during long pretraining or RL fine-tuning.

recommendation.zh: 从NTK角度推导MoE的光谱可塑性损失机制，提出的正则化方法可迁移到LLM MoE的持续预训练场景，重点看第3章的代理指标推导
recommendation.en: Derives spectral plasticity loss mechanism for MoEs from NTK theory; the proposed regularization is transferable to LLM MoE continual pretraining, focus on Section 3 proxy derivation.

paper.title: When Does Structure Matter in Continual Learning? Dimensionality Controls When Modularity Shapes Representational Geometry
paper.abstract: To preserve previously learned representations, continual learning systems must strike a balance between plasticity, the ability to acquire new knowledge, and stability. This stability-plasticity dilemma affects how representations can be reused across tasks: shared structure enables transfer when tasks are similar but may also induce interference when new learning disrupts existing representations. However, it remains unclear when and why structural separation influences this trade-off. In this

summary.core_problem: 研究持续学习中，模块化结构在什么条件下会影响表征几何、迁移和干扰。
summary.importance: 这是基础深度学习机制分析，贡献在于把任务相似度、模块化架构和表征有效维度联系起来解释稳定性-可塑性权衡；对 LLM continual pretraining 只有间接启发，实验设置更接近受控小模型。
summary.technical_approach: 论文比较任务分区的模块化循环网络和单模块 baseline，系统改变任务相似度以及权重初始化尺度。初始化尺度会诱导不同学习 regime，作者用表征有效维度刻画这些 regime，并分析维度如何调节模块化对表征几何、迁移和干扰的影响。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供模型规模、任务细节、样本量或具体数值。实验是在顺序任务范式下，对低、中、高任务相似度和不同初始化尺度进行消融，并比较模块化网络与单模块网络的表征变化和学习表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自哥本哈根 IT 大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies when modular structure affects representational geometry, transfer, and interference in continual learning.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic deep-learning analysis. Its contribution is linking task similarity, modular architecture, and effective representational dimensionality in the stability-plasticity trade-off. It is only indirectly relevant to LLM continual pretraining, and the setup appears to be controlled and small-scale.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors compare a task-partitioned modular recurrent network with a single-module baseline while varying task similarity and weight-initialization scale. The initialization scale induces different learning regimes, characterized by effective dimensionality, which is then used to explain when modularity shapes representational geometry and interference.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model scale, task details, dataset size, or numerical gains. The experiments use a sequential-task paradigm with low, medium, and high task similarity, multiple initialization scales, and comparisons between modular and single-module recurrent networks.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with IT University of Copenhagen.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 continual pretrain 的机制备查；只看维度控制结论，别把小 RNN 结果外推到 LLM。
recommendation.en: Useful as a mechanism note for continual pretraining; read the dimensionality claim, but do not over-extrapolate small-RNN results to LLMs.

paper.title: Hidden Failure Modes of Gradient Modification under Adam in Continual Learning, and Adaptive Decoupled Moment Routing as a Repair
paper.abstract: Many continual-learning methods modify gradients upstream (e.g., projection, penalty rescaling, replay mixing) while treating Adam as a neutral backend. We show this composition has a hidden failure mode. In a high-overlap, non-adaptive 8-domain continual LM, all shared-routing projection baselines collapse close to vanilla forgetting (12.5--12.8 vs. 13.2). A 0.5% replay buffer is the strongest shared alternative but still reaches 11.6, while fixed-strength decoupling falls below vanilla at 14.1

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文指出一个容易被忽略的持续学习失效模式：许多方法在 Adam 之前修改梯度，希望保护旧知识，但 Adam 的二阶矩估计会把被削弱的梯度解释为低方差方向，反而提高这些方向的有效学习率，抵消保护效果。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在训练动态和持续预训练接口。持续学习、领域顺序训练、灾难性遗忘控制，经常默认优化器只是执行梯度修改。论文说明这个默认假设不稳，尤其在 Adam/AdamW 这类自适应优化器下，梯度投影、重要性惩罚、replay mixing 都可能被二阶矩通道改写。贡献不是一个通用预训练算法，而是给出一个清晰的 optimizer-composition 诊断：保护旧知识不能只看梯度方向和幅度，还要看这些信号如何进入一阶矩和二阶矩。
summary.technical_approach: 核心机制叫 attenuate-then-adapt conflict。上游方法把受保护方向的梯度缩小，但默认 Adam 会用修改后的梯度同时更新一阶矩 m 和二阶矩 v。v 是幅度累积器，梯度越小，分母越小，eta/sqrt(v) 越大，于是受保护方向的有效学习率被放大。论文先用单方向标量 surrogate 分析投影方法，得到在 epsilon 远小于稳态二阶矩时，有效学习率近似出现 1/(1-alpha) 的膨胀。修复方案是 decoupled moment routing：把修改后的梯度送入 m，用保留幅度信息的统计量驱动 v，再叠加 overlap-aware adaptive strength。作者把这个实例化为 Adaptive-OGP，并强调固定强度的 decoupled routing 并不够，甚至可能更差；稳定性来自“路由解耦”和“重叠感知强度调度”的组合。
summary.experiments: 高重叠 8-domain continual LM 是主要压力测试。vanilla forgetting 为 13.2；共享路由的投影类基线 OGD、GPM、FOPNG、Adam-NSCL 都落在 12.5–12.8，几乎没有拉开差距；0.5% replay buffer 达到 11.6，是较强共享路由替代方案，但仍比 Adaptive-OGP 差 2.2；朴素固定强度 decoupled variant 为 14.1，低于 vanilla；Adaptive-OGP 达到 9.4，相比 vanilla 改善 3.8。16-domain 扩展中，相比最强共享路由基线的差距扩大到 4.5–4.8。机制验证上，标量 surrogate 对 8 个 alpha 值的预测误差在 8% 内；只干预分母并保持 m 不变时，遗忘随有效学习率膨胀单调变化，相关系数 r=0.97；eta_eff matching 能关闭 clean benchmark 中约 80% 的遗忘差距。论文还报告了 penalty-based importance、replay-gradient mixing、7B LoRA，以及 Adam、AdamW、AdaFactor、SGD+Momentum 的控制实验，结果支持这是优化器组合问题，而不是某个 Adam 实现细节。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Introduction，确认问题设置和失败现象。随后看 Section 2 的 attenuate-then-adapt 分析，重点是 Proposition 1、Remark 1 中有效学习率膨胀的推导。Table 4 看 eta_eff matching，Table 5 看高重叠持续学习下各基线的塌缩，Table 6 看 routing 与 schedule 的 2×2 分解，Table 7 看 penalty 和 replay 家族是否同样受影响。Algorithm 1 可快速扫一遍，重点不是实现复杂度，而是 modified gradient 与 magnitude-faithful statistic 分别进入 m/v 的设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a quiet failure mode in continual learning with Adam: gradient-modification methods try to protect old knowledge upstream, but Adam’s second-moment pathway can turn the attenuated gradients into larger effective learning rates in the protected directions.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining research is in training dynamics and continual pretraining. Domain-sequential training and forgetting control often treat Adam or AdamW as a neutral backend. This work shows that the optimizer can rewrite the intended protection signal. The point applies beyond one continual-learning method: projection, penalty-based rescaling, and replay-gradient mixing can all suffer when the modified gradient is shared by Adam’s first- and second-moment estimators.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed diagnosis is the attenuate-then-adapt conflict. If a method shrinks gradients in old-knowledge directions, and the same shrunken gradients are fed into Adam’s v accumulator, the denominator becomes smaller. The effective step size eta/sqrt(v) then increases exactly where the method intended to reduce updates. The paper analyzes this with a scalar surrogate for a projected direction, yielding an approximate 1/(1-alpha) inflation of the old-direction effective learning rate under the tested regime. The repair is adaptive decoupled moment routing: send the modified gradient to the first moment m, keep the second moment v driven by magnitude-faithful statistics, and combine this with an overlap-aware adaptive strength schedule. The instantiated method is Adaptive-OGP. A key detail is that fixed-strength decoupling alone is not enough; the schedule and the routing each contribute.
summary_en.experiments: In the high-overlap 8-domain continual LM setting, vanilla forgetting is 13.2. Shared-routing projection baselines such as OGD, GPM, FOPNG, and Adam-NSCL cluster around 12.5–12.8. A 0.5% replay buffer reaches 11.6, still 2.2 units behind Adaptive-OGP. A naive fixed-strength decoupled variant drops to 14.1, worse than vanilla. Adaptive-OGP reaches 9.4, improving by 3.8 units over vanilla. In a 16-domain extension, the gap to the strongest shared-routing baseline grows to 4.5–4.8 units. The scalar surrogate tracks measured inflation within 8% across eight alpha values. A denominator-only intervention gives a monotonic relationship between measured inflation and forgetting with r=0.97. Matching the old-direction effective learning rate closes roughly 80% of the clean-benchmark forgetting gap. The paper also checks penalty methods, replay-gradient mixing, 7B LoRA, and multiple optimizers including Adam, AdamW, AdaFactor, and SGD with momentum.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with Figure 1 and the introduction to understand the failure regime. Then read Section 2, especially Proposition 1 and Remark 1, for the effective-learning-rate mechanism. Table 4 is useful for the controlled eta_eff intervention. Table 5 shows the collapse of shared-routing baselines. Table 6 separates routing from adaptive scheduling. Table 7 tests whether the same issue appears in penalty and replay families. Algorithm 1 is short; the important design choice is the separation of signals routed into m and v.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了改梯度（如 Continual Learning 常用）和 Adam 动量状态的冲突，做 Continual Pretrain 或魔改梯度的研究员值得看 §3 的机制分析。
recommendation.en: Reveals the conflict between gradient modification (common in Continual Learning) and Adam's momentum state. Researchers doing Continual Pretrain or hacking gradients should read the mechanism analysis in §3.

paper.title: Towards Adaptive Continual Model Merging via Manifold-Aware Expert Evolution
paper.abstract: Continual Model Merging (CMM) sequentially integrates task-specific models into a unified architecture without intensive retraining. However, existing CMM methods are hindered by a fundamental saturation-redundancy dilemma: backbone-centric approaches face parameter saturation and representation interference within fixed capacities, whereas Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants resort to indiscriminate expansion, incurring expert redundancy and a routing bottleneck reliant on additional data-driven

summary.core_problem: 解决持续模型合并中固定骨干容量饱和、表示干扰，以及 MoE 式扩展带来的专家冗余和路由开销问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是模型合并与持续适配方法改进。它不直接讨论 LLM 预训练，但触及一个现实问题：多个任务模型如何在少量或无重训条件下整合到统一模型中，对 continual post-training 和模型资产复用有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MADE-IT，即 Manifold-Aware Dynamic Expert Evolution and Implicit Routing。核心做法是用投影式子空间亲和度度量专家之间的内在表示关系，再用分布感知的自适应阈值决定专家演化、合并或扩展，以控制专家多样性和参数规模。论文还声称通过隐式路由绕过额外数据驱动路由优化，但摘要未给出完整细节。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体模型规模、任务集、baseline 名称和量化提升。可确认的是论文面向 sequential task-specific model merging，而不是端到端预训练；实验可信度需要看是否覆盖强模型合并 baseline、任务顺序扰动和容量受限设置。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港理工大学 Department of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence；Kay Chen Tan 是进化计算和智能优化方向的知名学者，但该背景并非 LLM 基座预训练主线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses capacity saturation and representation interference in continual model merging, as well as expert redundancy and routing overhead in MoE-style merging.
summary_en.importance: This is a continual adaptation and model-merging contribution rather than a pretraining paper. It is relevant mainly as a possible tool for reusing task-specific checkpoints without expensive retraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MADE-IT uses manifold-aware expert evolution. It measures expert affinity through projection-based subspace similarity and applies a distribution-aware adaptive threshold to decide when experts should evolve, merge, or remain separate. The abstract also claims an implicit routing mechanism to avoid additional data-driven router training, but the details are not visible from the provided text.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The key thing to verify in the paper is whether the method is tested under realistic task sequences, strong merging baselines, and constrained-capacity regimes.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from the Department of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University. Kay Chen Tan is well known in evolutionary computation and intelligent optimization, but this is not a core LLM pretraining group.

recommendation.zh: 作为模型合并备查即可；如果隐式路由不依赖 held-out 数据，§方法细节值得扫一眼。
recommendation.en: Useful as model-merging background; skim the method only if implicit routing truly avoids held-out routing data.

paper.title: COMPASS: COntinual Multilingual PEFT with Adaptive Semantic Sampling
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often exhibit performance disparities across languages, with naive multilingual fine-tuning frequently degrading performance due to negative cross-lingual interference. To address this, we introduce COMPASS (COntinual Multilingual PEFT with Adaptive Semantic Sampling), a novel data-centric framework for adapting LLMs to target languages. COMPASS leverages parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) by training lightweight, language-specific adapters on a judiciously selec

summary.core_problem: 解决多语言持续适配中常见的跨语言负迁移问题：朴素多语微调往往会伤害目标语言表现，尤其当目标分布与已有训练数据不匹配时。
summary.importance: 这是一个数据选择与持续适配问题，不是预训练范式创新。价值主要在于把“该喂哪些辅助语言数据”做成分布感知的采样策略，对 multilingual PEFT 和 continual adaptation 有一定方法论参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 COMPASS：先用多语嵌入与聚类刻画目标使用分布和现有训练数据之间的语义缺口，再优先采样欠覆盖语义簇中的辅助多语数据，配合语言专属 PEFT adapter 训练，以提升正向迁移并减少干扰。进一步扩展为持续学习版本 COMPASS-ECDA，用于监控分布漂移并触发增量适配。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出明确模型规模、数据量、基线和具体提升幅度。可确认的实验主线应是：与朴素 multilingual fine-tuning / 随机采样 / 常规 PEFT 方案比较，在目标语言适配和持续分布变化场景下评估性能与干扰程度。由于缺少关键数字，当前只能视为中等可信度的应用型后训练方法。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets negative cross-lingual interference in continual multilingual adaptation, where naive multilingual fine-tuning often hurts the target language, especially under distribution mismatch.
summary_en.importance: This is a data-selection and continual adaptation paper rather than a pretraining-method paper. Its value lies in operationalizing which auxiliary multilingual data to use via distribution-aware sampling, which is mildly useful for multilingual PEFT and continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: COMPASS uses multilingual embeddings and clustering to measure semantic gaps between the target usage distribution and existing training data, then prioritizes auxiliary samples from under-covered semantic clusters while training lightweight language-specific PEFT adapters. COMPASS-ECDA extends this into a continual-learning setup that monitors distribution drift and triggers incremental adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data scale, baselines, or concrete gains. The likely setup compares against naive multilingual fine-tuning, random sampling, and standard PEFT baselines under target-language adaptation and continual-shift scenarios. Without hard numbers, the evidence should be treated as moderate at best.

recommendation.zh: 更像 multilingual PEFT 的数据采样技巧，不改 pretrain prior；若你做多语持续适配，只看采样定义和分布漂移触发机制即可。
recommendation.en: This looks like a multilingual PEFT data-selection trick, not a pretraining prior shift; if you work on continual multilingual adaptation, just read the sampling formulation and drift-trigger logic.

paper.title: SkillLearnBench: Benchmarking Continual Learning Methods for Agent Skill Generation on Real-World Tasks
paper.abstract: Skills have become the de facto way to enable LLM agents to perform complex real-world tasks with customized instructions, workflows, and tools, but how to learn them automatically and effectively remains unclear. We introduce SkillLearnBench, the first benchmark for evaluating continual skill learning methods, comprising 20 verified, skill-dependent tasks across 15 sub-domains derived from a real-world skill taxonomy , evaluated at three levels: skill quality, execution trajectory, and task out

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM agent 在真实任务上持续学习技能的能力，尤其是技能生成方法在跨任务、跨模型、跨反馈形式下是否稳定有效。
summary.importance: 这是 benchmark 工作，不是预训练方法。价值在于它给出了一个较真实的 continual skill learning 测试床，并得出一些不太乐观的结论：现有方法收益不稳定，强模型也不自动解决技能学习问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillLearnBench，覆盖 20 个经过验证的技能依赖任务、15 个子领域，并从技能质量、执行轨迹、任务结果三层评估。基于该 benchmark 比较 one-shot、self/teacher feedback、skill creator 等持续学习方法。
summary.experiments: 实验结论较明确：所有持续学习方法都优于 no-skill baseline，但没有任何方法能在所有任务和 LLM 上稳定领先；更强的 LLM 并不可靠地带来更好持续学习；对流程清晰、可复用的任务帮助更大，对开放式任务仍然吃力。摘要未给出具体模型名和分数。
summary.authors_note: 来自 CMU 与 Amazon AGI。Chenyan Xiong、Markus Dreyer 所在团队在检索、agent 与应用型 LLM 系统上有持续产出。

summary_en.core_problem: It benchmarks continual skill learning for LLM agents on real-world tasks, asking whether automatic skill generation methods are robust across tasks, models, and feedback settings.
summary_en.importance: This is a benchmark paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its value is in providing a more realistic testbed and in showing that current continual skill learning methods are much less stable than many demos suggest.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillLearnBench contains 20 verified skill-dependent tasks across 15 sub-domains, evaluated at three levels: skill quality, execution trajectory, and task outcome. The benchmark compares recent continual learning methods including one-shot, self/teacher feedback, and skill creator approaches.
summary_en.experiments: Main findings: all continual learning methods beat the no-skill baseline, but no method consistently wins across all tasks and LLMs; scaling to stronger LLMs does not reliably help; gains are larger on tasks with clear reusable workflows and weaker on open-ended tasks. The abstract does not provide exact model names or scores.
summary_en.authors_note: From Carnegie Mellon University and Amazon AGI. Chenyan Xiong and Markus Dreyer are associated with sustained work on retrieval, agents, and applied LLM systems.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent memory/skill 库，这篇的负结果比方法本身更值钱；否则只记住一点：更大模型并不会自动学会持续技能积累。
recommendation.en: If you work on agent memory or skill libraries, the negative results matter more than the benchmark itself; otherwise the main takeaway is simple: bigger models do not automatically solve continual skill accumulation.

paper.title: Why Fine-Tuning Encourages Hallucinations and How to Fix It
paper.abstract: Large language models are prone to hallucinating factually incorrect statements. A key source of these errors is exposure to new factual information through supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which can increase hallucinations w.r.t. knowledge acquired during pre-training. In this work, we explore whether SFT-induced hallucinations can be mitigated using established tools from the continual learning literature, since they arise as a by-product of knowledge degradation during training. We propose a sel

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究的不是泛泛的“幻觉”，而是一个更具体、也更可控的问题：模型在 SFT 过程中学习新事实时，会把预训练阶段原本已经掌握的旧事实弄坏，最终表现为对旧知识的错误回答。作者把它重新定义为 factual forgetting，而不是把所有错误都归因于知识缺失或推理失败。这个重述很关键，因为一旦问题被看作持续学习中的遗忘，就可以用 stability–plasticity tradeoff 的框架来分析：模型越有能力吸收新事实，越可能破坏已有事实；反过来，越强调稳定，越难学到新知识。论文的核心问题因此变成两件事：第一，SFT 诱发的 hallucination 到底是不是一种持续学习式的知识遗忘；第二，如果是，能否在保留任务学习能力的同时，减少这种遗忘。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后续微调研究，这篇工作的价值主要有三层。第一，它把“微调导致幻觉”从现象描述推进到机制层面的解释，明确区分了预训练知识空洞、推理时编造、以及 SFT 造成的知识退化这三类来源。这个区分会直接影响后续数据构造、SFT 配方和评测设计。第二，它给出两类有明确适用边界的缓解方案：如果场景不需要吸收新事实，例如对齐微调、私有风格适配，那么应主动压低 factual plasticity；如果场景既要学任务又要学新知识，例如领域适配，则应通过 self-distillation 约束输出分布漂移。第三，它对“知识存储是否受全局容量限制”给出了一种更细的反证：遗忘并不主要来自容量耗尽，而更像是表示空间中相近事实之间的局部干扰。这一点对预训练中的数据混合、实体表示、tokenizer 设计、持续学习和知识编辑都很有启发。贡献量级上，这不是单纯加一个 regularizer 的工程改进，而是把一个常见但混杂的问题拆开，并给出可验证的机制解释。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三步。第一步是构造一个能把 task learning 和 factual learning 分开的实验框架。作者沿用 Gekhman 等人的设定，用 SLiCK 先判断某个事实在基座模型中是否“已知”。SLiCK 通过多种随机 few-shot prompt 下的回答一致性，把样本分成 HighlyKnown、MaybeKnown、WeaklyKnown 和 Unknown。论文只保留 HighlyKnown 和 Unknown 两类：前者用来测遗忘，后者用来测新知识学习。这样做的好处是把“模型本来就不会”与“模型原本会但后来忘了”分开，否则 hallucination 指标会混入太多噪声。

第二步是验证“降低 factual plasticity”是否能减少遗忘。作者基于已有关于参数分工的研究，考察冻结不同参数组的效果，核心观察是：模型仍然可以学会任务格式和输出行为，但新事实吸收能力会下降，同时对旧事实的破坏显著减轻。这里的逻辑不是说冻结一定最好，而是用冻结做一个干净的干预实验，证明 task learning 与 factual learning 并不完全绑定，SFT 诱发的错误确实和新事实写入有关。

第三步是引入 self-distillation 作为持续学习式正则。具体做法是在 SFT 时，让当前模型不仅拟合监督标签，还要在一定程度上保持与旧模型输出分布接近，从而限制 output-distribution drift。它和常见 KL regularization 类似，但这里的目标不是保守地拒绝学习，而是在学习新事实时减少对旧知识相关表示的扰动。论文进一步通过合成事实实验分析机制：作者控制新实体的表面形式，一类是类似真实名字的字符串，另一类是 UUID 风格的随机标识符。若遗忘主要来自全局容量或行为克隆偏置，两类实体应当相近；但结果显示，名字式实体随着规模增大显著诱发遗忘，而 UUID 几乎不引起遗忘，即使加入 1M 新事实也是如此。这说明关键不是“写入了多少新知识”，而是“新旧知识在表示空间里是否相互靠近”。self-distillation 的作用也因此更清楚：它不是简单减小更新幅度，而是在输出层面约束那些会牵连旧事实的表示漂移。
summary.experiments:
论文最重要的实验结论有三组。第一组是复现实验：在引入 Unknown 新事实进行 SFT 后，模型对原本 HighlyKnown 事实的正确率下降，表现为明显的 factual forgetting。作者将这一现象量化后，指出基线设置下遗忘大约在 15% 左右。第二组是干预实验：通过冻结部分参数、抑制 factual plasticity，可以把遗忘显著压低，同时保留相当一部分任务学习能力；在不要求学习新事实的场景下，这是一种直接有效的策略。第三组是 self-distillation 实验：在需要吸收新事实的设定中，self-distillation 能把遗忘从约 15% 降到约 3%，同时仍保持有效的新知识获取。这是全文最关键的结果，因为它说明“少忘”和“能学”并非只能二选一。

机制实验同样值得看。作者构造合成事实，系统改变实体名称的表面形式和数据规模。结果是：当新实体使用 name-like 字符串时，随着新事实规模增加，旧事实遗忘显著上升；而当新实体使用 UUID 风格标识符时，即便规模达到 1M，新旧知识之间的干扰仍接近于零。这个结果很强，因为它把“语义/表示邻近性”从猜测变成了可操作变量。论文还报告了 self-distillation 能减少 held-out facts 的表示漂移，进一步支持其缓解机制。虽然你给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字、模型规格和全部消融细节，但从正文可确认的关键量化结论是：遗忘幅度约从 15% 降到 3%，并且 1M synthetic facts 的 UUID 条件下遗忘接近零。
summary.reading_guide:
建议按“问题定义—干预验证—机制解释”三段来读。

第一遍先看 Introduction 和第 2 节。重点不是实验细节，而是作者如何把 hallucination 缩小为 factual forgetting，并用 SLiCK 把 Known/Unknown 样本拆开。这里决定了整篇论文的可解释性。如果不理解这个数据划分，后面的结果会看起来像普通的微调稳健性实验。

第二遍精读第 3 节和第 4 节。第 3 节看冻结哪些参数组、为什么冻结后还能学任务但不太学新事实；这部分对理解“任务学习”和“事实写入”在参数空间中的相对分离很重要。第 4 节重点看 self-distillation 的目标函数、蒸馏对象、正则强度，以及它和简单减小学习率、减小步数、或更强 weight decay 的区别。核心创新不在于蒸馏本身新，而在于把它放到 factual forgetting 这个问题上，并证明它能在稳定性和可塑性之间取得更好的折中。

第三遍重点看第 5 节机制实验和相关图表，尤其是 name-like vs UUID 的对照，以及 held-out facts 的表示漂移分析。这部分最值得深挖，因为它触及一个更基础的问题：LLM 中事实冲突到底是参数容量问题，还是表示邻域冲突问题。若你做预训练数据、tokenizer、知识编辑或 continual pretraining，这一节的信息密度最高。

如果时间有限，至少看 Fig. 1、SLiCK 数据构造说明、冻结实验主表、self-distillation 主结果表，以及 surface-form similarity 的机制图。预计精读 60–90 分钟，若连附录中的额外分类组和消融一起看，建议预留 2 小时。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a specific failure mode behind hallucinations: during supervised fine-tuning, a model learns new facts but starts answering previously known facts incorrectly. The authors recast this as factual forgetting rather than treating it as generic hallucination. That reframing matters because it turns the problem into a continual-learning question: how to manage the stability–plasticity tradeoff. More factual plasticity helps absorb new knowledge, but it can also damage pre-trained knowledge. The paper asks two concrete questions: whether SFT-induced hallucinations are indeed a form of continual-learning-style forgetting, and whether they can be reduced without giving up useful task learning.
summary_en.importance: This work matters for foundation-model training for three reasons. First, it separates one source of hallucination from others: not missing pre-training knowledge, not inference-time fabrication, but degradation of already acquired knowledge during SFT. That distinction is operationally important for evaluation and for choosing fine-tuning recipes. Second, it proposes two mitigation regimes with clear use cases. If new factual acquisition is unnecessary, factual plasticity should be suppressed; if new factual acquisition is required, output drift should be regularized with self-distillation. Third, the mechanism analysis argues against a simple global-capacity story. Forgetting appears to be driven more by localized representational interference between nearby facts than by running out of storage. That has implications for continual pretraining, data mixture design, entity representation, tokenizer choices, and knowledge editing. The contribution is not just a better regularizer; it is a cleaner decomposition of a common but previously entangled phenomenon.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three layers. First, the paper builds a controlled setup that separates task learning from factual learning. Following Gekhman et al., it uses SLiCK to determine whether each fact is already known by the base model. SLiCK probes the model under multiple randomized few-shot prompts and classifies facts into HighlyKnown, MaybeKnown, WeaklyKnown, and Unknown. The paper keeps only HighlyKnown and Unknown examples: the former measure forgetting, the latter measure acquisition of new facts. This filtering is important because it removes ambiguity between facts the model never knew and facts it knew but later corrupted.

Second, the paper tests whether reducing factual plasticity reduces forgetting. Motivated by prior work showing that parameter groups play different roles in factual storage and task behavior, the authors freeze selected subsets of parameters during SFT. The key observation is that the model can still learn the downstream task format and behavior while becoming much worse at absorbing new facts, and this reduction in factual plasticity sharply lowers forgetting on old facts. The point is not that freezing is universally optimal, but that it provides a clean intervention showing that task learning and factual writing are not fully coupled.

Third, the paper applies self-distillation as a continual-learning regularizer. During SFT, the current model is trained not only on supervised targets but also to stay close to its own pre-update output distribution, limiting output-distribution drift. This is similar in spirit to KL-based regularization, but the role here is specific: preserve old factual behavior while still allowing new factual acquisition. The mechanism section strengthens this interpretation with synthetic-fact experiments. The authors vary the surface form of new entities: either name-like strings, which are likely to live near existing entities in representation space, or UUID-like identifiers, which are not. If forgetting were mainly due to global capacity limits or generic behavior cloning, both conditions should behave similarly. Instead, forgetting rises strongly with scale for name-like entities, while UUID-based entities induce almost no forgetting even with 1M new facts. This points to representational overlap as the main driver. Self-distillation then works by reducing the drift that would otherwise corrupt nearby held-out facts.
summary_en.experiments:
There are three main empirical results. First, the paper reproduces the core phenomenon: after SFT on Unknown facts, performance on previously HighlyKnown facts drops, showing clear factual forgetting. In the main setup, the forgetting level is around 15%. Second, interventions that suppress factual plasticity, such as freezing selected parameter groups, substantially reduce forgetting while preserving much of the task-learning ability. This is especially relevant for settings like alignment tuning or private-domain adaptation where learning new facts is not the goal. Third, in settings where new factual acquisition is required, self-distillation reduces forgetting from roughly 15% to roughly 3% while still allowing effective learning of the introduced facts. That is the central result of the paper because it shows that stability and plasticity are not forced into a strict either-or choice.

The mechanism experiments are equally important. Using synthetic facts, the paper varies both the scale of new knowledge and the surface form of entity names. Name-like entities cause substantially more forgetting as scale increases, whereas UUID-style entities produce near-zero forgetting even at 1M new facts. This is a strong result because it turns representational proximity into a manipulable variable. The paper also shows that self-distillation reduces representational drift on held-out facts, supporting the claim that its benefit comes from mitigating localized interference rather than simply shrinking updates. The provided full-text excerpt does not include every table value or model-size detail, but the key quantitative takeaways are explicit: about 15% forgetting in the baseline, reduced to about 3% with the proposed mitigation, and near-zero forgetting for the UUID synthetic setting at 1M facts.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read the paper in three passes: problem definition, intervention, mechanism.

Start with the Introduction and Section 2. The main thing to understand is not the benchmark itself but the reframing from hallucination to factual forgetting, and how SLiCK is used to isolate Known versus Unknown facts. Without that setup, the rest can look like a generic robustness study.

Then read Sections 3 and 4 carefully. In Section 3, focus on which parameter groups are frozen and why task learning can survive while factual acquisition is suppressed. This is useful if you care about where factual updates live in parameter space. In Section 4, inspect the self-distillation objective, what outputs are distilled, and how this differs from simply lowering the learning rate, reducing steps, or increasing weight decay. The novelty is not self-distillation by itself, but its use as a targeted tool for factual forgetting.

Finally, spend time on Section 5 and the associated figures. The name-like versus UUID comparison is the conceptual center of the paper. It addresses a deeper question: are factual conflicts in LLMs mostly about finite capacity, or about interference among nearby representations? If you work on pretraining data, tokenization, continual learning, or knowledge editing, this is the section to study closely.

If time is limited, at minimum read Fig. 1, the SLiCK data construction, the main freezing results, the main self-distillation table, and the surface-form similarity analysis. A careful read should take about 60–90 minutes; with appendices and ablations, closer to 2 hours.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改变你看 SFT hallucination 的方式：别再只怪数据噪声，先把它当 continual learning 退化问题；建议立刻复现其 distillation 正则和冻结 ablation。
recommendation.en: This should change how you think about SFT hallucinations: stop blaming only noisy supervision and treat it as continual-learning degradation; reproduce the distillation regularizer and freezing ablations first.

paper.title: JumpLoRA: Sparse Adapters for Continual Learning in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Adapter-based methods have become a cost-effective approach to continual learning (CL) for Large Language Models (LLMs), by sequentially learning a low-rank update matrix for each task. To mitigate catastrophic forgetting, state-of-the-art approaches impose constraints on new adapters with respect to the previous ones, by targeting either subspace or coordinate-wise interference. In this paper, we propose JumpLoRA, a novel framework to adaptively induce sparsity in the Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 LoRA 式持续学习中的任务干扰问题，尤其是在 rehearsal-free、task-agnostic inference 设定下，连续为多个任务训练 adapter 时，已有方法虽然会做子空间正交或坐标约束，但更新仍然偏 dense，参数隔离不彻底，随着任务数增加容易出现容量挤压和残余梯度干扰。JumpLoRA 的目标是让每个任务的低秩更新自动学出稀疏、相对分离的参数占用，从结构上减少遗忘，而不是只靠几何约束去“尽量不冲突”。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线而言，这篇不是 must-read 级别，但在持续学习和参数高效适配方向有一个清楚的启发：低秩并不等于低干扰。LoRA 把更新限制在低维子空间里，节省了参数，却没有天然解决不同任务之间的重叠占用。JumpLoRA 的贡献在于把“参数隔离”从后验约束变成前向结构设计，用可学习门控直接决定哪些更新坐标应该存在、哪些应该被取消。这个思路对后续做 continual pretraining、domain incremental adaptation、甚至 mixture-of-adapters 设计都有参考意义，尤其是在不想为每个任务维护完整独立模块的场景下。
summary.technical_approach:
方法建立在一个很直接的观察上：LoRA 的更新是 ΔW = A·B，虽然低秩，但其展开到原权重空间后仍可能是稠密的，因此很难做细粒度的参数选择。作者的做法不是对 A、B 本身加普通 L1 稀疏，而是把 JumpReLU 门控引入到 LoRA block，对低秩更新对应的权重贡献施加可学习阈值，让小幅、冗余或潜在干扰的更新被直接“跳过”。

论文的关键设计点有三层。第一，它把 task relevance 近似为累计梯度大小，并沿用已有 CL 文献中的观点：当前任务训练得到的 ΔW 可以看作 base weight 在该任务上的累计梯度代理。因此，保留 ΔW 中高幅值元素，相当于保留对当前任务更关键的更新。第二，作者要求每层稀疏度不是手工超参，而是由门控阈值自动学习。这个点很实际，因为 continual learning 需要跨多个任务顺序训练，如果每层 sparsity 都要网格搜索，成本会迅速失控。第三，JumpLoRA 被设计成模块化插件，可以叠加在现有 LoRA-based CL 方法上，而不是替换整个训练框架。文中明确展示了它与 IncLoRA、ELLA 等方法的兼容性。

和已有方法相比，O-LoRA、InfLoRA 主要在子空间层面避免干扰，ELLA 更接近坐标级约束，但仍处在 dense update 范式里；JumpLoRA 的区别是通过可学习稀疏门控实现更强的动态参数隔离。代价也很明确：它引入了额外门控参数和训练不稳定性的可能，需要平衡稀疏性、可塑性和任务性能。如果门控过强，新任务学习能力会下降；过弱，则隔离效果不足。
summary.experiments:
实验在标准 continual learning benchmark 和 long sequence benchmark 上进行，设定是 rehearsal-free 且 task-agnostic inference，这比知道任务 ID 的设定更难。论文的主结论是：把 JumpLoRA 叠加到现有方法上，能显著提升 IncLoRA，并优于或补强 ELLA 一类基线，说明收益不是来自换 backbone，而是来自稀疏门控带来的更好参数隔离。

从全文可提炼的实验关注点有三类。第一是平均性能与遗忘指标：作者应比较 sequential tasks 后的平均准确率、backward transfer 或 forgetting measure，验证 sparse isolation 是否真的减少旧任务退化。第二是稀疏性分析：需要看不同层学出的 sparsity 是否自适应变化，以及这种变化是否和任务难度、序列长度或层功能相关。第三是模块化验证：JumpLoRA 不是单独方法，而是可插接到 IncLoRA、ELLA 等框架中，因此关键证据是跨框架都能带来一致收益，而不是只在一个特定基线上有效。

给定你提供的全文片段，没有看到完整数值表，因此无法可靠填写具体提升百分点、参数规模或每层稀疏率分布。阅读时应重点核对主表、遗忘曲线和稀疏度可视化，确认收益是否稳定，以及是否存在后期任务性能回落。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点看方法动机和实验图表，不必在公式上停留太久。建议先读 Introduction，作者对现有 CL-LoRA 方法的局限总结得比较清楚：问题不只是正交不正交，而是 dense update 天然缺少结构隔离。然后看 Method 里关于 task relevance、ΔW 作为累计梯度代理、以及 JumpReLU 如何作用到 LoRA 更新上的部分。这里要特别注意作者为什么坚持“每层稀疏度自动学习”，这是方法是否实用的关键。

实验部分优先看三类内容：与 IncLoRA/ELLA 的主结果对比、forgetting 指标、以及 learned sparsity 的层级分布。如果只做一次泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。真正值得判断的点有两个：一是它是否在多个任务序列上稳定减少遗忘，而不是只提升平均分；二是 learned sparsity 是否形成了有意义的参数分工，而不是单纯把更新做小。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses task interference in LoRA-based continual learning for LLMs, especially in the rehearsal-free and task-agnostic inference setting. Existing methods try to reduce forgetting by enforcing orthogonality or coordinate constraints across adapters, but the updates remain largely dense, so parameter overlap accumulates as more tasks arrive. JumpLoRA aims to create adaptive parameter isolation: each task should occupy a sparse and partially disjoint subset of update coordinates, reducing forgetting structurally rather than only geometrically.
summary_en.importance: This is not a central pretraining paper, but it offers a useful idea for continual adaptation. Low-rank updates are parameter-efficient, yet they are not automatically interference-efficient. JumpLoRA makes that distinction explicit. Its contribution is to move from post hoc constraints on adapter interactions to a learnable sparsity mechanism inside the adapter itself. That is relevant for continual pretraining, domain-incremental adaptation, and adapter composition, where one wants stronger separation between tasks without maintaining a fully separate module per task.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method starts from a practical limitation of LoRA.
